Tests are impossible. Takes forever to email back. He glazes over important info during lecture and then never talks about it again. The tests were so impossible and wordy. The multiple choice questions had nothing to do with what we learned. RUN AWAY SCREAMING!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Coming from knowing nothing about finance, he always took the time to explain and repeat concepts that I did not quickly grasp. He always encouraged questions. You learn everything you need from his lectures (don't need textbook). Tough exams, but if you put in the work and ask questions you will do fine. Learned a lot and really enjoyed the class!

Prof Bai is great at teaching and is passionate about the topic. He graded by few things which allowed his students to focus on learning rather than merely high GPA. He is a lenient grader, and he would award you an A as long as you show a decent amount of effort. Fin Modeling is not an easy course, but it was an enjoyable one thanks to Prof. Bai!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The professor does his job well. The class in general is very hard if you are not inclined towards finance. Other Professors are too boring. He drops the lowest midterm, homework due every end of week (chegg). Finals and Midterms are decent, esp when online.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 2 midterms (20%), 1 final (30%). 2 SA and 17 or 21 MCQ each. Lockdown Browser with cam + mic. I did well on the final (along with many other students in the course) so he dropped my midterms grades, so final counted for 70%. Weekly connect assignments (hw is 25%). He goes through problems in class and gives a lot of practice worksheets. Okay hard

the course, in general, is hard. esp for non-finance majors. other professors will bore you and not even give you a grade, at least he'll keep you entertained. There are 2 midterms one final. Homeworks are due at the end of each week which are MCQs all available on Quizlet, course hero, or Chegg.

Professor Bai is enthusiastic and loves to engage the class together with discussions of current events on the stock market or economy in general. He tries to keep the class at a good pace but sometimes the discussions can be longer than expected. Overall, a decent Professor.

The worst class I've ever taken at NEU because on top of being a lazy grader--like who gives grades for assignments after classes are over--I didn't learn anything in this class that I didn't learn on co-op. A colossal waste of time.
Amazing lecturer, cares about his students. Pretty easy to get an A if you know anything about Finance

John has been one of my favorite professors at NEU. Genuinely caring, fair grading, and very humorous. He still recognizes me to this day despite having one class with him two years ago. A true class act.

John Bai is one of the best profs at NEU, he really cares about his students and does an excellent job of teaching the material. He is available outside of class to help with questions and really wants to make sure that his students do the best they can. If you do better on one midterm than the other he will drop the lower one which is really nice

I find the lectures to be frustratingly meandering and difficult to follow. I also wish what we learned was tied closer to the textbook so that I could go home and read the chapter to understand better.

Super nice guy, good prof and funny too. The class is tough but if you work hard you can get a good grade. He'll drop 1 of the 2 midterms (or both if you do better on the final than on both) so you will end up with the best possible grade. Homework is worth the same as one midterm (20%) which will give you grade a boost as long as you get it done.

His exams can be difficult, but his grading system is extremely considerate. He drops the lower of the two midterms, and will even drop both if you do not do well, but the final would be weighted more heavily. Very entertaining and funny in class, and he does all tough problems step-by-step on the board. 10/10 professor

Professor Bai is a good and funny professor, however his exams are very hard an often curves. Make sure to study from all the extra packets he hands out and only takes attendance sometimes. You need to study, and if you do you can get a minimum B-.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very good professor. Teaches finance from a more mathematical approach and goes over each topic in great detail making sure everyone gets it before moving on. Gives plenty of practice material, similar to what is on the tests. Tests can be very hard, so make sure to go over all his worksheets and office hours if needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Bai is a classic college professor: his lectures are supplemental to what you should be doing on your own outside of class. He expects you to have knowledge of the chapters as he further discusses them in class. If you are dependent on learning in the classroom, don't take him. Little homework, very clear about exam topics, nice guy, but gotta work
Funny guy. Curve the average to B.

Bai truly cares about his students' well being and performance. If you work hard and show improvement, he will take that into consideration when calculating grades. The class section was very large and I do believe he had a bit of trouble communicating to different skill levels. Definitely take his class in a small section, he's a great guy
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: HE IS A GREAT PROFESSOR. TRULY CARES ABOUT THE STUDENTS DOING WELL IN HIS CLASS. I HATE FINANCE AND HE TRIED TO MAKE IT AS UNPAINFULL AS POSSIBLE.  HE IS ALWAYS AVAILABLE OUTSIDE CLASS, HE IS A REALLY NICE PERSON THAT KNOWS HOW DIFFICULT THIS CLASS CAN BE FOR SOME PEOPLE THAT ARENT INTO FINANCE.  DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND TAKE HIM. NICEST PROFESSOR

Apparently, I know half of my classmates didn't do well in this class. However, Professor Bai covered everything on the exam in class.  He made really clear of what you should know through the PPT. Make sure to take notes on every example he gives out in class, because they will most likely to be on your exams. One of my favorite professors at NEU!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but horrible teacher. Half of the class was failing and MC questions were impossible. There seemed to be a large discrepancy between grades, i.e. those who came in with a solid foundation did well and those who didn't suffered.

I believe Spring 2016 is his first semester as a professor, he is okay, except the final exam, other were not so difficult, he curve the grade, but he doesn't explain the materials and lectures clearly. A lot of student in his class were confused. Well.. If you are a good student, take his class, you will be alright, but if you are not, probably no
Tough but fair
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Charvet's tests and grading are tougher than average. Negative reviews probably from students not putting any effort and expecting to coast anyways. CLosed book and expects you to know most of the material. Fair teacher, knows a lot and uses real-life examples.
Worst professor ever!! Never take già class! Very hard-graded. Hates every international student
I was interested in Supply Chain before taking this class...Worst Professor I ever had! DO NOT TAKE HIM!

Worst Professor EVER! Doesn't want to give full credit (always finds some lame excuses to not give 100%), and the only way you can get a good grade is by memorizing his incredibly boring slides. Quizzes are hard and final exam is comprehensive. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!

If you expect an easy A, don't take this class. Don't expect to get 100% for particiation just by being in the class. My experience have been great with Prof. Charvet. His class actually prepared me for the real world. When you get out of school, don't expect much hand holding by your managers.
Hard hard hard class. Hard grader, boring and way too much HW. So much reading every day and crazy about participation. Got D for participation for attend every class, and speak out once per class.

Worst professor in the supply chain dept.  takes the subject of transportation and makes it even more unbearable.  assigns way too much reading for each class and online book is difficult to read.  professor simply does not know how to teach effectively.  Slides are confusing and tests are hard.  Class is much harder than it should be.
I was very interested in Supplychain management before I took this class. He should learn how to teach.

His tests are extremely difficult.  Assigned a simulation to do every week, before he taught us the principles behind it.  Does not speak clear and is very hard to understand.  Must read and try very hard to do well in the class.

Truly one of the kindest people I've ever met. I can't speak highly enough of him. If you reach out for help or need an extension, he's incredibly understanding and willing to work with you. I highly recommend taking any of his classes, he's genuinely supportive and accommodating.

I absolutely LOVED Craig. He is such a gem and deserves so much more attention than he's given. His lectures can be boring, but he loves to expand on topics and really help students understand. He's accommodating for his students and really cares about his students. He's the sweetest man ever.
Professor Roberston is so funny, gives great content and lectures. His class definitely isn't an easy A, it's kind of a lot of work but not super hard work.
This guy is the best. Inspirational. Really just living his best life writing unintelligably on the chalkboard. If you do the readings and go to class an A- is practically guarenteed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Very passionate about his subjects, but he gets it if you aren't. Very clear about expectations and genuinely just wants everyone to learn something from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Craig is awesome! He makes class super interesting and has the best sense of humor. Would highly recommend his classes.

Robertson is one of my favorite professors I've had here.  He's funny and engaging in his lectures, and he is very passionate about his subject and wants you to get excited about it too.  He's very accommodating and understanding if you speak to him.  It's a lot of reading, but nothing too bad.  I highly recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I am not a fan. Craig is extremely biased and I never once was given an article to read that provided a viewpoint that wasn't his. This class was dull, useless and had no educational value. Also regardless of if I spent 1 or 20 hours on a paper I always got a B. If you want an easy useless class go ahead, but not if you want to learn anything.
Amazing professor with awesome teaching style. He is very clear. Do the readings and be open to understand what you may not have thought about before this class. can't stress enough how amazing.

Robertson is very smart guy when it comes to media and cultural theories. The class is an absolute ****, as the topics are really abstract, but Robertson manages to pull you in with his unique teaching style. He has a great sense of humor. You must read, and do not BS the essays, he'll see right through it. He also gives a ton of comments on work.

While this class had a dry topic, Professor Robertson made it pretty exciting and interesting.  The classes were dicussions rather than lectures and he valued participation.  Grades were based on 2 long and 4 short essays. He's also very funny.

Very interesting class with a fun teacher.  The class is discussion based and Robertson did a good job of keeping the class going.  He is also pretty funny with a dry sense of humor in an annoying briton kinda way.  He's also got a funny New Zeland accent.  Craig Robertson rocks hard and often.  He's got a black belt in keeping it real.
Very passionate about what she teaches. Lectures are informative and content is engaging.

Prof. Pereira was a great professor! You can tell she cares deeply about the topic and is experienced within the field, yet she's still lighthearted, approachable, and easily accessible.There are two bigger group assignments (with the same people), so it really depends on who you get paired with, but she has a system for ranking effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super sweet! So much reading to do tho, you will most likely not even try to do it at the end of the semester. Weekly discussion posts but only like 20 mins, but you have to pay for the program. Two group projects with assigned groups, but relatively light is you have a good group. She's very easy to talk to and passionate about the topic.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: She's super nice and understanding, but lots of group projects with the same pre-assigned group, so cross your fingers you get a good one. Leanient grading, but there is a discussion board every week.

Prof Pereira was sweet, but I'm not sure I would take her again. I liked this course, and you were assigned a group to work throughout semester which I found valuable -- very project-based and several weekly readings.

Professor Danahy is really good at teaching you the material but her class is considered harder than some of the other professors. You will have a great understanding of Orgo but your grade might be lower than if you took another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take orgo with literally any other professor!! Her lectures are lengthy and confusing, and she doesn't explain concepts well. Her exams are very difficult and require you to have an extremely good understanding of orgo to apply concepts. She rarely does guided practice with the class and you're expected to know how to do all of the homework!!

Honestly one of the worst graders possible, tests are unfairly graded, lack of support and understanding, the practice exams are nothing like the real exams so no point in doing those. Her lectures are heavy and don't teach you much at all. I recommend taking another professor.

Danahy is a very nice person, but her tests are impossible. Studied for hours on end, yet still felt completely unprepared for each test. The topics covered between the last test and the final are rushed and poorly covered, so there was no shot the "final redemption" policy would apply. Love Pensive Cat, but not this class.

As a ChemE who had Danahy for Orgo 1, this was my favorite class of the semester. Puzzle sets were short and sweet. Office hours make the semester enjoyable. I always go into her exams thinking they're going to be harder than they are. I'm coming out of the course feeling like I know how to do useful things with Orgo. Her humor is icing on the cake

I am reading all of these bad reviews and truly wondering if I was the same class as y'all…Like yes her exams are hard but the comments about there being no support are just false. She has 3 hours of office hours per week, responds to emails in like 10 minutes, and has 3 excellent TAs. She is also extremely kind and nonjudgmental.

Danahy is an amazing teacher who really cares about her students. This course is of course challenging, but she sets us up for success. Her exams are all free response, so if you prefer MC,  take it with another teacher. I really enjoyed this class, and it has made me appreciate chemistry more! My D in her class is a reflection of me not her!

Super nice and caring; very accessible and approachable outside of class for extra help. Lectures are given via her iPad, and her notes and weekly homework are very useful to learn from. If free-response exams and "content mastery" aren't your thing, take the other professors with MC tests.

Take someone else if you can. I loved orgo 1 and got an A, but did terrible in this class. Exams are extremely hard and despite studying nonstop, I felt hopeless. The exams have content that we never covered. Some puzzle sets were easy, and some were very hard. She also doesn't curve, give extra credit, etc. She's nice, but the class is so so hard.

Honestly liked her for orgo 1 and did well. However, this class was so bad for orgo 2. Insanely hard exams and randomly pulls out mechanisms no one has ever seen. I studied like 30 hours a week and still felt blindsided on her exams. Take Matthews instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE HER. Her exams are impossible. She says, "I'm not trying to trick you." SHE IS. I spent so many hours a day studying, but nothing prepares you for the exams. Grade is basically just 4 exams, including the cumulative final. No practice is similar to exam questions because she pulls questions out of yk what. Take Staton or Mathews

This class (and her) made me cry on multiple occasions. I've studied hours on end, practically dedicated my life to this class, and never was it enough. her exams are nothing like the ones she gives us from ‘22, they are so so much more difficult. do your self a favor and please do not take her, this class is actually the most crazy thing ever…

Her exams do not reflect the material learned. I studied 15 hours straight every single day and understood all practice problems and practice exams. Yet, every exam consists of questions that are a mix of things and ultimately something we didn't learn. Her exams ARE NOT FAIR. Orgo is not easy, but she makes it harder. She gives no support. NOTHING

Do yourself a GPA favor and mental favor (emphasis on mental) and do not take her. I thought I could give her the benefit of the doubt, but the exams are not AT ALL similar to what we learn. To put it in perspective, someone fully balled their eyes out LOUD in the middle of the final. Multiple people left in tears with empty pages. Don't take her.

if you didn't do well in ochem1, do not take ochem2 with danahy. the exams and homeworks are insanely difficult. people told me ochem1 was harder than 2 but this class was so much harder. this class was miserable. take any other prof.

Dr. Danahey is an amazing professor! I took her class for both Orgo 1 and 2 and enjoyed both classes. Her lectures work best for visual learners because she essentially takes notes with you. She is extremely kind and wants her students to succeed. Responds to emails fast. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!!!

I liked her so much better for Orgo 1. Her lectures got very hard to follow and we never got to do guided practice in class. I wanted to like her but it was so hard to do well in this class, she is incredibly stingy with partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Danahy is absolutely wonderful. Incredibly kind and truly cares about her students. Her syllabus can make the class seem daunting, but if you put in effort she will genuinely love you and bend over backwards to help you. Read the textbook before lecture, come with questions, go to office hours, and you'll be fine!

She was a very hard grader and all tests were very difficult. She teaches in lecture very well but that is it. She provides no support, gives no extra credit and doesn't curve. Be prepared to study for your life for this class.

In all honesty she is a very sweet professor but she is extremely difficult. Orgo is a hard class no matter who you have, but she doesn't help. No curves, extra credit, or test corrections. Her exams are extremely difficult much more so then previous years and practice problems. I shed blood, sweat and tears and still ended with a C.

Professor Danahy is awesome. The textbook reading are not super important if you understand the lectures. The puzzle sets are really good practice for exams. She is so helpful and kind during office hours. Her lecturing style is keeps you engaged during class and she gives time for practice problems during which she walks around and offers help.

I dedicated my life to studying for this course. Did every problem in the textbook; they helped, but only to a certain extent. Some exam questions aren't like any practice. BIGGEST ADVICE: GO TO OFFICE HOURS and ask questions, no matter how "stupid", as long as it helps you. An A starts at 91.5(she rounds), + final redemption grade. Super nice lady
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Lectures are great- she writes notes with you. Everything is covered in class, but it's your responsibility to study. Exams are hard, so it's important u REALLY understand the material. Super approachable & nice, quick to respond to emails & addresses all ur concerns. Difficult course but she gives u more resources to study with than other profs.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is very kind and so knowledgeable in chemistry. However, the textbook problems and practice do not compare to the difficulty of exams, which make up mostly all of your grade. She is a very tough grader. If you take orgo with her you will learn a lot, but do know that it is very tough

Such a kind professor. But to be honest, her test are NOTHING like the assignments and previous exams as she claims, PREVIOUS ONES R 10x EASIER! She puts EVERYTHING reviewed in class on exam, class avg is usually in the 70s or low 80s. Classes are so hard to sit through and you get exhausted and bored by the end. Ur in for a treat, a GPA bust :(

Danahy is a great lecturer and qualified, but her tests are extremely difficult and the final was worse. She recommends you do the textbook problems + her homework which may seem helpful but come no where near the difficulty of the exams. She's super sweet but her class is very difficult to pass with a good grade :( If you are pre-med save your GPA

There are many mixed reviews about her, but to be completely honest, she is an amazing professor. Chemistry has never been a strong subject for me, but her lectures and office hours show that she is such a great teacher and genuinely wants you to do well. During finals week she provides so many study guides and resources and her TAs are amazing.

Professor Danahy is very sweet and kind. I really enjoyed having her as a professor and would say that she is really great at teaching the material! My only recommendation is that you also need to practice a lot outside of lectures to really grasp the concepts which will be on the tests. I recommend attending office hours when you can.

Great professor and overall really good lectures. Exams get progressively harder (including the cumulative final). Textbook problems are OK for grasping a basic understanding of topics, but come nowhere close to the level of difficulty on exams. Tough grader and not very generous with partial credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Danahy is very kind and a good professor with engaging lectures, however this class is very difficult. I found the cumulative final was very tough and way harder than the practice. In addition to puzzle sets and poll everywhere there are 3 exams then the final for the overall grade. I definitely learned a lot, though.

The reviews lied...yes Danahy is a good lecturer but her exams are very difficult making it hard to pass with a good grade. Her TA's aren't helpful because they don't understand her assignments and always cancel. The textbook does not help since her questions on exams are totally different than textbook practice problems.

DO NOT TAKE THIS WACK CLASS HER EXAMS ARE SO HARD IT'S INSANE AND HER FINAL WAS A MILLION X WORSE THAN ANYONE COULD EVER IMAGINE. Now you may think I'm dumb or smth but no I did good 2/3 exams but the last killed grade and the final was EXTREMELY hard. No curves, corrections, or extra credit. Good luck if u take her :(

Genuinely might be the best professor I've ever had. I've taken organic chemistry before and love it so that was definitely an advantage but for someone who is brand new and/or scared of orgo, she is AMAZING! You definitely need to read the textbook and do ALL the extra problems. I used a lot of notecards and she was always super easy to email!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Organic chem is hard and while Danahy teaches well in class her exams are EXTREMELY difficult and she is a tough grader. Her TA's aren't helpful bc they dont even understand her weekly puzzle set assignments. I would not recommend or take her again because if you mess up one exam you're done for grade wise.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was a very kind and approachable woman. If conceptualizing content is not easy for you, don't take her. The tests were extremely hard. We were not given much material to study from. We had 2-3 hw to study from for that exam and maybe some textbook problems that did not have much to do with what was going to be on the exam.
Sweetest lady ever.  Sometimes lectures can get confusing but going to extra help definitely helps.  She cares and wants you to do well.

I loved Prof Danahy for Orgo 1! Her lecture style makes it very easy to follow along. Utilizing her and TA's office hours was essential, though. I wish she provided more difficult practice problems/materials as her tests were pretty difficult. She is great with partial credit, though, and truly cares about your success in the class!

I absolutely love Professor Danahy. She is so amazing at what she does. Her lectures are incredible and make ochem seem easy. Her homework is based on participation, and is so helpful for studying because her tests are based on similar questions. Answers emails quickly, and has lots of office hours. Take her if u want to fall in love with chemistry
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is probably, if not the best, organic chemistry teacher! I had her for both organic chemistry 1 and 2, and I got an A in both classes! The most important things are pay attention during class, ask her questions, and review content. You really need a deep understanding of the material to do well. She really cares about her students doing well!

If you honestly want to be prepared for Orgo 2 and fully comprehend Orgo 1 you should definitely take this class with Jude Matthews. Jude may come off as aggressive but she will honestly give you all the material you will need to succeed unlike Danahy. Danahey doesn't teach to learn but to pass with low grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Danahy was one of the best professors that I have had at NU! She did a very good job of explaining the topics in a way that students could easily understand. She provided many examples in class and was very willing to answer questions and re-explain topics. Overall, she is a very kind-hearted professor who wants to see you succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I have taken Danahy for Orgo 1 and 2 and she has been the best prof I could ask for! Exams were open response and personally, that was difficult, but she gives partial credit. Find someone to study with who genuinely wants to help you (there's some stingy pre-health kids), but also utilize office hours and tutoring. Textbook also kind of helped.

As much as Matthews is hyped up, Danahy is a great option for orgo. She emails back super quick if you ask a question and I found her office hours very helpful. The tests are hard, especially the final, but if you put in the work you can absolutely get an A. Participation is taken via Poll Everywhere and you need to complete 90% of questions.

Danahy is a solid option for orgo. She's super sweet and her lectures are very easy to follow. As long as you do the recommended reading and the practice problems you'll get a decent grade. There are three exams and they are graded pretty harshly, it's all free response and she doesn't give a lot of partial credit. Definitely learned a lot though.

My favorite professor I've ever had at NEU. She is SO caring, helpful, and intelligent! I HIGHLY recommend doing the readings before classes, textbook questions after class, rewriting notes, and going to office hours once a week. Lectures are fast paced, but her tests are very predictable and manageable if you stay on top of things. Take her class!

Such a genuinely nice person. I've never had professor be so caring about her students. She wants people to do well and is interested in you as a person. That being said, her class is not easy and her final is hard if you are not the best at orgo. She is probably the smartest professor but very down to earth.
Really good at explaining things, the material on the tests are exactly like in class.

It was a privilege to have Danahy for Orgo 1 - while a bit shy, she is incredibly coherent and intelligent, and more importantly, good at teaching. Her mandatory lectures can be fast-paced at times, though she explains concepts coherently and they MUST be complemented by the textbook and her weekly puzzle sets. 

Also, DO NOT bomb the first exam.
best teacher ive ever had. really wants students do to well

explains things well
- skimming the reading before class and doing the recommended textbook problems within 24 hours of the lecture makes the A
- good review materials and review sessions
- the puzzle sets are basically practice tests, if you study them you will know everything you need to know
- a lot of helpful office hours

TAKE DANAHY. I was so scared of orgo coming into this class but she made the concepts so much easier to understand. Her tests are difficult, but she doesn't throw you any curve balls. Go to office hours! She's definitely a professor you want to form a relationship with.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best professor I have at at Northeastern, she is extremely clear about what she expects you to know and she's great at explaining concepts. Tests are open ended; she is very generous with partial credit, and the content of the test is predictable. If you really study an A is within reach.

Her lectures are very important, orgo 1 is just pretty overwhelming to begin with but she made it better for me. It's just not an easy A. It depends if u like lecture heavy and open-ended exams or not

Professor Danahy is one of my favorite professors that I have taken here at Northeastern. She truly cares about how students do in her class and also gives lots of partial credit. She makes the material extremely digestible which is nice for Orgo.

I enjoyed orgo 1 but I feel like her open response tests were just overwhelming for no reason. She gives partial credit but honestly your enjoyment of the class depends on if you enjoy her style of teaching tbh.

Danahy is a very generous grader but her exams are open response and difficult. For Orgo 1 she was fine, but I wish I took Jude for Orgo 2 bc Danahy's overcomplicated and difficult exams felt like we were being set up to get low grades. She is super kind and office hours are sort of helpful. Get a tutor and study immediately after a lecture.

Organic chem is a hard class no matter the professor. Danahy does a decent job explaining the topics. Read the textbook and beware that topics build on each other. Homework is hard but for completion. Exams are very hard but you get to understand her style. Gives generous partial credit. Helpful during office hours. I am taking her again!

Same guy as the previous post. If you want to actually do well, TAKE HER, NOT JUDE. Jude requires tons of work outside of lecture, and her only redeeming quality is multiple choice tests (you can't get partial credit!!) Take Danahy, thank me later.

AWESOME. Prof. Danahy is everything you could ask for for a challenging course like orgo. Her handwritten lecture style is far better than a slideshow style, and she gives examples for every topic presented. I believe that she is the best possible orgo professor, and an A in the class is very manageable if sufficient preparation is done.

Attendance is mandatory. Teacher is very nice but has a tendency to overcomplicate topics when explaining. Exams are open response and she does not curve or give extra credit. Even peer tutors would be confused on the homework she would give. Nice person, did not enjoy the class at all. Had to learn most of the content myself outside of class

If you're someone who benefits from handwriting notes, having a relationship with your profs, and values a smaller class size Danahy is your professor. HW is in the form of puzzle sets which are challenging but so helpful for exams, office hours are accessible, and lectures are actually understandable. Orgo isn't easy but she makes it manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's a nice professor, however her teaching style is definitely different. Her exams focus on the process of why something is the way it is more than the products, i.e explain why this carbonyl is more nucleophilic, or why is this compound have a certain composition? Take a different prof with multiple choice exams and not a cumulative final......

This woman is so slept on. She is wonderful! If you put in the work and aks questions you will get it. She is so willing to help and responds to questions and emails so very fast. She is always willing to help and is the cutest human I know! I love her soo much! TAKE HER! Better than Jude!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Love the way she explains chemistry! Lectures are clear and easy to understand. Tests are fair and class is manageable.

Prof. Danahy teaches Orgo 2 really well. The tests are open-ended, not multiple choice, which makes studying for them trickier since you need to know the content, but there's lots of partial credit. Going to class and taking good notes is important to learn the material, the puzzle sets also give a good insight into what test questions are like.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: 3 unit exams and 1 final exam, puzzle sets are very hard so I recommend the peer tutors for help. She is always available outside of class. Orgo is very difficult but she makes it bearable. Exams are mostly open ended but she gives a ton of partial credit. Definitely take her if you have the option.

Kelley is the sweetest prof ever!! She cares so much about all her students and is very passionate about what she teaches. The exams, though open-ended, were a lot easier than the homework assignments and she's a very lenient grader (she will defs give you points wherever she can)

She is thorough with her lectures and her exams are somewhat difficult but very fair. There are some open ended questions however you can get partial credit for these. There are a few homework assignments graded on completion which boost your grade a little. She also takes time to answer every question during class and in office hours.

I loved Professor Danahy. She's passionate about chemistry. She writes down examples and notes as she talks about them and focuses on concepts that may not otherwise be focused by other teachers. The homework she gives is hard, but is graded for effort/completion. She prepares you well for the free response exams - nothing comes as a shock.

Danahy was one of the few professors that I've had where she seemed like she wanted us to learn something. I found that she explained topics clearly and was happy to answer any question that we had, either during lecture, office hours, or over email. Exams are exactly what she teaches, and homework really prepares you for exam material.

Professor Danahy is one of the best professors that I have had. She is always available and super helpful in her office hours. The exams are open response, which was difficult, but she gave fair partial credit. She returns emails and grades very quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is such a nice professor! I didn't prefer her teaching style - several concepts were made very confusing and overcomplicated. I had gone to her office hours multiple times and I didn't feel like she would help explain problems and often left confused. Her homework assignments were also very tricky that it confused my peer tutors at times.
She is passionate about chem! Personally, I did not enjoy her style of teaching. I came to her when I was struggling and she did not try to help. Her example problems even confused the peer tutors.
Homework was difficult but prepared you for the free response exams. Questions were a bit confusing at times. Very accesible outside of class and really cares
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great prof that loves chemistry. She has some great lectures that you need to answer a poll to get credit for. Very information dense, but that's how organic chemistry is, and she drills the ideas into your head. She really wants her students to understand everything instead of memorizing. Very tough hw but it teaches you how she wants you to think

I had Danahy for orgo 1, great lecturer and good at explaining. She always responded to emails quickly. However the puzzle sets are very hard and prepare to study beyond the lecture material. She gives a lot of partial credit on tests. Overall I recommend her but her class is a little difficult, I thought I did a lot better than the grade I got.

I had Prof Danahy for CHEM 2311 but she was an absolutely amazing professor. Takes her time explaining tough concepts in class, is truly caring about her students, and is always accessible out of class for office hours and fit you in outside of them as well. Exams are open response but A LOT of partial credit. HW is great bc it preps for the exam.

Absolutely love her! She is always available outside of class and over email. Tests can be intimidating due to free response, but if you understand the homework and lectures you will be fine. She clearly cares for her students and hints at what may be on the test. Also gives lots of partial credit on tests.
He's just a lil guy.

Overall cool guy, your grade is just 20% quizzes, 40% midterms and 40% final, but the quizzes are similar to the practice ones which is good. You can honestly skip his lectures and just teach yourself the material in the same amount of time and get easy A's on the quizzes.

He's a pretty good professor for Diff Eq; he teaches the material well and the quizzes/tests are very similar to the practice problems. He also posts all of the lecture notes onto Canvas and the notes are well organized. He does occasionally trail off and the lectures can be boring but he's not a bad teacher.

I didn't have to attend to any of his lectures to get an A in the class, the notes are really good if you understand everything on notes you will get 100 in all the quizes ez. Also the slides for notes are only 3-5 pages so lock in.
I liked Dmitre. His lectures were wildly boring and he sometimes struggled with solving the example problems. However, he posted goo

I'm not sure why his rating is low because he's a great professor. He explains concepts thoroughly and focuses on understanding over memorization. He posts practice tests for every quiz/exam(a week+ ahead), and the real tests are very similar. He also tells you what's on the exam a week in advance. Highly recommend.
He posts practice problems which are very similar to his real quizzes and midterms, if you go to recitation you will pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do NOT take this class with Dimitre. He is a nice guy; however, he is extremely difficult to follow and pay attention to. He is very wandering and unformatted. He often backtracks and goes off on tangents. By 3 minutes in, everyone is lost. As I said, reasonably nice guy, BAD teacher.

This was my favorite professor I have had for a math course since being at NEU. He is very nice and has a great understanding of the material. He goes over some notes, then does a few examples which really make sure that you know what you're doing. Go to office hours because he is always willing to help.

I took this class in summer 2, and idk if it was just the summer semester vibes, but I felt he was very forgiving in grading. Partial credit can get you pretty far. Also he allows cheat sheets on exams and there's really no trick questions on quizzes. I had a terrible Calc 2 prof so this class helped me like math again tbh.
he is SO hard to understand and hella unapproachable, buttttt he gives great detailed lecture notes and llets you have a full page of notes for every test including the final.

hes a nice guy but his accent is literally so hard to understand and his vibe is so unapproachable. the lecture notes were very detailed tho, and hes a generous test grader. the course material is not very hard andddd you get an entire page of notes for every exam

Just took this professor and he pretty much sucked. If you really care to learn the material do not take this teacher. I basically taught myself the entire course since Dimitre was hard to understand and really really boring. hw is pretty similar to the quizzes but a few of the quizzes are just super hard for no reason.

This class was one of my least favorite because of not only the course material, but the homework. Homework was very hard.
the professor always mumbles when he speaks and it is hard to understand what is going on in lecture, I could never keep track of what was going on. I will say, he does grade the exams very generously

Professor Dimitre Tzigantchev was honestly the best professor I have ever had in my life, he brings the life into the classroom. While many may have the opposite reaction to him, I think that he brings fun to what is not a very fun subject. He is consistent with class examples, pictures, homework that matches what he puts on exams. GO DIMITRE!
lots of lecturing, most people have already taken calculus so he doesn't hold your hand through it; however, there is lots of help available and most importantly he is really genuinely nice guy.

Honestly I did not feel that Professor Dimitre was bad at all. There were times where he would mix up his words or forget some but it wasn't to the point where I couldn't understand what was being taught. Your grade is dependent on only quizzes and exams, so attending the lectures is important and the practice quizzes given are insanely helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Tzigantchev means well, but his lectures are useless and end up being confusing. If you haven't take calc before I wouldn't recommend him, also your grade is only dependent on quizzes and exams.

Would not recommend. Would often approach him after class to ask questions and would receive vague and unhelpful answers. Doing the research myself proved to be more helpful than reaching out to him for extra help. 

Quizzes involve lots of multiple choice, which I have not seen before in a class like this.

His lectures aren't very helpful he spends time talking about why he;s doing something irrelevant to the problem he's solving. There's a lot of quizzes, if you haven't recently taking an AP calc class in high-school I wouldn't recommend him. His office hours aren't really helpful either and he doesn't check or post the answer to hw assignments.

I took AB Calculus in high school (got a 3 on the exam so I didn't get credit), and this course was a lot easier. I never went to class because I didn't find it very helpful - when I did I just did practice problems on my own. He posts practice tests that are almost exactly like the actual tests - definitely do them!!! Super easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are informative and this class is not hard if you pay attention. Unfortunately, he doesn't really explain the ideas conceptually and just teaches you how to do the math. Homework is optional and grading comes entirely from quizzes and tests.

Absolutely do not take this class if you haven't taken calculus before. He treats the class like review and is not good at answering questions. The class is mostly self-taught and he often mumbles during lectures.

I do not recommend taking this class with Dimitre if you did not take calculus in high school, my grade is solely on background knowledge. He is hard to follow and strays from the topic. I recommend using the guided notes that he provides. You are graded on 6 highest quizzes of 7, a midterm, and a final. He gave substantial bonus points at the end.

Nice guy, teaches everything by the textbook. He often does calculations in his head which can lead to confusion. Homework is not mandatory as long as you understand the topic. There are quizzes mostly every week but as long as you do the practice problems you'll be ok. Tests have formula sheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU DID NOT TAKE AP CALC!!!!! His lectures are very confusing and he has messy hand writing which it very hard to understand. Anyone who didn't talk AP calc is struggling. Also 40% of ur grade is ur final. He does give extra credit though which is kind.

Good guy, kinda bland but he teaches the material in class pretty well. It's all very formulaic. No practice problems, I did no homework the entire time bc it is optional. Do the practice before the quiz because they're pretty much the same thing. Quizzes every week. Tests allow formula sheets.

The professor is incredibly boring and hard to follow. He simply writes on the board without engaging with the class and when presented with a question, he struggles to give a clear answer. The only reason why I am doing ok here is because of AP Calc last year. The quizzes/ tests are graded harshly and minor mistakes cost you greatly.

This variation of calc1 should be avoided as it covers concepts way into diff eq and linear algebra. Prepare to solve systems of ODE and use lambda substitution to find eigenvectors. Dr T did not help digest this rather challenging material which became more apparent as the class shifted to more difficult topics. U can still do well if ur smart tho
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not a great teacher, be prepared to study tons outside of class. Would brush through problems and start new topics without ever explaining the content or the methods used. There is a significant amount of extra material posted on canvas which made it somewhat helpful to practice with, however the entire grade was dependent on quizzes and the final.

Don't buy the textbook! everything you need is uploaded to Canvas including practice quizzes, lecture notes, and homework problems. the math in this class isn't too complicated as long as you listen and participate in class. His lectures can be difficult to follow because he goes on tangents but generally, he isn't a terrible professor.

Professor Tzigantchev means well, but his lectures are often confusing and he does not explain concepts well. He does provide practice quizzes that are very similar to the real quizzes. He also allows you to drop your worst quiz grade. If you haven't taken calc before, you will struggle in this class.

Do not take if you haven't taken calc already. I took calc before and the class was still bad. Someone else grades the tests, and they are not fair with scores. He is hard to understand at times and when asked to elaborate on a concept, he gives no explanation or overcomplicates. Practice problems uploaded are helpful, go to the recitations!!!!

Just shows no care for his students. A genuine disregard for how well his students are doing and whether or not they understand. Class moves so fast and covers topics well into calc 2 despite being a calc 1 class. No matter what you do, just take regular calc 1 for the same credit. Office hours and recitations are available and u will need them.

He is very scattered during lectures and always over complicates concepts. If you go into this class without having any prior knowledge of calculus, you will struggle a lot. The final is worth 40% of your grade and there is only 6 other exams, but the lowest grade will get dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: People aren't lying here. I thought I could beat the odds.....don't take it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I honestly feel that dimitre is given too much hate. I think he gives enough resources to do good in class like practice problems from a textbook. The test questions are almost exact to these questions and sometimes he will take questions straight from the textbook. If you took AP Calc then this class will be easy, i found it easier than AP Calc.

Has a very thick Russian accent that can be difficult to understand. There is a separate grader for the class who is not generous with partial credit AT ALL. I already took calc in high school but he tended to overcomplicate things.
If I didn't already know the content of this class from AP classes in high school I would have been completely lost otherwise.

I loved his ambition to practice lessons as much as class time goes. Please come to class every day, it's worth it. There's a separate grader for our exams and he is very evil when it comes to taking off points. Go to office hours and get them points back! ;) P.S. do the homework! It helps you with exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was an average professor-that is if you took calc before. If not, you will have to put in more work for this class. The grading was limited to 6 midterms (60%). If you get a bad grade on one, it takes a toll on your grade. Lastly, the last grade is the final (40%). Idk who graded the midterms but sometimes the points taken off are inaccurate.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures can be difficult to follow, but he does a lot of examples and answers questions. There's biweekly quizzes and a final, all of which he posts a lot of practice material/past quizzes for. If you do those practice problems, you'll do well. There's also two homework assignments, which boost your grade. Funny guy.

This professor was the worst one I have had in my 2 years at Northeastern. You are graded on 6 tests and 1 final exam. With the limited things to be graded on it does not help that the grading in the class is inconsistent, you could have exactly the same work and answer as a person in the class and receive completely different grades. DON'T TAKE!

reviews.comment: He is literally satan reincarnated. I wanted to unalive myself every single time I stepped out of my dorm because of this class. DO NOT TAKE.

Professor T was very hard to understand in his lectures, and is not clear when answering questions regarding the material. no quizzes, your entire grade is based off 6 exams and a final. calculators weren't allowed on exams, yet he would teach example problems that you needed calculators for. some questions on the exams weren't like what we did in class nor were they like the homework.

reviews.comment: Dimitre seems like a good guy who is pretty funny. It's a lecture heavy class and it is very difficult to understand what he is saying or what he means when he is teaching. But he gives homework which most MATH1251 professors do not give that helps to boost your grade.

Not a good professor. Goes over problems on the board that take up almost the whole class and then says they won't be on the tests. Only graded based on 6 tests that are very hard to do well on. Doesn't provide any resources or extra credit opportunities even though class grades aren't good. Easily distracted and goes over class. AVOID HIM!!!

Overall ok professor. Does go over time but if you take his class go to every lecture if you can and DON'T take the remake tests if you are not able to take the test at the original time. The remake test was way harder than the original test for no reason and only has fewer questions with more weight to the points you can get.
