Prof is good but class is structured terribly.

Weekly 1 hour class barely scratched the surface of what we actually needed to know for the assignments. Highly advise against taking this class unless it's a requirement, you will be spending 1 day every week cooped up inside trying to complete the assignments. There are 2 exams each worth 25% of the grade, so you have no choice but to learn it

Great professor, I just hated the class. Just make sure you do well on the assignments because that really helps, but there's an assignment due every week which took up my whole weekend. There's two exams, I got a 65 on the first exam and still ended up with an A-. The 1st exam was harder than the 2nd.

As a Psych-CJ major taking this course as a requirement, I am so thankful to have had Professor Lieberherr. Though the online portion is less than ideal, Lieberherr makes up for it by giving useful and easily digested information during class. I never thought I'd be able to understand CS in any capacity, but Lieberherr has changed my mind.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I went to Professor Karl's office hour twice. He is extremely willing to help, so if you get stuck by the homework, don't hesitate to ask him.
Class is based mainly on weekly homeworks and one project
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very good

One of my favorite professors at Northeastern. I had him for CS1100, and while my friends who had other professors were complaining, I had nothing to add. The class itself is mostly self-driven, so if you do not like that its an issue with the course, not the professor. Karl was available outside class time to help and is really such a kind person!

All learning is watching online lectures, then review is done in class. Watch them and take notes before class. Be prepared to be called on! Only 1 65 min class a week, but 10+ hours spent outside of class. Prof is quiet unless asked a question, but is very knowledgable and a sweet man if you talk to him! Hated class at first, ended up loving it!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: for the required class for a lot of different majors, prof lieberheerr was good. if something was unclear, he would explain it and make sure you understood. but the class itself required a lot of work outside of the meeting time, but thats with any professor you choose to take it with.

This was the most work i've ever had for a course so far and it was only an 1000 level course. The professor doesn't explain anything. You are expected to teach yourself all the material by watching the online lectures before attending class. Class is once a week. Not nearly enough time to understand any of the material. Don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I took the class twice... the first time was during my very first quarter of graduate school and I dropped it after 2 weeks because it was hopelessly more complex than I could understand.   I took it again during my last quarter and was AMAZED at the depth of information Karl presented.  He remains one of my two best graduate school professors.

The man is an enigma. He has you learn algorithms through the use of a "game", which in theory is a very novel approach. In practice, it's sometimes a little silly (especially when you play by yourself). In class, he's fairly clear and is very receptive to people asking questions. Exams are open note.
The Game is useless and even if you ask exactly what you need to turn in for homeworks, you'll still be missing something. Avoid if possible, but you probably won't be able to.

This class is like starving to death. At first, you try and try to make it through the next day, but eventually, your stomach distends, and you hallucinate the laughing specter of Karl, mocking you, as you cannot even muster up the strength to swat the flies off of your face. You, and your GPA die, just as you came into this world, alone.

The course was Secure Software Engineering. Or, at least, that's what it was called. It turned out to be a course in AspectJ and Demeter - really just him providing a forum for his students' research projects and trying to push AOP on everybody. I am told this is what ALL his classes are.

Brilliant man, wonderful professor. My only complaint is with the course itself, not with Lieberherr. The project was one that he had never done before, and didn't even know how to do himself. Talking to others who took his class, I guess this happens a lot. Surprised to find no Lieb bashers here!

Work hard and you'll learn LOTS. Lieb. is a zen sort of guy, but if you get him talking you immediately pick up on his vast ability and experience. He is willing to help any time, but can be confusing at times. Great class. Do y'self a favor and take it.

I would not recommend this professor for Risk Management. The expectations for assignments and exams were often unclear, which made it difficult to understand what was required to succeed in the course. I think the course could be improved with clearer instructions, better organization, and more consistent communication about expectations.
She's inprofessional and awful try to avoid her class if you can.

Kristen cares about students and makes herself available outside of class. She also uses examples from work and real life. She is not the easiest grader but she is fair and she makes her expectations very clear in class. Students who dislike her are pissed that they can not cruise through class with minimal effort and everything handed to them.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: To much work need to be done in six weeks, don't choose her. She is f terrible and mean, I can't learn anything in her class and everything i do is suffering

Don't be fooled by other reviews—this professor is a nightmare. She's excessively strict, mean, and does whatever she wants, regardless of how impractical it is. Classes are never finished on time and are often kept after class.This is all because she likes to chat and quickly get into the topic of the course without being serious.
A very good professor who will answer students' questions very patiently. Her final exams are given in class, but she will review the exams in week 5.

All assignments are group assignments. Group members were randomly assigned. Easy grader. Professor is friendly and replies to students' texts very fast. There is an in-person final exam before the end of the class, and every week, she will talk about the exam scope. The cell phone is not allowed to use during class. No breaks for her class.
Do not recommend. Lecture heavy, every other word is "umm". Lectures are taken straight from the textbook. Did not learn much.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had taken Risk Management with her. She is exceptionally good with her lectures. All assignments are group assignment and she takes open book final exam. Her assignments really help to understand the subject in a more practical way.
The class was exceptional. She really inspires you and makes you understand everything, she takes the time to make sure each student understands her class. I will definitely take this class again

Kristen is a great professor. She inspires me as a successful woman and a disciplined professor. She gives her best to make students involve in the projects. I am more excited to be in her class which is so far the best class in my grad life.

Top 3 class for CS/CY majors. Kaan is amazing and you'll walk out of the course being actually prepared for security jobs and get a solid understanding of the principles. Homework is actually enjoyable to do if you're interested.
Amazing prof

Cons: There is no fluff in this course, meaning you need to be well equipped to catch up on stuff you haven't really learned in prerequisite courses involving Systems and Databases. Pros: This course teaches you lessons you will apply in both your day to day life and your career. Khan stresses the importance of being thorough and self supporting.

Every professor should take notes from Kaan. All of his lectures are incredibly insightful, and the gamified challenge system makes you WANT to do his homework. Genuinely leagues ahead of any other professor I've had here.
Just a great guy overall. His lectures are very interesting and has a good sense of humor. Challenges are difficult but doable.

I took him in Fall 2024. Thursday night, brutal. The challenges were hard, since it was hard to even know any commands or whatnot. No notes or anything on the two quizzes and midterm, final. You basically had to memorize and understand everything and there was a lot. The bonuses were unsolvable, so don't be praising yourself with any extra credit.

I literally never use RateMyProfessor but it would be criminal not to praise Kaan.
If you are thinking about taking this course, do it. Even if you aren't pursuing a career in security.
Kaan is an expert at making you address your weaknesses in the material without making you feel bad about yourself.
You WILL learn a ton-- challenging but rewarding

The most helpful class I've taken at Northeastern. Kaan's lectures were very helpful and engaging and the topics discussed in class are very interesting and insightful. The coursework can be challenging, however the support from himself and the TAs was incredible.

Kaan's class was extremely rewarding. It is important that lectures are attended as he does give live demos of things that you just can't really get on your own, but it's not graded on whether you go. The challenges he provides are genuinely tough but definitely not impossible especially given the support you can get from him and the TAs.

The best class I've ever taken! I gained a lot from every single session. Also, the teaching style is engaging and fun, and relevant to real life. 
The assignments are definitely challenging. But, if you attend the office hours, Kaan always gives just the right amount of guidance to help you solve it.

Kaan is the kind of professor you actually want to get.  This has been the most valuable class ive taken at northeastern content wise, and kaan does it best.  Each lecture is entertaining and relates directly to assignments.  As long as you go to class you will be fine for the midterm and final.  Challenges can be difficult but very valuable.

Kaan has been the best professor I have had the pleasure listening to at Northeastern. He's incredibly personable but also a master at his craft. This is the one course I can comfortably say is worth the however many thousand dollars each class at Northeastern costs. You will be leaving lecture every week with ACTUAL practical skills. 11/10

Class can definitely be difficult at times but it is so worth it, every challenge is truly a learning opportunity. Kaan cares a lot about student success and you come out of class feeling like a 1337 hacker with all your new knowledge ;)
Probably the best professor most people will have at Northeastern, and easily the most effort any of my professors have put into a class.
Easily one of the best courses all time.

Kaan keeps challenges fresh and engaging. He's very approachable and gives you enough help where you can move past walls in the homework but still feel like you learned something. He helps you learn both technical and problem solving skills very well and rewards high performance.

Kaan is one of the best professors I've had. CY 5770 is tough but incredibly rewarding, especially for those with a good C programming and Linux background. He pushes you to apply concepts creatively and organizes the material brilliantly.

One of the best professors I've ever had. I recommend anyone who has a background in software security to take CY 5770 with Kaan. It was a difficult class, but it's a class I got the most learning out of. He pushes you to be a top-tier problem solver using the material you've learned in class, and organizes the class material extremely well.

One of the most valuable classes I've taken at Northeastern. It was definitely challenging and at times demanding, but the experience was more than worth it. Kaan is one of the best professors I have ever had.

If you have a chance to take a course under Kaan, just go for it. Keep in mind though, you need a certain level of C and Linux knowledge. If you have got the prerequisite knowledge, go for it probably gonna be the best course you have done in your program.

Kaan is the best!!! He is one of the best professors I've ever had. He explains complex cybersecurity concepts in ways that actually make sense, and his lectures are engaging and well organized. The assignments are challenging but fair and help build real-world skills. If you get a chance to take his class, do it!! you won't regret it!

He is truly one of a kind—extremely knowledgable. Classes are fun. I learned a lot about cybersecurity throughout my degree, but I truly understood concepts when Kaan taught it. Some technical challenges he designs are tough but rewarding; builds technical confidence. Kaan gives his absolute best & his dedication to teaching is inspiring.
It's tough enough to make you question choices, but interesting enough not to skip it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The most rewarding class I took at Northeastern. It was super difficult, but once you solved the challenges, it felt so satisfying. Khan put a lot of work into the structure of the class and it just shows. Kahn was a big part of how great this class was set up and I wouldn't have enjoyed the class as I strongly do if he wasn't the professor.

Kaan did a great job at keeping the class engaged, using real world examples to explain the content. He uses his work experience to give us motivation behind the content and activities in class. Kaan also did many in class demos and examples to show us how to complete our CTF's. The coursework was very rewarding, and Kaan was a fair grader.

Easily one of the best classes I have taken at Northeastern. It was definitely difficult and time consuming sometimes, but incredibly rewarding. One of the few classes where I genuinely felt like I learned a lot. Kaan is an incredible professor. He's funny, engaging, and just brings a lot of enthusiasm to class which makes it worthwhile.

I've said this too many of my friends, "Kaan is the best professor I have ever had." I don't think a second of my time taking this course was wasted, "challenges" (hw, CTF style) are super helpful in applying your learning from class (with a little learning left for outside of class). Exams were like 70% understanding hw, and going to lecture.

By far the most engaging lecturer and most fun and educational class I have ever taken at Northeastern. In no other class have I ever felt this challenged and rewarded, Kaan really pushes his students to learn in so many different ways, and I feel so much more confident in all my cybersecurity skills. Super funny guy, just wish he had his beard :(.

Kaan is an incredible professor. If you want to get into security, you have to take this class. He goes over all the fundamentals and is also a engaging professor. The homeworks are hands on CTF-style challenges, while the tests are more conceptual. Overall 10/10 class.

Kaan says he tries to teach everything about security in 4 months, and he really does. He brings years of experiences to the classroom and is passionate, knowledgeable, and invested in the topics of this class and the future of the students taking it. This is easily my favorite class, and I would've regretted not taking it before I graduated.
Kaan is fantastic, it is obvious he cares deeply about the material. The class is tough, but lots of help is available.

Best professor by far. Almost failed just to take again. 
First and only CS class I feel I have learned relevant material in.

Before this class started I really wanted to be the first one to give him a bad review on this site but I literally just cannot do that. Fair play to the guy, he's an amazing teacher and I've never learned more than I have in this class.

Amazing professor -- class is difficult but well worth the effort needed. Would recommend taking even if you are not necessarily interested in security as the course touches many core topics in CS such as networking, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, and more. Challenges are fun and there is lots to learn from them

Had a wonderful experience taking this class as CS major, by far the most I've learned in a NEU course. Couldn't have asked for a more amazing prof - Kaan is patient, inspirational, extremely knowledgeable, caring, and approachable. Lectures (theory, research, and demos) and challenges (hands-on, DIY) complement each other perfectly.
Best course this college

Kaan does what I have not seen before in other professors: keeping a 2-3 hour long lecture engaging, fun, and meaningful. Nearly every lecture is grouped together with a live demonstration of how to apply the concepts covered on the slides. These demonstrations often give pointers on where to start on challenges, giving some starting direction. -44

This class is the best I've taken so far. Kaan is an excellent lecturer who keeps us engaged even during the late sessions that run until 9pm. The challenges are the highlight though - each one is intellectually stimulating and genuinely fun to solve. However, be prepared to spend lots of time on challenges! I can't recommend this class enough. -68

Spent by far the most hours working on his homework out of the 4 classes I took this semester. However this was by far the best and most rewarding hours spent. His challenges/homeworks are always hard but relevant and fun. This class rewards you for your effort, if you take it be ready to give it your all. 
-86
Show up to class. I loved taking this class and doing his challenges. Lots of fun and so much learned. Highly recommend.
Kaan is a very engaging professor for such a boring time slot

If you're unsure about taking this class, take it. Kaan is one of my favorite Professors. He's highly knowledgeable and has years of experience in his field. CS3740 is uniquely structured, with most of your grade based on hands-on CTFs that expose you to real-world online threats. Kaan genuinely enjoys teaching and wants the best for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment:
Kaan's curriculum is awesome. Even as someone who enjoys security and regularly explores advanced topics, I still learned a lot from his class.
Challenges are unique, fair, and engaging. They were by far the most fun homework I've ever done in my life. If you can figure things out and deliver results, you'll have no problem getting an A.

This class was tough and challenges could take quite a bit to complete, but it was very intellectually challenging and Kaan equipped you with all you needed to solve them, given that you put some creativity into it. Very caring professor who wants to see his student succeed, and I'm glad I got to take this course!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kaan's class is certainly the most unique I've ever taken. Incredible teacher who knows his stuff thoroughly and cares deeply for students if you're willing to put in the effort.
Professor covers all important topics and ensures the lectures are interesting. The challenges are fun and tests the understanding of fundamentals thoroughly.

Prof. Onarlioglu's assignments are very fun and effective for learning practical skills. Lectures were well-organized and he was highly knowledgeable in all the content. He was very responsive and made sure support was always available outside of class (even answering questions at 4am). Overall, a funny and amazing professor that I highly recommend
Loved the lectures and the many challenges.

Kaan was the most prepared educator I've ever had. The challenge environment, concepts, and application of these concepts to real world scenarios tied together seamlessly. Have a question at 3am? Kaan's responding immediately. This is not an easy course, but I've gained more knowledge that I can apply to future work than from any other I've taken

I was told this before taking the class, and now I'll point out the same: It's the best class and instructor! I guarantee you will learn a lot. The assignments are challenging, but the feeling of achievement is priceless when you solve them. If you're not sure about your technical background, you better take this class alone just to fully enjoy it.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kaan is an amazing professor. I struggled but I learnt a lot and did things I didn't think I could do. 11/10 would recommend. Everyone needs to take this course under Kaan.

Kaan is a great lecturer and his homeworks are difficult but enjoyable. Also, there is office hours every week and constant support on Piazza so you are not alone at all, you will have plenty of help if you need it. If you have an interest in security at all, take this class, it's the best one I have taken at Northeastern and I have learned a ton.

Kaan is an amazing lecturer. He will keep you engaged with his enthusiasm and the occasional funny slides that pops up. He explains things very well and is very understandable. His course is also very hands-on while also balancing it with theory side. All in all, I really enjoyed this class and I learned a lot from it. Would take again!

Absolutely one of the best profs at Northeastern. Weekly lectures are fast paced and intense, but the material is presented incredibly clearly and Kaan is always willing to slow down for tricky concepts. The CTF-style homeworks are super fun and a great training ground for your technical skills, and the exams are great too! Expect to learn a ton.

Syssec will be the best cybersecurity class you take at Northeastern. Not only is Kaan an amazing lecturer--complete with anime references and top-tier memes littered throughout his slides--but his assignments are second to none. His CTF homeworks are a blast and he and the TAs are always available outside of class for assistance (even at 4am).

One of the best courses I have taken at Northeastern. I learnt so much from this class, and the 3-hour lecture per week goes like a breeze. I always look forward to what is to come next week. The content is hard for someone like me who has no prior exposure to security, but the support to successfully complete the course is impeccable.

Kaan is extremely passionate about the course material and teaching his students. Without a doubt, this was both my favorite class I've taken at Northeastern, measured by my ability to retain focus in and out of class, and most rewarding. The challenges will push your understanding of the course material to the next level, in a gamified fun way.

Interesting, fun and challenging class. As a CS major this was the first security class I enjoyed. Lectures are well planned and entertaining. Homework is time consuming but you gain experience using real world attacks.

Class was very fun and interesting. Homework is hard. Require shell bash scripting, but it is easy to learn. Exams are in person and written. Bonus points available to help with low exam scores. Office hours are extremely helpful. Only recommend this to student that wants a challenge and is confident in their CS knowledge/finesse.

Professor Kaan's lectures are amazing, he provides extra support to understand the concepts. His lectures are super intense and funny at the same time. His classes are worth your time and money :) In short he is the CoOlEsT and BeSt teacher I have ever had!! If you have a chance to take his class, without a doubt TAKE IT!!
Coolest professor you'll ever meet, if you are given the choice to take only one security class in your life, BLINDLY GO FOR THIS CLASS !
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Kaan might be the best professor I've ever had. His subject matter expertise is inspiring, he gives detailed information in lectures, and he cares so much about the topic that he set up his own hacking lab for students to exploit vulnerabilities. This was the most demanding class I've taken at NU; it was well-worth the challenge. Take his class.

Hands down!! The best course I have ever taken in academia. The course structure is brilliant and you will get addicted to challenges(you get to see your number on class rankings website in real-time :) ). Great piazza and one to one support. Extra credits saved the day. The stories/memes are great too. Salute Kaan!

Professor Kaan excels in teaching, crafting real-world-aligned assignments, and fostering accessibility through Piazza. His support and mentorship leave a transformative impact on student's academic journeys. A true beacon of excellence in education. I wish I had taken his class earlier during my master's program.

For a three month course, the structure was perfect to go over a wide variety of system security topics. Anyone even remotely interested in software security should take Kaan's class. His commitment to the course, engaging lectures, availability outside of class hours are second to none. Challenges simulate real world attacks and are super fun!

Kaan is a security guru we all wish we had lol. His teaching style is spot-on, making cybersecurity a breeze. 
The challenges? Intuitively fun! His cutting-edge research and legendary stories are just the icing on the cake!

Kaan is an amazing lecturer, knows his stuff, and cares about students. The lectures teach concepts and a security mindset, while the challenges (homework) are fun and teach practical skills. Grading is straightforward and fair. Kaan made an entire Arch Linux lab environment for this class, which should say enough about how much effort he puts in.

Every student who has the chance to take syssec with Kaan should. Best class I've taken at Northeastern. Homeworks and challenges were fun and addictive. You learn a lot too. Kaan puts a lot of effort and passion into the class, and it shows.

CY3740 was an indispensable course that gave me a well-structured and fundamental understanding of system security. Kaan is funny and entertaining in class and always ready to answer questions for his students. He always finds a way to hold the student's attention. In other classes, I would be distracted, but never in kaan's class.

Kaan is extremely knowledgeable about security and is a very engaging lecturer. Lectures are very informative and the slide decks are great. Challenges are somewhat difficult but definitely a lot of fun.

Kaan is really great. He is knowledgeable, really funny, and is always trying to make himself available. He responds on Piazza fairly quickly and gets grades back usually by the next class. Kaan has no problem being real about his opinions and is always trying to educate on past security issues that we should learn from.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kaan was an admirable professor, not only is he extremely knowledgeable about this field, he wants us to succeed as long as you put in the work. This is a very challenging class in terms of the homework "challenges" that are given to us, but I promise you will have a clear understanding of certain security aspects after this course. 11/10 recommend
He's an amazing professor. He is also one of the best researchers in security, just look up his google scholar. You will learn a lot in this course.

Kaan is an absolute legend, and this course might be the best one I've taken at Northeastern so far. The challenges are somewhat difficult with no prior experience, but he's super responsive online and has office hours after class--if you get stuck somewhere, you aren't left to bang your head against a wall. 10/10, take this class if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was honestly one of the most difficult classes I've taken. I spent a lot of late nights thinking about buffer overflows and cross site scripting. Nonetheless, I found that I've also learned so much from Kaan's class. He's incredibly knowledgeable, charming, and one of the most caring professors I have met. Also he's simply a security wizard.

Kaan is very likely one of the best professors at Northeastern. He's *extremely* skilled and *very* accessible after class. I'd highly recommend taking his class if you have the chance, even if it's at night (don't worry: the class almost never ran more than 2-2.5 hours). The challenges can be difficult; but it is definitely worth the experience.

Extremely effective lectures and assignments. Everything is usable in the real-world and the grading is based on whether you do the assignment or not. No scores, no partial credit. You either did the assignment or you didn't. The professor is super accessible if you need help and will generally respond quite quickly to questions.

A great course with a well-rounded syllabus and amazing lectures. Professor's delivery and explanations ensure that you understand the content from the ground up. The exams and assignments are fun and practically applicable in the real world. I feel better prepared to enter the world of security after this course. Would definitely recommend it!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Incredibly interesting and challenging course.  I really enjoyed this class and I learned a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This is a great class and you will learn a lot, but you need to do the work. There's no way to bullshit the assignments for partial credit, you need to commit to figuring them out start to finish. Lectures cover a lot of in-depth technical material useful for security career. Tons of opportunities for extra credit for those who want it.

Coming from a Game Dev background, I was shown how beautiful security is and absolutely loved every challenge and especially the fact where we having to be self disciplined as there were only 2 deadlines.

Hey Folks, 

So if you are here, That means you are in dilemma to take this course?

I am a student who took this course with the same dilemma and you know what? This is one of the greatest dilemma decisions of my life which yielded astonishing results. Go for it. You will love what you are doing. This is the real world, real challenges. GOAT!
One of the best classes I have ever taken at Northeastern, Cant find anyone better at teaching security than him!

Kaan is easily the best professor I have ever had at Northeastern. Great lectures, great challenges, and very accessible outside of class. I learned more from him and his class than every other class here combined. If you can take CY3740 for CY5770 with him, do it!
Great real-world experience, hugely accessible and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you are remotely interested in Security, take this class. Kaan is a great guy, and the challenges are by far the best part of it all.

This is probably one of the best classes I've ever taken, and Kaan is a major reason for that. If you like solving puzzles/challenges at all, you have to take this class. The homeworks in this class are pretty much "here's what you have to break, here's some hints, go", and they're incredibly fun. Plus, Kaan's always there to help if you get stuck.

CY3740 was one of the most entertaining classes I've ever taken. Kaan lectures on interesting topics and the challenges he creates are awesome. No doubt, Kaan's challenges will make you struggle and feel frustrated, but they are so well crafted that the sense of satisfaction you feel after completion is unlike anything.

Out of all professors I have had at Northeastern University, Kaan has been THE BEST professor. He is extremely knowledgeable and translates complicated topics into understandable lectures. His assignments provide practical experience in exploitation and are also fun/engaging :)
Fantastically designed the class with applicable challenges as hw. Very accessible outside of the class for hw help. 10/10 would take again.
Very interesting and fun challenges

If you have even a remote interest in cybersecurity you need to take this class with him. It's gonna be tough but you'll learn so much along the way and Kaan is a chill guy, so he'll always help you. There really isn't any book that'll teach you this stuff. You'll struggle through the challenges, but the high after solving them is worth it.

He is a great teacher and always ready to help you. The assignments will be tough if you have no previous experience in the Security field but if you ask a question he will guide you through the solutions.

Amazing teacher, really wants to help his students. I really enjoyed his class and found him to be one of the best professors I have had at this school. He makes the subject simple and breaks it down so that everyone can understand.

He's one of those professors whose enthusiasm for a subject wears off on you, and you find yourself excited about something as basic as intro stats. His class is lecture-heavy, but so engaging that time flies by. He's available to discuss anything you might be working on outside of class, and he did so happily (most of the time).
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I had him for INSH 6500 which is Statistical Analysis as an in-person class. I did not have a good experience with him, most of the homework took me anywhere from 3 to 6 hours for a maximum of 5 questions. Also, the projects were not good either. It took me and several other people 5-10 hours per project and we'd get different answers to them.

He is one of the best-balanced professors I've taken. Assignment due dates are clearly communicated. The workload is well-structured and manageable. His video lectures are light. The assignments are clear and well-organized, and he gives detailed instructions along with a grading rubric for all writing assignments. I would take his classes again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Shantanu is a really good prof who cares about you and wants you to do well and will do everything he can to help you get there. His lectures are engaging and is very open to questions. Gives many practice questions for revision and midterms (2) do not contain anything out of practice. HW are usually easy-medium, shout out to TA Dayonara!

Prof Kamarthi genuinely wants you to succeed. He opens day one with that and means it. Logical concept order, great TAs, fun free-form final project. Midterms pull directly from practice problems he flags explicitly, plus grade recovery opportunities. Harder to fail than get an A if you show up, pay attention, and give some genuine effort.
Great
Excellent teacher
This assignment for you is really useful, sometimes the instruction in class he couldn't explain intuitively.

The class sizes are too high to be managed by professor. All the lectures are on PPT including mathematical proofs of algorithms which makes it hard to follow. Professor makes the efforts to make everything easy for students.
Lectures are interesting at start of the the semester. Eventually gets bored.
He is good and respects your work.
Excellent teaching and provides multiple ways of solution to easyily understand.
Great educator, remarkable experience. Arabic coaching on point. Business teaching not too great. Chinese classes are exceptional.
Really good professor he knows his information really well, I would recommend anyone to attend his classes. Classes are well structured and interesting.
Lectures are very long and boring

Took his class last semester. Doesn't teach anything. A 9$ Udemy course thought me more than his class. He is a nice person but not a great professor. I hope he takes into account his bad reviews and teaches better.

Very systematic course and Kamarthi teaches it that way. Goes through a cycle of concepts, introduction of equations, practice problems, homework assignments based on concepts learned in class. Kamarthi is a very good professor. A bit dry at times but that could be because material is also dry. Would recommend.
He cares about his material and students. He is knowledgeable.

Moody and unorganized. Grading has no consistency. If he likes you it will help. Doesn't cover material well. Dives into detail on stuff he knows well but barely skims over stuff he hasn't spent time to learn. Very little passion for teaching.

Most boring professor I ever had in my life. Lectures are painfully boring, he has no motivation and zero passion for the subject. Crazy amounts of work and very useless guy in terms of preparation for homework. Avoid at all costs.
Mr. Kamarthi was thorough in his preparation for the classes, he graded fairly and he encouraged student participation.
Top professor at NEU

Horrible. I worked in manuf. on co-op before this class, and i was excited to get into some more details. But his lack of communication and poor teaching left me stunned. Stay away from this class if you can. Who gives students a packet of computer code 20 minutes before class is over and says "learn this for tomorrow's midterm"? Way to 'teach' us.

Prof Kamarthi was a really nice guy. But the student (IE's) treated him like crap, they complained about everthing. The Tests were straight out of the problems sets he would go over in class and post solutions to on blackboard. What more could you ask for. Course was not what i expected from description but i did Enjoy the lab. Really nice guy!
Very good professor, Knows the subject and has descent personality. I would love to take a course with him again.
Good preparation for the stuff that he teaches...and not too bad homework too. I'd say he is too decent a teacher to be true.

Professor Loredana is genuinely an amazing professor. I wish she offered more classes because I would stay in college to take her courses. She doesn't just give busy work, she really wants her students to gain knowledge and come out of the course with new skills.  Take her courses if you have the choice.

Genuinely the best Professor I have had at Northeastern so far. Her teaching style is unique, engaging, and informative. For the semester long group project we chose groups and created podcasts on industries we were passionate about. This project taught us how to create a business in a new and unconventional way that was fun and educational.

Best professor I have had at NEU so far, not your typical professor. At first, very intimidating to weed people out. Show up with positive attitude and participate as much as you can. Do the mandatory readings before class and take notes prior. Learned so much from her and she builds a community within the classroom. Will forever remember her!

She does NOT create a welcoming environment, she will berate you and nit pick what you said. She also boasts a lot about her personal achievements, like how she has a wait list for registration. Yes it gets better as you get to know her, but it doesn't worth it. I was also not the only one who felt this way, she annihilated our entire section

One of the best professors I've ever had. She creates an inclusive, collaborative environment where students feel encouraged to take risks and challenge themselves. Her lectures, assignments, and course content are innovative and engaging. She's deeply passionate about her students as well. I truly can't recommend her enough. Best professor!
Great professor and I highly recommend her class. You will learn more from this class than any other professor at Northeastern.

She is the best teacher I have ever had in my life. This is the second course I've taken with her. She genuinely wants everyone to succeed - not just in the class but in life. She goes above and beyond with everything she does for her students. You will learn so much from her that you will use the rest of your life. BEST TEACHER EVER.

Easily the BEST professor I've ever had. If you have the chance to take her class, do it. She creates a welcoming, inclusive class environment where everyone feels comfortable participating, and you genuinely look forward to going to class. You will learn so much from the class. Take her. You won't regret it.
Participate, listen, and put in effort. Amazing professor and I would easily take her again. I recommend to anyone who's interested in AI, entrepreneurship, and innovation. Extremely engaging.

Professor Padurean creates an environment for students to be collaborative and bounce ideas off one another. Her teaching method is unorthodox, but by far the most consequential I've experienced. I haven't learned more about what it takes to succeed in the world of business in any other class. Professor is an amazing teacher and even better person.

Professor Padurean is an excellent professor who delivers deeply engaging and interesting lectures. She is more than just a teacher; she has the unique ability to captivate her class with interesting and relevant stories that spark interest in almost anyone interested in business and entrepreneurship. Highly recommend.

The best professor. Class is engaging, effective & relevant to real life. She is inspiring, knowledgable & sees students as individuals. Class is interactive, discussion-based, and captivating. Innovative & embraces AI. Impactful for me as a student & person. Always helpful with her class and anything else. If you can take her do not hesitate!

She is one of the best professors I've ever had! She challenges her students to be better and is full of knowledge. I learned so much in her class. Definitely take her! Yes, you'll need to put in effort, but believe me — the class is totally worth it.

She is absolutely amazing! You either love her or hate her-I  loved her. For the first few classes she will be tough, but she becomes warmer over time. She does this to weed people out which, honestly gives a great batch of classmates to work with. Participation matters! It's a big part of your grade so be sure to participate and do projects well.

I really enjoyed this course with Loredana. She is very passionate about Innovation and how products have been innovated over time. She has a lot of wisdom and gives wonderful life advice. She has a lot of stories to tell which makes the class very memorable. Even though she might be intimidating at first, she becomes warmer overtime.

Hands down one of my favorite professors I've had the opportunity to take a course with. You get what you put in, and it's very hard not to be engaging in class. Lectures are conversation-based, so participation matters a lot. She can be more strict in the beginning of the semester, but she will lighten up and I guarantee you will enjoy class!

The best professor I will have taken at Northeastern, intellectually stimulating and impactful. Such a fan of this class and how Padurean approaches it that I could get an F and still recommend her forever. Class was discussion-style based on HBS readings with one large group project. The value in taking her  is out of this world, seriously

Professor Loredana is incredible. With engaging and inspiring class discussions, I have learnt and benefited a lot from taking her class. For future students please focus on reading the HBR articles rather than the slide shows. Class is great and fun to be a part of, also is intellectually stimulating!
Incredibly engaging and interesting to learn from. overall my best professor this semester.

You're either going to love her or hate her, and I loved her. Towards the beginning she is harsh if you are late to class, however once you warm up to her she is the coolest Professor you will know. I didn't even get an A in the class, but I would take her again. She is inspirational and truly has some funny stories if you get to know them. 10/10

This class is one of the most intellectually stimulating classes. Beware that participation in class matters the most. Through the group projects you will learn a lot. She will make you work for your grade and is one of the best professors you will get at Northeastern. Never be late to her class!

Professor Padurean is one of my overall favorite professors in the business program. The class is not for you if you don't want to put in the work, but if you are willing to it's amazing. Participation and group work are super important. Class is super engaging and definitely one of my favorites. It's tough, but totally worth it.

Great teacher who cares about students. She creates a community and if you are willing to put in the work then you will succeed. She believes that no one can force you to be an entrepreneur but you have to crave it. Care about the class and see will notice and be happy. She also has fun fashion and style!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: An amazing professor if you're willing to put the effort in. She's always willing to help students outside of class and gives the best lectures. I took this class early in the morning and it made waking up early feel worth it. Definetly take this professor if you have the oppurtunity.

Very knowledgeable about entrepreneurship, and her excitement for the course rubs off on everyone. Group project-based, so make sure to pick a good group. Really enjoyed working with my group. Everything you learn in class is applicable in life. Highly recommend taking her class.

I took Innovation 2301 with Professor Padurean. One of my favorite classes I've had. Her energetic personality makes class engaging and fun. She teaches you important life lessons that will help you throughout your life. I loved how she related material to personal and real-world experiences.

Professor Padurean is a wonderful professor. Her class is discussion based and be ready to participate. The stories and lessons she tells are very entertaining and interesting and make the class fun. Lots of group projects so make she to pick your group wisely at the beginning. She gives great feedback and wants you to do well. Highly recommend.

She is an amazing professor. If you participate, engage, and give good contributions to the class, you will be good. She gives great feedback on group projects and really wants you to grow. She said the first day of class how her goal is to build a community, and she did! Her classroom is a safe and encouraging community!

Best professor I have ever had in my entire life! If you are able to get into any of her classes, take it! She teaches the material in such an engaging way! The class discussions are amazing and I would look forward to her class. She has changed my life for the best and I highly highly recommend her!
She's a really good professor, just make an effort to participate and show up to class as the exam is easy if you actually do readings and listen to what id going on.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Loredana is my favorite professor. She has a fun and unique personality that makes class exciting. She is very intimidating at first, but warms up throughout the semester as she gets to know you and the class. She is very swiss with time, so if you show up even one minute late she will call you out. Your grade is based on participation!
I took Innovation! with Professor Padurean and I loved it!! She's a fair grader and provides applicable feedback for professional development.
She made hard concepts feel very understandable and her class was equally as hard as the other teachers. I highly recommend her for this course!

Honestly my favorite class. Her lectures make material easy to understand and always has good explanations to tricky concepts. She has worksheets for each chapter that you work on as a class. Workload is super manageable with easy weekly homework. If you attend lectures you won't need to read the textbook. Tests are easy and the class is chill.
It was the best class at northeastern that I have ever taken. Exams are very easy if you study well. Gives good feedback, replies to email in seconds. Perfect professor at NEU.

Good overall, but the lectures can be kind of confusing. Shes caring and understanding, easy to reach. Although attendance is not mandatory, if you don't go to class youll get pretty lost. Organized and clear instructions/grading.

reviews.comment: Never responded to my email and was late to her office hours. She can be nice, but can also be a bit passive-aggressive at times

You can tell by her lectures that she took time and effort in preparing, in hopes of making the material easy to understand. Though attendance is not mandatory, going to class, paying attention, completing the required homework, and putting in time to understand the material will help you succeed in the course.

I think she's a good professor, but she teaches like we are in middle school and it gets very frustrating. It is hard to focus in her class because she tends to describe things in a way that is way more complex than needed. She is really nice and caring outside of class and answers emails fast.

reviews.comment: Great professor, grades super fairly
Dr. M is kind, funny, and most importantly, knows her stuff.  I have learned so much, and I really appreciate her commitment!
My love for bio was extinguished after taking her class and I blame her.
Terrible experience. I dreaded going to class. Depressed every day.

Dr. M is the best! She's so kind and funny, and I thought she did a great job leading this course. I don't know how I would've felt if I had taken this a year ago, but I thought she was a great fit for me.
Dr. M is the best professor at Northeastern! She's like the fairy godmother of science: caring, kind, and always there for you. Don't believe the haters.
Dr. M is the best professor at Northeastern. Amazing 11/10.

I absolutely loved Dr. M for Bio Project Lab, she was incredibly helpful and clearly wanted everyone to do as well as possible! Sometimes the classes did drag on, but I blame that on the length of the classes and not necessarily her.
Did not learn much
Did not give consistent grading feedback across projects, graded either extra hard or extra easy depending on the assignment
Arbitrary grading scheme and feedback

Dr. M is an amazing professor! She is so sweet and caring for her students. She is so helpful and always available outside of class. If you put in the work the class is fairly easy. I highly recommend Dr. M

Overall, I would never take a class with him again. All he grades is homework, quizzes, and exams, with no study guides for the exams. When people were struggling, he said, "just do the work" and "watch my videos." When everyone was failing the exams, he wouldn't give us any extra credit besides attendance on random days near the end of the course.

reviews.comment: Try not to take his if you're not SMART smart. Exams and Quizzes were hard af at the start but he gave lotta compensating extra credits towards the end.

Homework problems were harder than the quizzes or exams. Half the exam questions are the same as the practice he gives. If half the class stops showing up to class, he'll randomly give extra credit for showing up. Really nice but hard to learn in his class since he seems confused about what he's teaching sometimes, better off self-studying.

Great professor who makes O-Chem manageable. I studied the day of most exams and still did well. He's kind, gives extra credit, tons of practice, and note cards on exams. Tests and quizzes EXACTLY match practice exams given. Very helpful and approachable, willing to talk research as well. highly recommend over other any other neu ochem professors!!
If you're struggling in his class it's genuinely because you aren't trying hard enough. It's orgo. Do better.
SO unhelpful. Genuinely just teaches to keep his lab at neu.

Do not take orgo with him. You will not learn anything unless you spend hours teaching yourself. Exams are impossible, with 4 25 MCQ exams determining your entire grade. Many many people dropped his class the semester I took it. When I asked him for help or to see if I should drop, he asked if I was pre-med and when I said yes, he laughed.
DO NOT TAKE ORGO WITH LOPEZ IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR GRADES!

Take anyone else. Average on one of our quizzes was a 54%. Everyone seemed like they were in survival mode. Everything after ch.5 is completely self taught, and everything significantly increases in difficulty. No one should be relying on a curve to save their grade/gpa. Cool guy, but save yourself. Take Matthews or Danahy.

reviews.comment: i dropped this class and am retaking it with jude matthews, best decision ever. it seems like professor lopez has gotten worse since i last had him, which was already quite bad. i can't wait to take my orgo final where i now have the confidence + knowledge to ace it. i highly recommend you all to get a different professor, do not rely on the curve!

I can only say that taking his class is worse than self-study, becausestart from chapter 6 is all recored class, we watched his vedio recored  and answered questions freely in class, Our average score on exam2 was 96 /150, as you can imagine. You need to do a lot of pre-study work to keep up with his courses.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM IF YOU WANT TO LIVE IN PEACE. The entire grade is based on quizzes and exams. The grading doesn't help the students score better as every MCQ is 6 points. The FLIPPED classroom in the latter part of the semester will eat 2 hours before every class and he would expect you to understand everything to solve questions in class.

DO NOT TAKE ORGO WITH HIM. I am currently in Orgo 2, and according to my current professor, he failed to teach us the most important chapter for Orgo 2, meaning I now have to spend extra time learning what I should already know (Chapter 11). Also, do not rely on the curve, it doesn't help anything.

One thing I really appreciated about Prof. Lopez is that he was always willing to take feedback. He changed things up (test dates, etc) based on student feedback. He started giving quizzes with partial credit when he got a TA so that the overall grade wasn't dependent on just four tests. Go to his office hours for the types of questions he asks!!

Great man, kind, cares about his students, and always willing to help clear up misconceptions. HOWEVER, the TA for this class when I took it seemed to take joy in taking off points on quizzes, so just be very careful with everything you write. Be aware this class features a flipped classroom setup later in the year (just google it)

Prof. Lopez knows what he's talking about. We fell behind schedule about halfway through the semester, so the last few units felt rushed, but overall he taught the material pretty clearly. If you pay attention in class, you'll be fine. He also gives a VERY generous curve at the end of the course, which helps a lot. Tests were all multiple choice.

Professor Lopez is a nice person, but you would want to consider other professors first before taking his course. His lectures don't really make sense and his exams are nothing like what he covers in class. Your grade is based mainly on your four exam grades. Do not bank on the curve at the end of the semester, it's not worth it.
get a different teacher for orgo !!

He tries his best but confusingly presents information. I strongly recommend you attend office hours and email him with any questions. He will work with you if you show you want to do well. Tests are worth a lot so they will take a lot of effort.

Orgo 1 is definitely a challenging class in general . He is pretty lecture heavy but is very conscientious of his students and course corrects when necessary. he always curves exams and is very accessible through email and online. adds a significant curve at the end of the year to bring class avg to a B. Overall pretty good professor.

Maybe this semester was not his semester, but it was rough. He did not keep up with the syllabus and made LOTS of changes with exams. He was extremely behind compared to other sections and would rush through lectures. Exams had about 30 questions, worth 200 points. You're better off choosing Fulton, at least there is more organization there.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A good curve is given at the end of the class. Your grade is basically dependent on 4 exams so you have to make sure you study hard and attend lectures. He is always willing to help students outside of class during office hours so make sure you take advantage of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very smart, knows the material well and takes time to answer students questions, but each exam is worth 20% of your grade and are significantly harder than other orgo sections. lectures also move very fast and it is very easy to fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Disorganized and unhelpful lectures

Clear syllabus from the start, sticks to four tests and a bit of homework for grades. Fair grader and goes over the exam after testing. He's overall a really nice dude and actually cares about his students. Orgo is a hard class, but because of the homework/practice questions he gives, the tests are less scary and he offers a nice curve at the end

reviews.comment: Lopez is great but moves really fast in lecture. He drops your lowest test and homework score and is super helpful in office hours. Reading before class can help you stay up with lecture content.

Prof Lopez really cares about his student. He is willing to listen and compromise and he wants everybody to feel the class is fair. At the start of the semester I was unsure because his test were a little unfair. He course corrected and acknowledged how students felt. He's such a great guy and LOVES orgo will take as many questions as needed!

Sometimes professor Lopez can be a little hard to understand but he is an incredibly smart individual. His lectures are really heavy and dense but he takes a lot of time out of class to host meetings for recitation and office hours in order to help.

I would pay to have a different professor for this class. One of those teachers that says something once and never reiterates. God forbid you ask a question because he will either say "I've said this" or give some snarky, condescending comment. His tests are harder than the other ORGO classes & it almost feels like he wants you to fail...
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Larson is a phenomenal ORGB professor. Although the content is a bit boring, she truly does care about her students and makes her lectures engaging. The exams are all short answer but you get a one page cheat sheet that helps. Out of all the ORGB profs, she is probably the best choice!

Passionate about teaching and knows her material very well, but is a very tough grader. Class is usually engaging, but ~23% of grade comes from participation, so be on your game from day one. reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Are you actually kidding me? The last couple of posts from Nov 21st are all fake!! Its literally Proffesor Piatt making these posts to boost her rating. Everything she said in those posts are stuff she says in class, but the self-glaze is crazy! Read the other posts and you will get a better understanding!
