reviews.comment: i enjoyed going to this class a lot! very straight forward expectations and fairly interesting lectures. we had weekly-ish homework assignments that were graded on completion and a final presentation on any law related topic of your choice and no exams
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She absolutely clocked the class on cheating yesterday and it was iconic #puttingherfootdown. 10/10 experience watching everyone who cheats panic, and she didn't stutter ONCE, ate and left no crumbs. A&P is hard so you have to study, but she at least makes it clear what to know. I rather get an 85% with studying then with cheating.

I loved her. I took her for both A&P 1 and 2 with her and she was great for both. All of the info you need is on the slides and if you actually study its an easy A. The labs also weren't as bad as everyone made it seem, I would study the day before and went to office hours one a week and got an A on every quiz/exam.

I sat in this class wondering if I would live to see the end of it. It's like sitting through a presentation that was prepared the night before. On the bright side, I had time to do the crossword 3x a week.

Genuinely seems like she doesn't know what she's talking about. She just reads off the slides and only chooses to answer questions that are on the slides. She gives many tests that are just so conceptual and not straightforward, so prepare to study a lot. It's only difficult because she struggles to teach in an effective manner. It's ridiculous...

All the bad ratings are for the lab which she has nothing to do with! This class is super easy the exams are right from the slides and theres plenty of ways to get participation credit (including ways outside of class). She's great, the lab is hell

Honestly she's like fine ig she's just a big pushover and everyone used chat on her exams cause they're all online and she doesn't have proctors which was annoying. Also her lectures are basically just reading off the slides w/ some small additions so don't really need to go to class tbh. Participation activities were kind of just checking a box
Lectures are decent and exams are fair, nothing really special about her teaching but I dont think its as horrible as everyone says it is.

Her low rating is unfair. She's VERY straight forward & intelligent, its clear what you need to know, very willing to clarify what will be on exams. Exams are all MCQ, you need to put in effort as A&P itself is very difficult, but people take their frustration out on her by low ratings. 100% recommend taking her class she is amazing. #queenpeacock

I don't get why her rating is so low. She's organized and makes it clear what you need to know, offering reviews and clarifying what lectures will be on exams. All exams are MC, and you're given plenty of time to finish. A&P itself can be very difficult, and people take their frustration out on her by low ratings. 100% recommend taking her class.

True honesty, I think she gets a bad rep and she's overhated. Peacock is organized and clear on how she grades, and she gives so many resources to help study: lecture videos, free textbook, weekly, short, open note take-home quizzes, etc. I understand how the course in itself can be difficult once you find a study method it'll be worth it.

Honestly think she gets a bad rep but she's not that awful. As long as you make sure to stay on top of participation that will help boost your grade. Course had 4 midterm exams throughout the semester that were each 50 MCQ. Each midterm usually covered around 5 lecture topics, so usually studying a few days in advance would help.
I think she's being unfairly rated here. The exams are based solely on the lectures, and as long as you follow along, you'd be fine for the exams. It's very lecture-heavy, so be prepared to study.

I've really enjoyed Dr. Peacock and her course! You do have to do participation activities every week, but they're easy to do. Lectures are fairly easy to follow and she truly wants people to understand. Exams are mainly application, but its MCQ and she does review sessions the class before an exam. As long as you put in effort you'll be fine!

honestly a fair professor, exams are usually straight forward. A&P is a hard class which in general requires a lot of studying so if you put the work in its fine. my only thing is that sometimes she doesnt super clearly explain things, but she keeps a poll everywhere open so you can ask questions which i like.

Overall, your going to find yourself studying to survive, not to actually learn and retain the information which sucks. Tests are made to trick you, not for you to succeed. At first, it bothered me that students would cheat in order to pass her tests, and although I still believe it's wrong and wouldn't do it myself, I understood why.

Her slides makes it really easy to understand and is much better than the other professor, she makes the slides simple while the other professor copies off the online textbook and doesn't explain as clear as Professor Peacock. Take her class instead of the other professor

I loved this class and I loved having her as a professor. I don't know if she changed her style or the course but after having her for both 1 and 2 I think she's a great professor. Exams are straight forward and she gives you practice before each one including the final. If you actually study and put in the effort it's actually pretty easy

Idk why everyone hates her but she's great. I had her for both a&p 1+2. Her lectures are clear and straightforward and the exam was exactly her lectures. She provided a practice exam for every one on topics that students have the most trouble on. If you actually study it's really easy. I loved her class and truly didn't think it was bad at all

i don't think professor peacock's low rating is fair. as long as you pay attention to lectures, it is easy to do well. i never saw an exam Q that i had no clue how to answer. she gives a lot of options to do well (exams, participation, quizzes, etc). she was accommodating when i had to reschedule an exam for an emergency. highly recommend her.

While Professor Peacock is not the best professor I've ever had, she is certainly not the worst, and I think her rating on here is completely unfair. The course is hard, but I don't think her exams are unfair - all of the material you need to know is in her slides.

I dont think Dr. Peacock deserves the hate she gets. Class participation is required 2x per week. Exams are pretty difficult and more complex than the slides, but if you study its fine. People rating her badly are freshmen who have never taken a college class before. It's as difficult as any other STEM class. Don't be scared by her reviews.

Professor Peacock is a great professor! It is very doable to get an A in this class. Everyone who gave her a 1 or 2, did not try enough. In class she said PEOPLE SHOULD PUT IN EXTRA TIME FOR THIS CLASS. If you studied each lecture, meaning you did not just memorize, then you should be able to get an A in this class. I would take this class again!

The slides, which she reads straight off of, are too simple to make a student gain the complex knowledge required for her tests. I recommend skipping class and going through the slides slowly and chatgpt concepts that are unclear (which is most of it). Lectures feel like watching a teenager that prepared for the presentation the night before.

Dr. Peacock really just is too nervous to teach in a college setting. She seems to be very timid when she is teaching, causing her to just read from the slides in a monotone voice while never explaining any definitions. A free online textbook is provided but doesn't provide any help at all and isn't used.

Overall, Dr. Peacock is a good professor. Her tests were hard but doable & it helped to rewatch lectures and note-take on each lecture. Exams are weighted heavily but there is an opportunity for corrections and she factors in participation. FYI Lab is a different animal & somehow harder than the lecture course! I spent more time studying for lab...

lectures aren't the best; they provide the material but exams sometimes don't correlate and it seems like questions are purposely trying to trick you rather than test your understanding. reads straight off the slides even when answering questions. explains concepts in a very convoluted way. i think she is a good person, but not a good professor.

Peacock is the worst professor I've ever had. She doesn't communicate with students and either takes days to reply or doesn't respond at all. What we study in class is never reflected on the exams, making it difficult to prepare and succeed.

Dr. Peacock is a great professor and I think she explains the content really well and is super organized with the way she structures her class. It's anatomy so it's supposed to be hard but if you put in the time to memorizing you will do well. I think a lot of the complaints here come from the lab (which another professor runs...).

The real problem with A and P is the lab. This lab is the worst thing conjured from the depths of hell. The class so far is much easier. In the first month, you will have to memorize every part of every bone and muscle for humans AND rats. It's like learning a new language and the expectation is you become fluent within a month.

As a third year bio student, I think that these reviews are because this is a class that mostly first year nursing students take. Adjusting to college is HARD and I mean no hate at all- class felt impossible at first. But if you take time to figure out what study methods work for you, doing well in this class won't be a problem.

Overall, Dr. Peacock is a good professor. Her rating is unfounded on here. Taking A&P 2 with her over the summer wasn't really a challenge, as the material on the tests aligned well with the content taught in class. Engagement is key to performing well, and she makes expectations clear for content on the exams. Would take another class with her!

This class is definitely manageable. There are 4 non-cumulative tests, all multiple choice and you have plenty of time to answer the questions. My advice is too make sure you focus on the content on the slides. Be familiar with definitions and make sure that you really understand more complicated topics by searching supplemental content on youtube.

Took over summer 1, very easy class. Look over slides, exams all multiple choice, final is non cumulative. No homework besides weekly multiple choice quizzes with 3 attempts. Gives very few extra credit points. Memorize as much from the slides, not textbook.

Prof. Peacock seemed to be very knowledgeable but she mainly reads off the slides in addition to adding a ton of information quickly. she treats you like her children. fair on grading. you just have to practice the materials for 30-50 mins per day and you will be get an A. easy adn fun class. you get to meditate as well.

He is so scattered, that he becomes confusing ! the Final was really long took all of the two hours, DONT TAKE !!! if you need step by step process.

I LOVED him! I had him for Stats and he made it fun and easy. Used real life psych examples which helped to see its real world applications. Answers questions well and will discuss test results if you ask. TAKE HIM! Also an advisor so he is a good man to know. Laid back and easy going. Makes sure you know the material before the test. LOVED him!

This guy is hilarious. He will make awkward comments during class that just makes everyone laugh. The homework load isn't terrible, you only have an assignment the week of any of the quizzes. All of the quizzes are the same format, so it's never really a surprise. Quinn is great at teaching, and I learned quite a bit. Good class!
I know a lot of people like him, and he is a nice enough guy, but personally his teaching style is really not for me and coming to this class was painful.
HOT AS HELL
He is a really great person and a pretty good professor.  I did well in Stats but I have heard he is one of the most difficult.  For an easy A, get some one else.

If you have any high school mathematical background, this class is fluff.  I had to take it depsite my AP stat credit (counts for everything BUT stat for psych).  But despite the fact that I knew everything already, I still enjoyed the class, cause prof Qu
great guy
Great great great teacher. A little absentminded, but very helpful and very throrough and clear. Fair tests and fair grader... take his class!

Requried for Psyc majors.  I had taken Stat courses before so it was fairly easy for me but it's not an easy class for those who aren't familiar with statistics.  He does a pretty good job of breaking it down though.  Typical crazy math professor
Slightly scatterbrained at points, but he knows the material and knows how to break it down for math illiterates like me.  The tests are pretty difficult, but manageable if you study.
I think Quinn is great-he has that psychology professor hair...his tests are tough-but he explains everything very well.
Very helpfull, really makes the effort to help everyone A+A+A+A+A+A+A+

The material is tricky, but he made it pretty clear and less intimidating. He's always willing to help, and overall he's a pretty cool guy. Everything on the tests he went over in class- no surprises.
He's a little bit tough for a stats prof...but i slacked off
Very cool guy, easy class.
Best NEU Professor, I never write reviews but this man deserves a 5!

He is awesome. No exams, just a few case studies and a final presentation. Lots of extra credit assignments. If you read the case and prepare for those discussion questions, you will be fine. I really enjoy his class and sometimes he will bring some snacks to share with us.
Great alsome professor I have ever had!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Best professor at NEU over the past five years!
One of the best professors here, very caring about students and their careers!
Best professor at Northeastern.
Obliterates your grade without telling you anything if you don't go to class.

By far the best professor at Northeastern. Such a caring, passionate, and funny professor who made me, a spring semester senior, want to come to every class. He offers so many extra credit opportunities and has the class vote to amend the syllabus in the beginning of the semester to make his policies even more fair.

Great professor, one of my favorites of all time. Replies to emails fast, is super attentive, and is always willing to help. Solid feedback. Let's students make decisions (eg: we voted as a class to not have to read the textbook). Short papers are straightforward, and the final essay is simple. Very smart guy who makes you want to learn. 11/10 prof
One of the best at NEU!
THE Best NEU professor that I have taken class from - humorous, accommodating, and inspiring. I came to class not only to fulfill attendance requirements, but simply wanted to.
The best professor at NEU, humorous and caring. Glad I took his class!
Very respectful, kind, and accommodating. Best of all NEU profs.
Very good profession, so fair and caring of students, and very accommodating as well.
Wonderful professor, IMO.

Very humorous professor. I also read all the comments and was surprised to see negative sentiments. I am sorry for them but I agree with the majority. This professor is wonderful. If you come to class and don't miss too much, you will get a good grade.
Very encouraging and caring professor!
Extremely accommodating!!!! Very fair and caring about his students. Great person.
Wonderful professor. Very fair, caring, and helpful.

Didn't use text book, no exams, but heavy reading, and participation in class is mandatory. Participation is 20% of the Final grade, he can give what every grade he want due to your behavior in class, crazy
Didn't have a clear grading criteria, don't know why Final essay is graded so tough. Beside that, a nice man with humor in class, but didn't learn much in his course

I thought I'm going to get an A until he gives the final grade, never seen any Prof ever give a 6 out of 20 in a Presentation. Not a fair grade and not a fair professor, don't come, or you will regret at last

I was deceived into attending his class by his previous 5 rating. The course read a lot, discussion based, and the class was relatively easy. However, the professor appeared to be friendly, but in fact, he would stab student in the back at the end of the term by giving terrible grade. Not a good man

Awful! On the surface and with a friendly demeanor, but behind the scenes with a narrow mind, he will remember every class you missed and give you a 0. Extremely low score on group presentation and won't warn you or telling you the reason. I never seen such a professor in all these years in the United States

Discussion heavy class. Speak less and absent willl result in extremely low grade on 20% of participation. One of my classmate failed for it. Tough grader, grade everthing at the end. If you cannot guarantee that you will be fully engaged in discussions and attend every class, then it is best not to be fooled by his humor and friendly in class.

I've never felt strongly enough about a professor to leave a review on here, but Professor Qiao is the real deal. He makes an effort to connect with his students and was incredibly accommodating throughout the semester. His lectures are engaging and he's incredibly knowledgeable. If you have the opportunity to take his class, you absolutely should.
Professor Kunyuan Q is an amazing professor, and I very much enjoyed his lectures and in-class interactions. He is brilliant and I just want to say he is wonderful.
Prof Qiao is very knowledgeable, fun, and caring!! He is my favorite professor and his lectures are so interesting :-)

Prof. Kunyuan Qiao is a very, very great professor - he cared so much about his students, knowing where we are from and designed very fun lectures and classroom interactions. I missed his class and should have done a better job!

Professor Kunyuan Qiao is the sweetest and nicest professor I have ever met!!! He cared so much about students and made lectures and class discussions fun and very easy to follow (although his questions are often intellectually challenging). I very much enjoyed his class and his cooking was amazing (the potato bread haha!).

Professor Qiao had very interesting lectures, which were organized by his RAPPORT framework and we did develop rapport ourselves! Very nice, accommodating, and caring professor. Would take his class again!

Professor Kunyuan Qiao is my favorite throughout my years at Northeastern. He cared so much about his students, bringing foods and even cooking for us! His lectures were more than fun and I very much enjoyed the class. I even expected to see him for the class. I was so luck to have selected his course!
Professor Qiao is my favorite professor at Northeastern University - he cares so much about students and is so accommodating. I am very lucky to have selected his class!

Professor Qiao is THE best professor at Northeastern University based on my experience. His lectures were so fun and most of us enjoyed. He was also so caring and made the class very inclusive. Would recommend to others!!!!
The best professor I have had at NEU. Extremely nice and informative.

All the other comments and more. inconsistent material, discouraging, tests too much to measure knowledge accurately with materials being displaced/disorganized, unites everyone by how afraid she makes people feel to ask Qs and then criticizes when we don't.

Though she is knowledgeable on the subject, her exams often consist of questions from content never covered. The slide materials used are not organized and often displaced. I felt scared even speaking up about my questions out of fear that they'd be criticized and shut down. Be cautious and put in an unjustifiable amount of extra work to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Throughout all of my academic career, I have come accross professors who had varying styles, teaching methods and the like but seldom do I come accross a professor who truly is this difficult to deal with, extinguishes the student's natural curiosity, refuses to take accountability, and uses a grading criteria that leaves the student helpless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Robinson-Wood is a great lecturer who cares about her students. The only critique I have is that she is a tough grader. I found the tests to be incongruent with the course material. Overall, I enjoyed her class and learned a lot.
Nice guy but not the best at teaching. He spends way too much time talking about stuff unrelated to the course content

Easily the most well-organized online resources of any Khoury class, and most caring prof. as well. This guy genuinely loves what he does, and it shows in his lectures, in&out of class interactions with students, and how accessible he is. It also seems he's been factoring in student feedback and adjusting the course. Thank you prof venkat🙏.

Prof. Raj is just an all-around nice guy, cares about his students, and is passionate about his work. Prior reviews show that his class used to be different, but as he mentioned in our final class, he heavily values student feedback, and it is evident that things are different now. Be sure to get started on the HWs early and attend his lectures.

Professor Venkat has, by far, the best online resources of any course I've taken. Also very interactive lectures where he really wants students to participate and ask questions. You can schedule 1-1 with him even outside of office hours. He offers 2 pathways for the final so you can choose what fits your learning style. Best professor at Khoury.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Raj was hands down one of my favorite professors I've had at Northeastern. He is very knowledgable and clearly passionate about his work. He takes the time to clearly explain and walk students through lectures, and wont hesitate to put the lecture on hold to clarify things.

I really really enjoyed the class and lecture. Prof. Venkat is so nice and really makes you think in lecture but you have to pay 100% attention to really learn. His homeworks aren't terrible but they're quite confusing, he also has a pretty tough grading policy so you will need to go to office hours a lot to make sure you're on the right track.
Loved this guy, really cared about people learning very entertaining lectures. Harsh on deadlines but homeworks weren't too hard.

Took it over the summer and really enjoyed it! Professor is very knowledgeable and fun to talk to. Assignments are straightforward, Final Group Project is a lot of work, no exams, TAs & OH are very helpful. He has well-written notes on all the topics, and even though attendance isn't mandated, please go to class! It's very enjoyable : )
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took this class during the summer and it went really well. We only had 3 assignments and one group project which is reasonable for summer semester. Lectures are pretty engaging and he is quite available to help out in anyway. For homework's I would recommend starting earlier, just because they can take some time.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he is actually the GOAT and i can't understand why he was rated so low. he is one of the best profs i've had at khoury: easy to follow lectures (just show up), an ability to break down complex topics to make it seem so easy, and genuine care for students and passion for education. if you're planning to take CS4100 there's no better guy than raj!
He is a great professor for FAI, would enjoy taking up his class once again
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Professor, very interesting lectures and course content. You could tell he cared about his students and wanted to provide the best learning environment! Would highly recommend.

Unreasonable homework amount and timeline. Strange sense of "fair", doesn't allow extra credit because that's "unfair" to students with a job that do not have the time (funny, isn't the whole idea of extra credit just sacrificing extra time to boost your grade?). A TA even said he has no idea on a homework problem.

Professor Rajagopal Venkatesaramani's lectures are highly effective in enhancing understanding. He also asks well-thought-out questions that deepen understanding and often provide a fresh perspective on the concepts. Reviewing the notes beforehand is beneficial, and both the professor and TA are approachable for any clarifications.
Unclear grading standards

Raj is hands down a top professor I've ever had. His lectures are engaging and he has an inspirational passion for teaching. He invents hours of the day to help you with any challenges you face. If you know the material already, you still have the rare opportunity to work with a truly dedicated educator. The negative reviews are frankly absurd.

I don't understand the point of having such ambiguous Assignments and neither the TAs nor the professor cares enough to throw some light on the doubts students have. If I were to go back in time, I would have had definitely not taken this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please don't waste your time and money taking this course.

Pretty generous with the homework by combining the third and fourth one for us. Gave a lot of help outside class and even helped my group beyond the requested time. Takes feedback very well and I really respect it.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very unclear and inconsistent grading and TAs don't even have the basic knowledge to help other students out.
Absolutely useless course content, won't learn anything you don't already know
No use taking this course whatsoever, TAs don't know anything to help you out. If you want to learn take it from a different professor or learn it online which is going to be a lot better.

If you would like to learn atleast the basics of AI, please don't consider taking the course under this professor at all. Absolute waste of time and money. Instead you can watch a few youtube videos from a Stanford Professor which is exactly what he teaches in the class with the exact words, jokes and class interactions from the videos.
Very good professor, obviously cares a lot about students. Office hours were helpful.

It's almost disheartening for me to see all of these bad reviews for Professor Raj because he has truly been the single most inspiring and caring Professor that I've had in Khoury. Even though he's a good lecturer, his true strength lies in his office hours and helping those that take the effort to reach out to him. Take the effort to get help.

He is one of the most caring professors I have had and truly cares about your learning experience and not just the grade. His course material is designed to build your foundation and open up avenues to solve problems in multiple ways in the future. If participate wholeheartedly, you will gain a lot from his class and won't be disappointed.

Good professor, had well-constructed lectures and clearly presented the topics. The assignments were tough but they teach you a lot. They are appropriately sized and manageable. Make sure to attend the presentations as they are both very useful and necessary since he graded attendance through random pop quizzes (were super easy). Highly recommend!
if you want to gain useful knowledge in AI, you should choose other professor
Think twice before taking his class.

Very caring professor who is passionate about AI. Grades kindly and is very empathetic towards his students. He stayed with me way past his office hours just to help me understand a concept I was struggling with. He makes a couple mistakes in lecture, and the pop quizzes are unnecessary, but he is there to support your learning!
bad quiz setting, difficult homework, don't take his lecture
SOOOOO many lectures. She's truly the sweetest person alive, although the lectures kind of drone on and are slightly boring, she is super passionate and knows what shes tallking about. Easy A

Super clear lectures and course material! Canvas was organized and everything we had to do for credit was reasonable. As long as you stay consistent on homework and pay attention in class there shouldn't be any additional stressors. My fav prof!

Literally the best professor out there, very friendly and approachable, always willing to help and explain whatever is unclear. Very clear structure of the course, grading and teaching style. Amazing!!

I really liked Professor Scott. She was super friendly, and I liked how lenient she was about dropping low scores. I didn't like how lecture-heavy every class was with an overabundance of material to memorize. I understand it's an intro course, but sometimes less is more. It also felt too much like my high school psych class. I guess I wanted more.
Professor Scott is amazing! There's extra credit opportunities throughout the year and she sometimes drops your lowest quiz or homework score.

Professor Scott is such a good professor. The lecture slides are clear and she does a good job of explaining everything as well. There's extra credit opportunities throughout the year and she sometimes drops your lowest quiz or homework score. You'll always know what to expect when it comes to quizzes and midterms. I recommend!!!

Class is mainly slide presentation which are all posted before the next lecture. Lots of information but quiz questions and exams are generally the main topics and are all MC. Homework, quizzes and final are online she provides extra credit throughout the semester and is generally super chill. Overall loved her class.

Loved this class. The class itself was a basic lecture based class. The quizzes are usually made up of a variety of homework questions and attendance questions then the exams are made up of some of those questions. Very kind professor, and the content can sometimes be a lot to digest, but the homework and external sources she provides are helpful.

This was Professor Scott's first year teaching at Northeastern Oakland, and she did amazing. Though her lectures are pretty heavy, people can participate or not. She will drop quizzes and homework and give extra credit. I would really recommend this class since she is really amazing and makes it really hard to not do well.

Professor Sabherwal  sparks conversations that stay with students long after class. Her teaching has encouraged me to see the world more critically and with greater empathy. I feel very fortunate to be in her classroom. She cares about students.

my favorite prof at northeastern. she is not afraid to talk about hard topics. she shows her students that she is also a person with lived experiences and she gives space for us to share our own experiences.

To start I took ANTH 3421 not 3100, but that option wasn't provided. Prof. Sabherwal is genuinely one of the best profs I have ever had. She is kind, intelligent, and passionate. Her lectures were always helpful and easy to grasp. She cares deeply for her students' wellbeing and overall success. If you have the option, take one of her classes!

Greatest experience with a professor ever! Conversation focused class, cultivates a compassionate space. Lots of reading but goes over material. Grades easy and her comments are constructive and empowering. Cares about students learning and personally. Listens to students and incorporates feedback. Always available outside class. 100% recommend!

My favorite prof I've had at Northeastern. She cares more about students' well-being and that they're actually enjoying the course and absorbing material than shoving it down our throats with quizzes and busy work. She creates a safe, accepting, uplifting and collaborative class environment that allows for insightful conversations. TAKE HER!!

Prof Mike is incredibly sweet, yet unfortunately he's unable to stay on topic during classes and is the stereotypical "chalkboard professor" to a fault. He gives no study guides or practice exams, and the tests are nothing like the homework and almost always like the work done in class, so if you actively participate, you'll be golden.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a chiller, kind and sweet guy.

He is Very nice person, he is doing well in preparing all the materials in the class, but he does NOT know how to teach you the train of thought.He will just write down the answer on the assignment and barely explain it at all. There is a gap between teaching and homework

I took the Summer 1 asynchronous online course for ACCT 1201. I have attended his online office hours. He tries his best to help the students, despite the challenges of the online course. He supports the students through constant reminders and office hours. If you make an effort to try in the course, he will reciprocate.

Prof Mike is great! The way the class is structured you only need to do homework once a week pretty much. The content can be confusing, but he does a decent job at explaining each topic well, as well as talking through problems. Make sure you participate!! He is a fair grader, and if you stay decently on top of your work you will do really well

A genuinely sweet, caring, kind professor. He loves when you participate, even when you aren't correct. Sit near the front/participate often and he will know your name. Sometimes a bit monotone/boring, but I'd take him again. Try and read textbook before class and following lecture will be easy. Lots of practice problems done in class to follow.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice but does NOT know how to teach. Really boring lectures and does not offer support to students. Really tedious in class work and he will cold call you. Attendance is mandatory and do not sit in the front row he spits

Prof Ruff is a great person and for his age taught the class well, however if you don't pay attention for a little bit you can fall behind easy. His handwriting is unreadable at times which is inconvenient because he spends most of the lecture writing on the chalkboard. Even with all that said, I would still say take his class. Great guy!

Professor Ruff is a great guy and cares about his students. The quizzes are online, multiple choice, and open note. He does not curve individual assignments, but is a generous grader and curves final course grades. He is not the best lecturer, but appreciates you going into office hours which helps.

Not the best at lecturing or explaining the actual concepts, but very caring and understanding. He gives a lot of extra credit if you participate and practice resources, but most of the actual learning has to be done but the student. Really nice guy but he should probably retire.

Very kind and funny professor, made class very entertaining and manageable. Only two major tests the entire semester so you truly have to study hard on those because they make up 50% of the final grade. Overall very good professor and very generous grader. My advice would be to do the optional hw assignments, extra credit, and use his office hours.

Overall, Michael Ruff is a very kind person who will work with you. He is very knowledgeable in accounting but is not great at teaching concepts. He tends to speak over his students and doesn't answer specific questions. If you are not great with conceptual learning I would recommend a different teacher.

Ruff is very caring and teaches the material well. Gives a lot of chances for extra credit. Only issue is the group project (10% of grade), but he also is very receptive with issues with groups. The course is very test heavy, with about 50% of your grading riding on 2 tests (20% midterm 30% final). Grading is pretty favorable too.
Stay away, there are better ACCT profs. than him
he is so funny and teaches so good
Fair grader. Enough extra credit opportunities. Submit hw and quizzes on time.

I absolutely love this professor. I really struggled with the course, but he was always available whenever I wanted to meet to discuss my quizzes/homework support. He also offered extra assignments that definitely helped me understand the material on top of the lectures/problems in class. There is a group project that will require excel knowledge!

Mike is the best! He is the sweetest professor and truly cares about all of his students, even the ones that don't participate. His lectures are very basic and easy to follow so you don't ever feel lost, and he's always willing to meet outside of class, even just to chat! He's easily my favorite professor at Northeastern, highly recommend.

Had this guy for asynchronous classes and can confidently say after seeing about 4 videos of him, I already love him. He is the sweetest, kindest guy, the kind of guy you could never be mad at. Already love him. He talks slowly, but I can put the video in 2x speed so it's easier to get through.10/10 Would rate again.

Prof Ruff tells you exactly what you need to do to succeed. If you do the homework, study for quizzes and exams, and ask questions when necessary, you'll do fine. If you put in some extra work, you'll do great. He is nice, and is understanding if you have any problems. I find his lectures to be very helpful. Do the optional assignments!

As many have said, Accounting in itself is not an easy one. But Prof Ruff helps you understand the material. Do your homework, LearnSmart, etc and you will pass. Going through end of chapter exercises will really help in quizzes/exams. Engage as much as you can during class! Prof Ruff is someone who genuinely cares for those who are keen to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: His class was by far my favorite and he goes out of his way to make it more interesting. He also wants you to do well and if youve put in the work hell try his best to get you a high grade.

Professor Ruff was funny and easy to understand which made Accounting a lot more interesting than I thought it could be. He says that students are expected to read the textbook and spend many hours outside of class. I didn't do this and ended up doing fine. The final is very hard so get ready for that.

Professor Ruff is very caring to his students and has a lot of experience in his field. During class he does practice problems but its up to the student to teach yourself the material. The homework takes a long time to complete, and exams and quizzes are quite difficult, but Professor Ruff is pretty flexible.

This was the hardest class I took last semester, and the exams are difficult. The online class heavily relied on the textbook which was confusing at some points if you have not taken a previous accounting class. However, Professor Ruff is extremely caring, does a great job answering any questions you may have, and is flexible.

This class was SO HARD, but Professor Ruff is truly the most caring Professor ever. Hell do anything to help you understand concepts-he even stayed on an office hour zoom call with my friend for 2 hours to make sure she understood the concept. He replies to emails super fast, and is super understanding about the pandemic and your other classes.

I took this course during the pandemic online. Professor Mike is a really nice professor, though his course is extremely tough! You need to read every chapter carefully, so you are able to do homework and quizzes. There are few assignments that are optional, but they are good practice for exams. Exams are tough, so better prepare for it!
Ruff makes the intro classes very fun and I would recommend him for any accounting classes. He acknowledges the comical nuance with a lot of the material and manages to make it interesting

Most students in my class did ok. However, I usually studied acct1201 with angry tears in my eyes. The midterm and final were SO hard. I realized that I wouldn't receive an A grade right after the midterm. The quizzes were 10 MCs so be prepared. Email him, talk to him, he's very inspirational and thoughtful. Put in some work and you will be fine.

One of the most caring professors I've ever had. He sees the best in every student, and seriously wants us all to understand the material & do well. Accounting will never be the easiest or most fun class to attend, and he teaches the tough classes which I don't think he gets enough credit for. He will go to the ends of the earth for u to succeed.

Professor Ruff is a solid choice. His class can be difficult at times, but his lectures are very easy to follow and you can tell he really wants everyone to learn. He always mentions when he is accessible outside of class and gives clear expectations about what is due. The homework assignments are an easy 100 and he gives lots of time to do them.

Prof. Ruff really cares. He is super responsive to emails and is available when you need him. He curves with the attendance/participation grade, so be sure to participate and ask questions. He wants you to do well & visit the TAs too! Weekly homework, 4 quizzes each 5MCQ, 1 test &the final, and the project are grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Caring--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Respectfully, Professor Ruff is one of my least favorite professors I've had at NU. He isn't very kind, doesn't do a good job of helping students understand the material, and the tests are extremely difficult. Overall not a nice guy. Can be rude to students.

Professor Ruff is a great guy and a fair teacher. He has a lot of experience in accounting and gives good lecture; however, the majority of your learning will need to be done outside of class through the very long homework assignments or TAs. The quizzes and exams are tough and require a lot of studying and the online textbook is not the best.

One of the nicest professors I've had. Gives a lot of practice problems which are super helpful in understanding the material. 4 quizzes, each are 10 mc's, which can pull down your grade. Always holds office hours and makes sure he can reach students if needed. I wasn't the best at accounting but still loved him as a professor

Literally the nicest professor I've had here at NEU. Definitely cares a lot about his students and how well they're doing in class. All this being said, he isn't the BEST at explaining content, but the class is primarily reading the chapters so mostly independent studying. Participate in class and he'll help you out on your final grade!

Prof Ruff is a super nice teacher and really cares about his students. He is very reasonable and listens to his students. The homework can sometimes take a few hours and make you want to tear your hair out. His tests are pretty tricky and his lectures are very boring. My best advice is to practice the problems he gives you in class over and over!

Prof Ruff is definitely one of the kindest and most caring professors I've ever had. His lectures aren't the most engaging and can sometimes be confusing, but when asked questions he takes time to make sure you fully understand the material. The class itself is difficult but he's a fair grader and tries to give you as many points as possible

Ruff is your typical dad accountant making stupid jokes that he himself laughs at for a good minute. He teaches by doing many examples on the board (sometimes theyre hard to keep up with) and giving powerpoints. Tests are reasonable, doesn't curve though. Also, homework is long and tedious on an online textbook but is great practice for tests/quiz.
Prof. Ruff is a very kind person and really cares about his students,  attendance is mandatory. He is willing to explain any of your confusion... about the course. Highly recommend.

Accounting is not easy in itself. Ruff's class seems engaging and requires a lot of attention. Professor tries to be as clear as possible while explaining the material. However, his quizzes and exams are hard! He is a tough grader. You will need to participate as much as you can and attend his office hours to get some extra points in order to pass!

As has been said Ruff is a cool guy, but that doesn't excuse what was/wasn't taught in his class. His lectures are clearly stock from McGraw Hill and he does a poor job of conveying the messages and, by extension, he does a poor job teaching the material. I learned 99% of my accounting this semester from Youtube despite paying to learn in class...

This is accounting and it's not easy. Ruff is a great guy like everyone says, but his exams and quizzes hard. The book is useless for learning and connect can only help you so much. He gives projects and hw (unlimited tries) to balance grades. The final exam is extremely hard, be prepared to study a lot. You can survive the class, wont be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor ruff, is overall a great guy. However, he is a really tuff grader. His exams, while mainly multiple choice are extremely hard. I attended every class, went to office hours and saw the TA and still struggled.  He over complicates the subjects and is heavily power point based.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's one of the nicest professors I've had, but he's very strict when it comes to participation and attendance. He cares about his students and wants you to do well. Accounting is a tough class but he makes it bearable.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Prof Ruff is a great dude, not the best teacher by any means, but a great guy. If you haven't taken accounting beforehand or you don't learn by reading the textbook outside of class, this class - despite Ruff being a good guy - is a hard pass.
