Personally, I hate mono-tone foreigners that teach, but this guy makes life easy as cake.  If you take a quiz, you can have 10 problems wrong out of 50 and still get a 100.  Very Approachable. This was definetely a cake-walk class.
She should go home

I am not a conspiracy theorist, but I do believe with all my heart that Aisulu is an angel. When I am not looking in her direction, I swear I see wings sprouting out behind her back, and dare I say, the glimmer of a halo on her head. Aisulu cares deeply about her students and real learning. She has a beautiful respect for the field of linguistics.

She was a great professor. She was very lecture driven but she is always willing to make sure that you understand. She will incorporate practice problems into her lectures so you have a better idea of what she is teaching us. Her homework is pretty easy if you review the lecture slides. She is very lenient and is always to help accommodate you.

The professor is extremely nice, she wants to make sure you actually learn the material. There is only 1 test. The homework is graded fairly with great feedback and she does not really mind latework. The lectures in class are long and can be boring but you will understand everything from her with no studying. I 100% recommend taking her class.

Very negative experience regarding the course and the handling of intellectual property. Students should be extremely cautious about protecting their original work with Michal Aibin. Avoid at any cost.

Beyond the severe ethical red flags, the instructor's professional standard is alarmingly subpar.

The teaching quality is honestly very poor. He often seems confused and doesn't explain things clearly, which makes me doubt if he even understands the material. It feels like he is just doing the bare minimum to get by, without caring about the students at all.
Very negative experience regarding the course and handling of intellectual property. Students should be extremely cautious about protecting their original work with Michal Aibin. Avoid at any cost.
Lots of positive feedback and ideas how to do projects - helps learn how to do research.

The best Capstone Prof by far. Lots of knowledge, industry connections and applied, hands-on approach. We build disaster management tools for wildfires and got internships after in the industry. Strongly recommend!

Nicest professor at northeastern. She truly cares about her work, her contribution to science, her students, her place within the university, and as the editor of the Northeastern Journal of Linguistics. Amazing human. Amazing professor.

She's the NICEST lady! Super caring and understanding - I had to join her class online during the summer, and she was really accommodating. She gives great feedback and is really passionate about what she teaches. The class was super engaging and you learn a lot, yet the workload is manageable - take her class!

Aisulu Raspayeva is a WONDERFUL professor who genuinely cares about her students. She wants you to be as passionate about linguistics as she is. The workload in manageable and contributes to the content of the class. I recommend taking something with her if you have the opportunity.

She's a very accommodating professor who's generally open to whatever you need, as long as you can explain your reasoning. The assignments are flexible, you can miss class or arrive late if you communicate with her. She's extremely understanding and creates a comfortable classroom atmosphere where you can work at your own pace, listen to music.

Very sweet professor, is usually okay with anything you do as long as you have a good enough reason. Assignments are flexible and you can skip class or come in late of you just tell her why. Very understanding and good class environment - you can have music on while you work, go at your own pace, etc.

I did great in her class but she is the kind to tell you what is wrong with your artwork in front of everyone. I was doing a presentation and made me stop because of something I said was "wrong" and proceeded to tell the entire class why what I said was wrong, basically called me stupid and that I didn't know what I was talking about while laughing
very kind, easy class, can draw or paint anything if you have a clear enough profession of your work or enough reasoning, very process oriented.
Pretty rude, talked down to me because I couldn't draw certain styles. Very unclear of what we are doing in class that day and grading scale is wack.

She clearly has favorites. After missing two weeks for personal reasons, she developed a weird vendetta against me, even making remarks about me in class. Though I put A LOT effort into my work (mind u this is an 8am 2 credit course) and followed her guidelines, she graded unfairly. For my final, I met all requirements but still ended up with a B.

Judgemental + pretentious. Will grade you on how much SHE likes it/match her style, not if you did it right. Her suggestions are basically mandatory fixes if you want a good grade. Clear favoritism. She often singles people out for not having art knowledge or doing the project wrong (will make people come look at your work and explain why its bad)

Good at at teaching art but she likes to give her thoughts on things when she thinks you are wrong. Graded by very few things, but very picky if you are late. I think her grading was unfair at times. But she was an easy class for me.

She was a fun person, depending who you were. She is picky on art style at times and said she didn't like the way I drew a project on my style. She could tell I wasn't a good at the type of art she gave.

She always singled people out. When I participated in her class at the beginning, she pointed out my apparent difference. And she always treated me differently, and when everyone introduced themselves, she gave positive feedback. When it was my turn, she ignored me. She only ignored me.

i was sick and could not come in for the midterm, emailed and nothing back. midterms are by appointment and i came in and she gave me a 0 for it, later on a guy in my class said he just overslept and she just gave him an A.

not good at all types of art? don't even think of getting an A in this class. she singled out people in the class and would laugh it off when no one laughed with her. also drew all over on and on back side of my art piece in sharpie of what she didn't like about my work.

she has her fav in students and has double standards. she is very passive aggressive when it came to people artwork. i had her as a 8am and she would shame students that would come late (by 5 mins) and say that there was no excuse of being late when she got there at 6am. gave me a C on a project because she didn't like my style i drew something.
She's trying to make me the minority, I feel isolated by her words.
An incident where she commented on physical differences between students left me feeling marginalized and uncomfortable. Her approach lacked sensitivity, which significantly affected my ability.

reviews.comment: As a student currently in Professor Ainslie's Color and Comp course, I've found that her passion for her work and creativity enhance your learning experience tenfold. She approaches issues with empathy and kindness. Communication and effort are key in this course; you cannot half-ass your work, but it is absolutely worth it in the end!!

If you are not someone who has fundamental art skills don't go with this professor. She is dismissive in communication and is very vague in terms of how she grades your assignments. She never gives clear feedback or instructions on the projects in class.

Grades are based on projects and attendance. There are 3-4 projects during the semester, most of which have a quick turnaround time. you will have it put in a LOT of time and effort outside of class; even then, you are not guaranteed an A. she does not grade by effort, she grades it based on what she thinks of your work.

You'll need to spend a lot of time doing the project every week, get ready for it. She is a hard grader even you put a lot of effort into work, you may still not an A. She can have so many to say about your work, so don't be afraid.

The only 8 AM class I actually enjoy and attend every single class. Very friendly, encouraging, good teacher, but somewhat harsh grading if you're used to easy As. A very kind and understanding woman, who wants to help.  She seems to be very proficient at art itself, but maybe not at teaching art. She says "push the work" as the main feedback.

reviews.comment: Sophia is funny, upbeat, and really nice, so she's willing to help you if you ask. She's also a really tough grader, and though you can always revise your work, expect to spend a lot of time on your projects.
Hard class, lots of work, but pays off. Best teacher I've had at Northeastern. Sweet, funny, and willing to help.

Sophia is the best teacher I have ever had.She accepts everyones technique and style and is excited to explore it.She is extremely down to earth and understands that students have other work and gives a fair workload. She gives a lot of personal attention and will rearrange her schedule even to meet with you and she wants to see individual progress

nice person, but just ok professor. she was a bit harsh with her grading, and she was also a bit hard to please.  projects were sort of hit or miss, either she liked what you did or she didn't.  if you take her 2d class, make sure tone is a key element of your pieces, she definitely focuses on that the most, and subtlety in tone works against you.

Sophia is a lovely lady who is passionate about art and teaching. Color 1 is an easy class, which actually allowed me to produce some of my best work.  She doesn't respond to emails too quickly but she is more than willing to talk to you for a significant amount of time before or after class. She has an awesome British accent.

Great teacher, passionate about art and active in her field. Defintly my favorite teacher of the semester! critiques are honest, which is helpful, and advice given is quite useful for those who would like to improve.
Great prof, passionate about art, good critiques. Fair grader, but you've got to work a lot! I highly recommend her.
Ainslie is very knowledgeable and helpful. Critique can be harsh sometimes, but you really learn a lot. It's really hard to get an A on pieces, but not impossible.

Though art is subjective, yes, this teacher always didn't like my work--even the class came to notice that she just picked on me. She gives you the chance to re-do your work--but she'd just give me the same grade after I did the extra work. DO YOUR HOMEWORK
What a great professor! Even though class was at 8AM it was so interesting that I didn't mind. I learned a lot and my drawing definitely improved. Ainslie is fun and supportive!
great teacher! enthusiastic, passionate, interesting.

Excellent class. I loved it. She is a mirracle worker to get me to be able to draw

friendly,  creative woman is helpful in teaching you the basics. she likes extremes- in areas like shading as well as in concept. she doesnt mind if you take a different approach to an assignment. just be able to justify it. must attend all classes.
her class was very simple and shes a nice teacher.  just make sure that if you do sumthing not her way, to do it well.

The tests during the semester weren't difficult, you're allowed a reference sheet. Final was EXTREMELY difficult and didn't relate to covered, in class material whatsoever.

FINA4526 - Mengchao Ai is nice, respectful, and educated. Mengchao is also by a lightyear, the most useless, ineffective, and unplugged teacher I have ever had. Do the practice problems and come to class with questions! Material is generally easy to follow. Sit in the front. I really liked her.

Avoid Professor Al if you can. Her teaching consists of reading unhelpful PowerPoints, and her exams, which are mostly multiple-choice, are far more challenging than anything she covers.
Since the tests make up a huge part of your grade, it's almost impossible to do well.

The exams are full of complicated questions that she doesn't prepare you for, and they're weighted so heavily it's hard to recover if you do poorly.

Professor Al doesn't teach; she just reads through irrelevant slides. Her exams are brutal, with 20-30 multiple-choice questions that are much harder than what's in her PowerPoints. Since the exams make up most of the grade, it feels impossible to succeed even after studying hard.

Worst professor l've ever had. Her lectures are just PowerPoints that don't prepare you for the exams at all. Her exams makes up the majority of your grade

I do not recommend taking fina2201 with her. there are barely any homeworks and most of your grade is 2 midterms and the final. she is not easily accessible outside of class and she will not make time for you if u cannot make it to office hours. cold calls. tests are not like the practices. do not recommend.

While the course is test-heavy, none of the test questions were more challenging than the example problems. I liked how Professor Ai was very accessible outside of class and her dedication to explaining concepts to her students until they understand it is very clear. Also gives end of class time up for students to ask questions.

reviews.comment: Very exam heavy, if you're not a test taker, do not take her. 70% of your grade is your midterm and final. Her classes are boring because of her thick accent. classes will just be discussing a set of problems and no real explanation. I knew concepts from highschool and last sem ACCT1201. If I hadn't, I would be miserably failing this class.

Definitely felt like I was missing out on what I should be learning but its just a math class. Know formulas and how elements interact and the class isn't hard. Two tests, autograded MC homework, and final are the only grades. Not hard if you pay attention in class to how she solves the problems and study. Boring lectures but slides are posted.
Her classes are horrible and hard to understand anything she says. If u miss an exam, the final exam is worth 50%. Literally the worst class I have ever had

Her course is hard but professor Ai is a great teacher, if you have more question that cannot be understood during her office hour, she will use her own time to teach until you fully understand the knowledge.
This Professor has no homework, but the tests are kind of difficult for you, so if you just study hard on the class, it is easy to get an A.
Wonderful!
Great professor with incredible experience with her!
Professor Ai is a great teacher, her class is organized and she does pay a lot of attention to students! Amazing experience.

Her explanations in class were questionable, so there is a decent burden on you to learn the material. The exams are generally easier than the hardest example questions given, so I wouldn't say they are unfair (in spite of there being low classes averages).

Mengchao is kind and caring but class avgs are low. For our second exam, the avg was around a 74 and she did not curve. The multiple choice were super challenging and we were given no practice with them at all. I got a B+ despite the fact that I found the course straightforward because its 70% exam based so one subpar grade on an exam blows it.

Do not take Professor Ai. Her slides are extremely confusing and the chapters in her slides do not line up with those in the textbook she provided. She does not curve anything despite the class average for our class's second exam and final exam being in the 70s. Be prepared to be confused and frustrated if you take Professor Ai.

Prof. Mengchao was nice, but she struggled to convey the class materials and her slides were confusing. In this case, normally you could read the textbook and teach yourself, however the chapters in the slides did not even line up with the textbook making this quite difficult. Overall, it was a disorganized class not very conducive to learning.

Prof Mengchao is fair and gives straightforward lectures. She is thorough when covering material and ensures to answer questions and go through practice problems. My only compliant is that she doesn't provide enough resources (study guides & practice answer sheets) to study for tests. If you miss class, you'll need to look up questions yourself.

Professor Ai spends the time with students when you come to her with questions.  Office hours and her patience are part of why I passed. You have to do the assignments; she won't read the book to you like a bedtime story, but she cares about students doing well and understanding the material. There is no reason not to do well in her class.

I love this professor. I took her class in the summer, and I was afraid that the workload would be unbearable, but she made finance clear and easy. Her slides are amazing and as long as you do the slide questions, you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Ai tried her best but it she was a very disorganized professor that did not know how to teach this topic.  She rushed chapters and did not teach them properly, leading to most class averages to be very low.

Panahi is an amazing teacher. He frontloads the content for a chapter for one class, keeps it to only the most important information, and then spends the next few classes afterwards devoting the entire class time to exam style practice problems. He cold calls but doesn't care if you don't know or aren't finished yet. Super personable and helpful.

Panahi is the goat. Thermo is a very poorly organized class at the administrative level, but Panahi makes sure all of his students still do well. He's a pretty monotone guy, but lowkey funny once the class warms up to him. Lectures are him writing a practice problem on the board and having everyone solve it. He is super helpful if you get lost.

Panahi is sneaky funny and is a troll. Course is difficult with weekly quizzes, 3 midterms, and a final, but Panahi's teaching makes it manageable. Classes will mostly consist of working through 1-2 example problems which will make time fly by. His class performs better than other sections taught by other professors. Enjoys cold calling students.
Super boring lectures (he just reads the slides). Very very difficult to learn anything without just reading the textbook on your own.
I learned a lot in this class. Great selection of business cases related to Fintech. Team work was fun too and I transacted using cryptocurrencies for the first time!

Enjoyed this class. Mainly lecture based and had a mix of online assessments and group projects on interesting topics. Professor Koparan was very accessible and was always down to help if you had questions. Would highly recommend if looking for a chiller FINA class.

I took fintech in summer 1 and although the pace of the course felt a bit expedited due to summer scheduling, it was super fun to explore fintech landscape and Alper creates a friendly classroom environment. Assignments are helpful and I also learned a lot about cryptocurrencies.

Very enjoyable lectures and friendly classroom atmosphere. I really liked group project which is about creating a startup idea and investor pitch at the end. Alper is extremely knowledgable about Fintech and makes concepts easy to understand.

I really enjoyed this class and even at 8 am Professor Koparan made lectures engaging and interesting. Some assignments are in class and there are hands-on exercises to experience cryptocurrencies and decentralized finance. A must have class if you are interested in Fintech!

FINA4604 is a super dense finance class in nature covering Levels 1-3 of the CFA curriculum and dives into highly quantitative topics. Unless you're super passionate about fixed income I wouldn't advise taking this class unless you're ready to read through a 900 page textbook and spend 6-10 hours a week on homework

This is a very technical and difficult course. I would not take it unless you are interested in Fixed Income. It covers topics from Level 1-3 of the CFA and it takes a lot of work outside of class to do well. I spent 6-8 per week outside of class studying. Alper cares about the material and his students. I learned a ton in this class.

Hard grader, exams extremely hard, midterm 1 20%, midterm 2 20%, final 30%. assignments consist of mcq and excels very hard and complicated. if u miss class get ready to figure out how to do assignment/hw. didn't know this class was tailored for CFA. work hard or else ur grade is gonna have a big drop.

I'm in Fixed Income Securities class and it is going great so far! It is not an easy course but Professor Koparan makes it engaging and practical. Hi is always available for questions and care about student success. He is one of the best at Northeastern and highly recommended!

Do not take fixed income securities with Alper Koparan. He is extremely disorganized and doesn't have the answers for homework figured out before the test, so you can't study effectively. Tests make up a large portion of the grade, but his test questions are not specific whatsoever and he solves them differently from how he teaches them in class.

Prof. Koperan is one of my favorite profs at NEU. He is extremely kind and caring and genuinely a good person. His Fintech class is relatively easy as long as you do the readings & study. He's always available outside of class too. He breaks down complex concepts into really easy ones. Take his class!!!!

She is the sweetest woman EVER. Made class so much fun and she is so accommodating. Truly a real-life Mrs Frizzle and I feel like I learn so much in her class. I took a gamble with this class given I had no clue what it was but god am I so happy I did,if you have the chance to take her please don't second guess it.She is so smart and awesome.
she's great just wish she was a stricter grader tbh
It is a lecture heavy class, but informal in nature. She spends class time sharing her knowledge about phonetics and it feels natural to ask questions and participate. I enjoy her a lot!

excellent professor. very passionate about the course and actively tries to include every student in the class before and during the lecture. if you participate in class and take the time to do the readings you will do very well

She's an amazing teacher, and really cares about her students/wants to get to know them. She's super willing to help one-on-one and is accessible outside of class. Her class has lots of in class worksheets to practice concepts and she keeps a fun atmosphere. She tries to make her students laugh a lot, and lectures are never boring because of it.

Alejna is a very good linguistics professor, she is clearly very knowledgeable about the topic. Outside of class she is easy to reach and responsive to emails. Super understanding, you just have to communicate things beforehand. No in class tests, just like 5 homeworks where she accepts corrections, a project, and a take home midterm and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is the only reason I understood discrete and everything was explained really well. She is super sweet and cares for all her students that show up.
She is super helpful and caring and makes sure we understand each topic. I enjoyed showing up every time, and left knowing a lot more than when I came in. Definitely recommend!!

My favorite recitation was the one for Discrete Structures taught by Professor Ghita. She has the power to make concepts digestible for someone learning them for the first time. Additionally, she always took the time to clarify even as after the section ended. Finally, she gives you just enough to let still reach that "aha" moment. Thank you Ghita!

so nice and so ineffective. there were many typos on the shared materials (notes shared, etc.) throughout her teaching, with not enough support to resolve them, making understanding concepts frustrating. explanations were ambiguous and missed the mark. poor teaching quality. highly suggest avoiding if you can. some things just don't change.

Had her for recitation for Discrete Strucutres (CS1800). She was amazing! Not many people went to the recitations, so you are able to have very small group discussions with her and get personalized help. She knew the content very well and did extra practice problems to make sure that we understood the material.

Said that "for computer science" natural numbers start at 0 in the lecture, did an induction example with said assumption, took points off in homework because "natural numbers start at 1". A must take if you enjoy casual gaslighting :)

A terrific professor. Dr. Amor was always ready to answer questions and she explains concepts super well. I got an A in discrete because of her. She provided so much help and kindness. My advise is to show up to recitation - no one does, so she'll spend as much time as you want on your questions. I cannot stress enough how nice and helpful she is.
Gives good recitation lectures. Seems to care if students understand content or not
For CS 1802 (CS 1800's lab), pretty good, although sometimes the explanations may be a little difficult to follow, if you just ask for clarification, she will happily oblige. Very caring and nice.
I didn't like the attitude or teaching style very much

She is nice but she got mad at me once during office hours because I didnt understand a question, like???? Oh and be prepared to take a very important exam the Monday after thanksgiving break very early in the morning. Your end of semester results will be delayed as well.

Just watch the lectures and you can pretty much figure it out. Go to TA office hours/clinic hours!!!!! They will help you with all the assignments they literally were the reason I did so well! Prof is super sweet and caring!

Extremely hard, weekly homework that takes hours to complete, final exams are so important. Very useful information but avoid if not necessary. Prof was available and helpful. Hardest and one of the most demanding classes I've ever had.

reviews.comment: The online lectures are done by a variety of teachers and are comprehensive. Professor does a good job of explaining in class. Tests are a big percentage, but they are the same as the HW

She is a very easy professor to get an A grade under. It does make it unfair for students who are willing to work for the course since she frequently gives extensions, allows late submissions and entertains any sort of regrading if you just ask for it. Take it to get points, do not try to work hard for the course since you'll just be disappointed.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Everything you do is online. Attendance is 4%, but CS, in general, is a very intense and time-demanding class. Long assignments every week + quizzes. The grades add up fast. Don't risk your grade unless you're a CS major. Take an online class somewhere else if you want to learn the skills (especially for co-op) but this class is not worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class is based on watching tutorials online before class, and then practicing the material during class. reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Easily the worst class I've taken in my 3 semesters at NEU. TA is AWFUL. If you sit in the front, maybe you can understand a bit more. But regardless of who I've talked to, they struggle. Unless this class is absolutely required for your major, take it with another prof. She doesn't know much of the material, she needs to look stuff up in office hr

I am only taking this class because it is required and this one was the only one that fit into my schedule. If you can avoid this professor, I HIGHLY recommend you do so. Most certainly the worst professor I've had at Northeastern. Definitely extremely knowledgeable in marketing but abuses his power and does not want students to succeed.

The worst thing about this class is that stupid Bike simulation you have to do your entire semester and if you get a bad group, you are done for as that is already like 25% of your grade especially the summaries. The HW isn't too bad and defiently look at his feedback to get a higher score on the next one. The entire class is so lecture heav.

Very, very strict on attendance (3 strikes you're out kinda thing.. beware). Not much HW, but very strict on grading (you must thoroughly incorporate his feedback). Open-note exams- lots of flexibility with how you answer which is good. Class is lecture heavy but relatively engaging, participation matters (easy to participate). Teacher is solid.
STAY AWAY!!!!!!! HE WILL RUIN YOUR GPA! I have an A in every single class EXCEPT his! RUN FOR THE HILLS!! HIS TESTS ARE STUPID! HIS HOMEWORK IS GRADED 1-4 but NOBODY get above 3/4 Automatic 75
Very knowledgeable and enthusiastic about marketing! His lectures were almost always entertaining and he always laid out what you needed to do well on quizzes and projects.
Great professor and great guy. I don't understand the bad reviews he's a great dude and I learned a ton in the class. He grades a bit harsh but it's chill.

Professor DePaoli's class was incredibly valuable for anyone interested in digital marketing. We earned HubSpot and Google Analytics certifications and worked on real-world projects like running paid ads and managing a social media page. Highly recommend for those entering the field!
I think he acts the way he does to overcompensate for being short and not getting a bid in college

This man is straight up evil, no words. Run for the hills, run, he ruined my gpa. I have never ended a class with a C. Got a perfect score on the final but ended with a C bc of attendance? Avoid, he is also super nit-picky.

DePaoli is a great professor who definitely knowledgeable in his teachings. There are only four homework assignments and they are worth almost as much as the assessments - this is a double-edged blade but it helps students learn and understand the material. Overall he is very nice and takes time to make sure his students understands the material
Alex doesn't give any direction on how he wants case studies and assignments done. He has TA grade cases which he should probably be grading himself. Super hard grader.

Professor understands the concepts very well and is very good at explaining them although he does so with slight arrogance. I spent little time outside of class reading the textbook or my notes. Tests are online and open book and are not very difficult except there is not a lot of time. Homework's are easy if you put a bit of effort in them.

Very strict grader without good reason, knocks points off for unexcused absences, and is sadistic in my opinion. I always work to improve but rarely scored anything but a 4/5 on all outside-of-class assignments. He expects you to do so much more than what the assignment says to do & doesn't give points back once he made his decision. Avoid taking!
Glad I dropped this class lmao.
The quizzes are really hard!!

Agree that this professor is incredibly sadistic. He will take an incredible amount of points off for things you DID complete, solely because he didn't open the attachment you submitted. He is a poor representation of the university and deserves to be severely audited as his grading practice is frankly ridiculous. Save yourself and don't take him.

The professor goes out of his way to make students miserable and feel bad. I completely agree with another review that described the Professor as sadistic. He wants to get students in trouble and finds pleasure in their failure. His mistreatment is unreasonable and unjustified.

Professor DePaoli has very interesting lectures and he knows marketing very well, but he punishes students who do well out of pure skepticism. Many students like this professor, but for those who do not, it is mainly because of mistreatment and disrespect. He has negatively influenced my idea of marketing and of the university.

Although Alex is very knowledgable in marketing, I would look at other professors if you know that marketing is not something you want to pursue in the future. He is incredibly lecture heavy, is quite a strict grader, knocks points off for unexcused absences, and is honestly kind of pretentious in my opinion. Some will love him, some will hate him

This professor can be perfect for some and bad for others. Super lecture intensive, with his classes being him reading of a presentation the entire duration of the class. He wants you to learn, so his quizzes are based heavily on your response rather than a correct answer. Super participation focused, after 2 missed classes he knocks your grade.

Alex is a nice professor and he always has interesting lectures. Sometimes they can get a bit long/redundant and too in depth for an intro course. He grades pretty harshly and does not give many easy assignments--tests are very detailed and rushed (he expects creativity) and homework are too demanding and time consuming.

Definitely have to work hard and show up to class, but you learn A LOT. The class is very well structured and you can tell he cares about his students and their learning. Make sure you participate. He's always very accessible if you ever are confused.

Really interesting lectures, but the actual quizzes are really difficult. If you want an A you'll really have to work for it. I personally wasn't a fan of him because of his really odd grading but if you value learning over an easy A I'd take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Very cool and engaging. Powerpoints are very useful and the course load is not too bad. He is kind of a tough grader on tests though. Textbook is recommended but most of the info is covered in his lectures anyways. Great guy

Prof. is a very nice guy. However, he is definitely tough on grading. You can get through the homework thinking you are doing very well (no negative feedback), but then do very poorly on quizzes (worth 10% each) or the presentations. He expects more than he lets on. Be prepared to put in a lot of work, but then you will do well.

Professor DePaoli is very knowledgeable and it shows. However, he is a little high-strung and has explicit guidelines with everything. Feedback is very vague most of the time, and his response to just about anything is very matter-of-fact. Don't buy the textbook, it is a waste of money and you learn everything in lecture. One big group project.

reviews.comment: One of those rare professors who actually makes it their goal to educate you. Not to test you, not to waste your time, but to make you learn. There is no pity given to lazy students. If you work and participate you can get a higher grade, but you have to struggle for the A. Hes also very direct and well spoken which is a plus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Alex DePaoli is the most sadistic and unfunny professors I've had in my life. He picks on students and makes jokes about them that just humiliate them. He has no morals when it comes to students with disabilities as he didn't allow one student to get extra time since he submitted his form late to him even though he had a debilitating disability.

DePaoli is a legend. One of the best professors that I have had at Northeastern. He is very funny and witty. We stan. His class lectures are very interactive and heavily relate to the world. He is very receptive to students' thoughts and opinions (coursework, lecture style, topics to discuss, etc.). You SHOULD DEFINITELY TAKE HIM for 2201/2202

I love Alex. Course is easy as long as you participate, turn assignments in on time, and try. His test are hard, but designed to give points even on wrong answers. He has an interesting and fresh perspective on marketing so he lectures are fascinating. He's witty and modern, so the class is relatable. Class was refreshing and fun. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Overall a good class, good prof. Tons of cases but he will make them shorter. On that note, he is really good about asking how to improve the course throughout. One big group project/ business plan, but easier than most other Business class projects. Tough grader, but a really easy B, a little harder to get an A. Would take again.

STAY AWAY. I don't get why there are so many good reviews, perhaps these are only for his intro to marketing courses. I took his class for MKTG3301, and I wish I didn't. His grading is unfair. Even if you participate lots and work hard in his class, it doesn't matter. Prof. seems to take joy in students' pain and none in their success.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: 2 or more absences - grade lowers. You will also have to participate and talk in class to earn participation grade. Exam grading may be a little vague and disputable but that is because marketing isn't math. Overall, good and experienced professor who will make you work for a good grade.

Was very well aligned with the student's interests and makes it very clear on how to approach the class. He is a humorous guy and his lectures are quite engaging. Recommend 10/10, extremely solid and knowledgeable professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Prof DePaoli was such a gem to have. His lectures were very clear, engaging and funny that they will make you want to listen. All the relevant information is on the ppts for the exam and his exams are not too difficult, but he is a definite fair grader. Such a funny person with a friendly personality too, made me LOVE the field of marketing A LOT!
The best teacher I have had at Northeastern University so far, 10/10 would recommend him as a teacher, and I would definitely take his class again!

Prof. DePaoli is by far the best teacher I have had in my freshman year at NEU. His lectures are amazing, and the class discussions he holds are very interesting as he allows you to be open but at the same time contribute effective towards the course. Tests are not hard, but you must know your marketing knowledge which he provides in his ppts.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Most knowledgable professor I've had. He seems to know everything about the world, its pretty amazing. His exams are actually enjoyable and really interesting because they relate to current real-world stuff so well. Would definitely take him again
He lectures and lectures are interesting and engaging. Prof. DePaoli provides clear grading criteria and would willing to give you feedback. I would choose him again if I could!

Prof. DePaoli is an interesting and hilarious person. You wouldn't feel his lectures boring even though it is merely intro to marketing course. He would quickly reply e-mails you sent asking questions. CHOOSE his if you can.

I choose him for 8a.m. course with no regret. He gives amazing lectures and welcome to questions. Prof. DePaoli is smart and charming, he grade stuffs nicely and always respect his students. Choose him if you have the opportunity to do so, maybe you would even shift your major to marketing!

He lectures but lectures are interesting and you always get chance to participate in class (give examples or explain terminology). Prof. DePaoli provides clear grading criteria and always try to give grades to his students. You can ask him questions and he can give you good answers. Choose him for your intro. to marketing course with no regret!

Alexander DePaoli is always accessible outside class, you can just shot him an e-mail and he would respond quickly towards the question you ask. He also has the capability to make intro to marketing course funny and interesting. Even though A is not granted, he always see the effort you put into this course. Good professor, strongly recommend!

reviews.comment: Prof. DePaoli is a good prof and really smart, he makes marketing pretty interesting even if you aren't a fan of the subject. This is his first time teaching at NEU, or undergrads in general but he solicits lots of feedback to try to improve. Overall the class is NOT hard, but attendance (BE ON TIME) and participation are really important.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I don't love the field of marketing, but he makes it fun and engaging, plus he occasionally roasts annoying students which is fun. As long as you are paying attention in class and add to the discussion, participation won't be a problem. Very little homework, which is just part of participation grade. Textbook and slides are all you need to study.

First year teaching undergrads, so it was a very demanding class for intro to marketing. Participation is mandatory so is attendance, very strict on those two. Lots of reading before class. First test was difficult with lost of case studies, second was easier and less content. He does ask for feedback in class, so he is trying to improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: All he does at school is teaching and he's not even good at it

Perhaps one of the greatest professors I ever had the pleasure of taking a course with. He prints out notes for each lecture and walks through them with vigor and understanding. Those who are giving this guy bad reviews do not know ball. This is a professor who tries fervently to help his students understand and appreciate the field of EE.

Farhat's lectures are very engaging and explain the material well. He provides notes in-class and has office hours multiple times a week. He is very tough but everything that he says is incredibly useful. He will make you do it right.

Horrible all around - NEU please donate my tuition to one of the Youtube creators helping us get through this course. Amir assigns hideously long HW that is unrelated to course material. Professor Farhat is definitely the hardest professor I have ever had. While he might have been the hardest, he knows everyone can succeed if they put in the work. Unnecessarily challenging, abundance of HW, tests are brutal, little help given. avoid at all costs

I took Prof. Farhat's class for EECE2412 Fundamentals of Electronics (not 2142). I was quite unsure of taking a class with him and thought that I might move to the next section. Beast of a prof.

The course has a stupid notion of self-eval with dumb questions in them. The code walks are worse. Yeah there are no extra credits no useful help to make up your losses

Super caring. Echoing all previous reviews. Take him if you can! I look forward to his lectures!! I wish i was able to have him for every class. He makes you feel calm and puts you in the mood to learn.
He is a real gem. Awesome lectures and if you follow all instructions and focus on all his assignments you will learn a lot from his course.
tough grader but awesome teacher, useful assignments and hard test. You have to spend lots of time on his class. Students can learn many valuable knowledge and stuff through the course.
He is just amazing. Makes you love the course. If you just pay attention to his lectures you are good for the concepts. Best course. Best professor.

reviews.comment: The best professor I've ever had as far as teaching is concerned. Good sense of humor and always keeps the class lively. Grading is tough though.

Professor Shesh's class was among the most difficult I've taken, but I'm much better as a student and as a programmer for having taken his class. He is the nicest professor ever and extremely leniant with late assignments and absences. He really cares about the subject and preparing his students for the real world. I would definitely reccomend taking him if you want to learn useful skills in a low stakes environment.

Dr. Apfeld is so kind, flexible, and passionate about the content.

Dr.Apfeld isn't the best lecturer, but it's easy to succeed if you review lectures, teach yourself, and complete all homework and review materials. He is not so great at lecture/oral presentation skill, but he is a GREAT teacher, he cares about you and gives you good grade and a lots of extra credits, he is always there if u want to reach out outside of class. I had to admit that he so far the only prof who actually cared about their student and their grades after high school.

Professor Apfeld is very kind and actually quite funny at times. His fatal flaw is that he tends to mumble his way through lectures and it is quite impossible to stay engaged in class. With that said, all of the tests are online and open note so it is easy to get a good grade.

Good guy, and not the hardest class, but a few things: do the hw at the end of lectures and be prepared to pull out ones from past lectures for his quizzes, lecturing skills are mid so printing out the slides and jotting ideas down for review afterward might help more than full blown notes, and tests do have problems that require a lotta practice.

There's tophat questions every class. You can look at the lectures ahead of time on canvas and find the answers on quizlet. None of the tophat questions are on the exams. reviews.comment: I love Professor Apfeld so much!! He really cares about his students and takes your feedback on the class into serious consideration. Personality wise professor apfeld is so understanding and actually cares about your mental health Quizzes and Tophat questions were easy Exams were somewhat confusing but fair- please do the practice exams Hes open to any questions in office hours but doesnt really answer them well during lectures Mediocre lecturer, reads off slides a lot

Dr. Apfeld doesn't really go too in depth with the material, and usually reads off of powerpoint slides. Not too helpful when in need of some clarification for some material. Generally a nice man, but does not make things clear enough for his students.

good!

calc is a hard class. professor appel makes it much easier. put in the work and pay attention to her lecture and do every homework problem and the tests will be a breeze for you.

Prof Aparece was thorough and very passionate about Orgo Chem. He works hard to try and explain concepts to students and assist them in understanding them. Aparece is by far the best professor I've had in the science department. He is so knowledgable, funny, and personable. I took chemistry before professor Aparece but he really helped me understand the topics I was confused about. He held office hours in chem central and made himself super accessible. I would definitely take him again.

Aparece was one of the best professors I've had. He explains things in a very clear way and he always prepares for his lectures. Holds lots of office hours.

An amazing professor who really cares about his students. I took orgo 2 in the summer, and he continuously adjusted the syllabus to our tight schedule. Horrible teacher poor communication never thought a class could be so bad

Really nice teacher teaching an incredibly easy class. You'll watch a lot of movies and if you suggest any movie and have a reason for suggesting it, chances are she'll let the class watch it. Extremely approachable, by far my favorite first semester professor.

Great Professor who cares about each student. Case every week and 2 presentations during the semester with some lectures. you don't know your grade until the end of the semester but he really emphasizes participation and being engaged in class. Great class if you want to go into marketing but, it is a lot of work. Couldn't recommend enough!
great guy, had him in spring 2025

This is the BEST professor I've ever met at Northeastern! You can definitely take his course if it meets your credit standards. He is humorous and helpful to students. Excellent professor.  I had him as a composition instructor for several years and he was always friendly and open, and was very helpful with advising for my classes.  He was always available for office appointments.  A great musician as well.

Oh Tony is FULL of himself. You'll hear all about the fact he did the music for the 1997 Macworld Game of the Year. He'll walk away from you when you're talking to him. Needs to be more amiable, being the freaking CHAIR of the music department.

head of the dept. thinks he's god...he's not. never in his office for office hours, thinks most students are wasting his time and sends them away from him to their department advisor. needs some new people skills.
