Extremely good professor who is nice and cool

Drew is a nice dude. Took algo with him and loved it. For Theory of Comp, the course structure is awkward. We spent most of the time on FSA, the relatively easy stuff. On undecidability and complexity, he went through large amount of content in a short amount of time. The assignments are only out of 30 points so there isn't any room for error.

Drew is GOLDEN. One of the best professors I've met at Northeastern. Theoretical courses are tough for most people, but I enjoyed his lectures for this semester's computation theory, which has the clearest structures and slides. He's super inclusive about questions and comments, and actively responds to students' confusion/discussions. 20/10!
I forgot to fill out TRACE, so I'll leave my review here. Drew is an awesome professor. Lectures are good, and the content is taught well. You will learn a lot in his class.
Van Der Poel is a great lecturer and helpful in office hours. Good dude.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Van Der Poel is great. His lectures are direct and interesting. He makes difficult concepts easy to understand. Definitely recommend taking his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great guy, pretty good at explaining tough concepts and answering questions from the class. Really tried to keep everyone engaged especially over zoom.
He is really good professor. I have learn a lot of useful CS useful knowledge from his class. Definitly recommend to take his class.
Clear in explaining ideas, patient with all students and being fun with answering questions. Would definitely take his class again if I have a chance.

Drew is absolutely a gem and amazing in Algorithms! He does not assume that students know the pre-requisites and covers every topic right from the foundation and gradually advances the level. Graphs are the best! Assignments are well designed to cover lecture concepts, med to high difficulty. Definitely recommend him! You won't regret :)

Least intimidating professor I've taken so far. Very humble, down to earth. Very accomodating to confused students, and was extremely accessible throughout the course. Homework grading was slow but he released solutions asap, so that didn't matter. Lenient, lots of extra credit, yet still learned a lot from in. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Humble, relatable fellow. He gives precrastinators a chance to stay ahead (ha) in the class schedule by releasing lectures the day before. Very open to incredibly stupid questions (a lot of which asked by me). Slow grading, makes it difficult to fix up approaches to homework. Also hardly available on Friday/weekends (at least for summer).
Did a great job teaching the course in the pandemic. Always reachable on piazza and outside. Makes regrading interesting by introducing challenges.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He takes things seriously, but is also ridiculously in touch with college aged students (probably has something to do with his age, but he's also generally a cool guy). Took a tough situation with a hard class (COVID semester) and made the material accessible nonetheless. I would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. She genuinely cares about her students and makes sure everyone understands the requirements and materials. Just study decent for the exams and you will be so good.
Pritchett's the goat

Prof Pritchett is super sweet and caring. Her lectures are pretty densely packed with information from the textbook, so it might be hard to follow at times. However, if you just take some time to review in your own time, you'll do fine on the exams. They're very straight forward and she prepares you perfectly for the questions you'll see.
I LOVEEE Pritchett. If you need to take Profit Analysis, please take her course!! She's amazing
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at Northeastern. She is extremely approachable and does a great job connecting with students, which makes the class feel engaging and supportive. Her teaching style is clear and effective, and she explains course topics in a way that is easy to understand.

Sometimes the slideshow lectures can get stale, but when she is going over practice problems, that is when you want to pay attention because those problems are reflected on the exams. She genuinely wants everyone to do well in the course, and clearly tells us what problems are going to be on the exam. Attendance is mandatory.

I absolutely LOVE and ADORE Professor Pritchett. As a Business student required to take Profit Analysis, I was expecting any class I signed up for to be incredibly boring/hard, but Pritchett is super caring of her students & wants you to succeed. 2 midterms, 1 final group project, and 1 in-person final. Midterms are easy if you study! Good luck

Took class during the summer. Made the content extremely easy to understand and grounded it in real-world applications. Ive heard this is meant to be a tricky subject but she made it very manageable and straightforward. Also the curve is AMAZING. Great teacher

Took Professor Pritch for the summer. Was intimidated by her at first but after a few weeks I realized that she is pretty darn nice. My advice is to go to her office hours bc I did that once and she treated me with such grace and kindness for the rest of it. Accounting aint easy, but she made it a lot easier. She could have made it horrible but no!

Really nice professor. I recommend watching the videos inside the assigned textbook readings to learn the material. Exams reflect the difficulty of in-class practice problems and homework. She is really kind and willing to meet with you outside of class. The class consisted of two midterms, a final, homework, participation, and one project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor, will do well if you just read material, do homework and packets before tests.
Seriously one of the kindest professors I've had at Northeastern, always comes ready to teach! Her test are straightforward just do the homework and class packet and you'll be golden.

Very easy, especially if you participate in class and are doing the hw correctly. I def could've gotten a higher grade. She teaches well, gives amazing feedback and is willing to help each and everyone of her students. Overall one of the few great teachers I've had.
Good teacher

Prof Pritchett is SO SWEET, caring and clear about what you need to do to succeed. She is very helpful outside of class as well so if youre confused just go to office hours. Just put in the effort for accounting and you'll be fine.

Professor Pritchett is a really good professor who is clearly passionate about accounting. Accounting really just wasn't for me though, so I don't blame the professor for anything because it's a hard subject to make fun. She is a very nice woman who is willing to go out of her way to explain a concept that you might not understand.

Great person, but not the best prof. Isn't the best at explaining things but tries a lot and cares for every student. Quizzes are online/open book & get 3 attempts for a better grade but were worth barely anything. HW had unlimited attempts. 1 group project & only in person tests were midterm & final. Definitely take her if you want an easy A.
Very knowledgable about accounting and is generally very caring about her students, but uses time very ineffectively in her lectures and is pretty textbook heavy.

By far one of the most caring professors I've had at Northeastern. She really makes it a point to encourage her students to speak up if something does not make sense. Her tests are easy, and lectures are not necessarily stressful. Participation is graded so just show up to class and ask questions.

While she demonstrated some enthusiasm for the course she was almost never effective in her teaching or use of class time. This combines with some difficulty with English to ensure that the mandatory lectures were almost entirely a waste of time. Formula sheets are allowed for the tests and the class is not particularly difficult.

Dr. Otero was great. The textbook is free and online. It is not used for the class, but it is beneficial for self-study. Her tests go more in depth then the lectures, so be well-versed with the material. There is extra credit, she cares about you & your success, and she is approachable. She made class enjoyable and is personable. I recommend her.

I do not recommend taking this course, it was not worth the struggle. The lectures were boring and based on disorganized slides, and the exams were super difficult and based on small slide details. She also left some harsh comments on a few assignments. I just don't recommend taking this elective when there are other enjoyable classes out there.

higk shes great. i went to office hours often and i was originally supposed to get a B+ but ended up with an A- (AYYYY). you don't really need to use the textbooks. if u download the slides, all of her notes are in the speaker notes section. biggest tip is DO THE ASSIGNED PRACTICE QUESTIONS on time. its relatively similar to her exam questions

Grade is heavily based on midterms which she doesn't curve or offer corrections anymore and the questions are worded so confusingly. The tests go way more into detail than lecture and you have to study so much to get a good grade. That being said she is passionate about the subject and very positive and funny.

She was a good professor that explained the slideshows pretty well. However, some test questions were not even remotely related to the slideshows' content, hence averages in the 60's and 70's on all three tests. However, she offers many extra credit opportunities, so if you spend at least a week studying, and do the extra credit, you will do fine.

She lectures a lot and can be difficult to keep focused. You are expected to memorize an unrealistic amount of small details from all of the slides. A lot of your grade relies on her exams and the wording on the questions makes the entire exam feel like a riddle. Choose another elective unless you want an unnecessary amount of work.

Decent course. Her notes are clear, but if you want to do well on her tests, READ THE TEXTBOOK. It clarifies everything, and teaches you much more effectively and thoroughly. 3 exams and a final, all MCQ. She teaches simple concepts. All of the questions on her tests are application-based, not concept-based. Take note of these and you'll do fine.

Professor Otero is great! She's super friendly and funny, and I never felt nervous going up to her after class with questions. Lectures can be a bit monotonous, which is generally unavoidable in Biology. Attendance is via a daily poll, but you can get 100% with 80% attendance. Exams have some hard questions, but study and you'll be fine!

Dr. Otero is a great professor! I highly recommend you have some biology background before you take her class, but overall, she's great. She uses Poll Everywhere in every class, so make sure you show up for that. Exams are all multiple choice and offer many extra credit opportunities.

So much content over such a variety of topics; expected to remember every detail from the lectures. Way too much memorization and impossible to do well on the two exams, which are a huge part of the gradeI
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: MUCH easier than AP biology as the tests are all multiple choice, lectures can be boring and wordy, but no homework so everything is based on the 3 midterms and final, the tests are like not super hard but not easy, just don't procrastinate studying, 90% of test material was taught in class but she does have some random questions thrown in

I don't get why so many people gave her bad reviews on here. Lectures can be boring, but overall the content wasn't too much. Lecture slides can be a little messy, but she usually supplements with details in class and will tell you when to remember something she said that wasn't on the slides. Tests are pretty easy and all multiple choice.

Deceptively easy class until you get to the tests. Very kind professor who gives a lot of examples and tries to connect with the class, but you will be surprised at the amount of content on tests that was barely covered or not covered in class. Go more in depth then you think you will need to and learn to think critically and you will be fine.
Chill class just don't submit work late. She's also super accessible outside of class to help with the final project. Quizzes and final test are easy - just read the slides

Super easy, lectures were boring. All of her tests are free-response and direct copies of the slides she presents in class. Her class difficulty is similar to a high-school level AP Environmental Studies class and there was no final - just a project. If you're looking for an easy A or GPA booster, this is the class for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Terrible class... however, if you're deciding between her and Potts-Santone probably take Otero. Avoid this class if you can, but if you must take it: memorize every slide in the presentation and before the exam, practice with the textbook problems she provides (you'll get an A). Test corrections (class averages in the 60s ->70s) and final curved.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Otero honestly gets a bad rep. Yes, her lectures can get boring, but they're recorded and attendance isn't required. Her exams are all memorization so study just about everything and don't cram. Look at the slides and do the practice questions she provides because they're very similar to the exam. Also lots of opportunities for extra credit!
She truly is nice and her class is fun but her tests are so hard, you really need to study a lot and it is the bulk of our grade...

Do NOT do NOT take Dr Otero. Her lecture slides are very disorganized and do not contain things that are on the exam. Her exams are very very difficult and very long, around 60-70 questions. The only thing good about the class are the online take home quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ana Otero is one of the worst professors I've had at Northeastern. Her content is very disorganized and the questions that she gives on exams are so niche that you can't even take an educated guess on them. Her lectures are a little useless because she does not know how to teach the content well enough for us. beware taking otero.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is one of the worst professors in my opinion that Northeastern has to offer. She does not lecture well at all. She is extremely disorganized and does not know how to teach. She gives only 2 midterms with a final. They are about 60-70 questions long. She does give a lot of extra credit. Content is so boring and she does not know how to teach.

Ana Otero is one of worst professors I have ever had. Her powerpoints are very disorganized and there is so much specific information that you have to know for her tests. Me and my friend studied so much to only get 60s - 70s on Otero's exams. Luckily she gives corrections but honestly her tests are pretty unforgiving and challenging. Beware!!
Honestly dont even know how to study for the final.... she lacks study materials.. be prepared to teach yourself

Textbook work is not required but very helpful for doing well on exams. Exams are content heavy and sometimes focus on trace details but her review Q's are sometimes on the exam so definitely do the outside work. Not much required homework so grade is based mostly on exams; 1111 is a tough class and 1113 is a snooze but she is a very nice woman.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's hilarious + explains concepts very well with good slides. Records lectures, 2 exams 1 final. If you have questions during an exam just ask her for help. She wants you to do well even if she seems passive aggressive! I relied on funny acronyms, bio rap songs, and quizzing my friends to study. This is not a class you can last minute cram in!
exams never felt like they were on the material, but outside assignments and lots of extra credit help

READ THE TEXTBOOK- exams are much more in-depth than the lecture slides go. Had to spend a lot of time outside of lecture learning the material bc slides are super basic. She's nice though and lots of extra credit as well as test corrections.

i think otero is a good and engaging professor! there are many extra credit opportunities. activities can drag out but they're ungraded so dw about it. 

tips: the slides are very basic; to pass the exams you need to read the textbook and do all the practice problems she provides. exams are more difficult than what is discussed in class. 3.5/5!

Would read the slides in class and sometimes do a class activity. Attendance was checked by doing a poll everyday. Her slides were kind of basic but the exam was on detailed content. Definitely read the textbook and study in advance to exams. Thankfully she gave test corrections and have lots of extra credit opportunities.

This class was for sure interesting... Her lectures were essentially devoid of content except for our second unit, at least in my opinion. She seems to only teach the basics, but then gives us exams with questions that are far beyond the scope of what she teaches in class. She doesn't really say you need to read the textbook, but you def need to!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Take this class with a different prof like McElligott or Grabiner. Do not take Otero.

She is extremely unapproachable and her tests are impossible unless you've already taken bio or have time to teach yourself every concept. She offers test corrections but only for the most commonly missed questions. She does not curve or round grades. She is very cold during office hours and does not care how you do.

She is a very good teacher. She gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and test corrections on both midterms worth 40% of our grade. However, her tests are relatively hard and you might have to self teach yourself a lot to understand the questions fully. I took her for Bio 1 and will be taking for Bio 2.

Love Professor Otero! She's super sweet and she genuinely cares about students. In order for me to understand the material I had to do a lot of self-learning with the textbook because her lectures are super basic, but the exams are super difficult and in-depth. Average is usually in 60s. She gives corrections though. 2 midterms, 40%. 1 final, 25%.

She comes off as nice and funny, but the lectures and slides were very unhelpful. I only went to class because we were graded on attendance. The tests are incredibly hard and do not reflect the slides. Tests: 40% of grade and finals 25%. If you want to succeed in this class, read the textbook chapters and do the practice questions from the textbook
Tests are really hard and not a reflection of what we go over in class

It is impossibly difficult for an introductory course unless you have extensive practice with Biology. the people who did well took AP bio. She will joke around in class but is super judgemental during office hours and doesn't make study guides. There are test corrections but only for the most commonly missed questions.

Ana is extremely passive aggressive and unhelpful during office hours which makes her extremely unapproachable. Her tests have no correlation to lectures or anything she posts, so if you have her be prepared to essentially teach yourself every topic.

If you can take any professor other than Ana, do it. Her tests are impossible, she is extremely unapproachable, and doesn't care how you do. Says the textbook isn't required but it is. Lectures do not match test content. Do. Not. Take. Bio. With. Her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Otero is an awesome prof, easily accessible outside of class. If you attend class, do the optional assignments, do the textbook reading and generally pay attention you will pass the class. There are corrections on both the quizzes (the average will be in the 60s) and a curve on the final.

*PERSONAL TIPS* If you DOWNLOAD her slides off Canvas, you have access to the speaker notes with ADDITIONAL detail that you can read to actually understand. People say that the class is textbook dependent, but it's more important to know how to interpret the exam questions that she asks. I reccommend taking ONLINE AP BIOLOGY practice quizzes.

Honestly, the attendance is not mandatory, but you can go if you want to. I most definitely recommend getting the textbook and using it as a guide to get through the class. The exams are hard and not anything like the classwork, or take home quizzes. Good luck!

Prof Otero is a very very nice person, but her lectures are a little confusing. The only way to be succesful in the class is to go to lecture, and read the entirety of the textbook. READ THE TEXTBOOK she says you don't have to, and no one does, and then the average on the exams are 60s. If you read the textbook, and go to lecture, you can get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The exams are crazy bc we have extra problems in the exam, the other professor only tested anround 30 questions. Everyone receives about a 60s in her class while exam counts more than 60% of our grades.

This class is impossible to do well in. There are only two exams plus the final, which all cover way too much content for anyone to succeed. The class average was always in the 60s. She is nice during lectures but when going to office hours she is usually extremely unhelpful/unapproachable. Exams are heavily based on textbook and oddly specific.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ana's video lectures didn't go into much detail, so topics were mostly self-taught from the textbook. The assignments were pretty easy, but extremely subjective. There is no partial credit or thorough explanation of a grade. Her grading system is a bit strange (everything is 20%). Exams are very specific and based on the textbook and Ana's videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Otero is a better option for Bio 2 than Potts-Santone, but the lectures are quite dull and there's tons of material to learn for each exam because they're basically all term-focused. The tests are pretty unforgiving but she gives exam corrections for partial points. Bio 2 is just ecology so if you have AP credit take only Bio 1 instead.
Amazing professor!

She a very lovely professor, but her tests are impossible, and often, her lectures don't teach anything. You must read the textbook to prepare for tests since her lectures only cover 30% of the test. One hint for her tests is she typically will make a majority of the test about the most recent topics (including the finals exams topics).

Otero was such a fun and caring prof. She genuinely cares about her class and listens to feedback. She would give breaks during class, and tell jokes/funny stories. She allows test corrections on certain problems and extra credit opportunities. Textbook is not required, nor used, unless for some practice problems to study with. Take her for BIO2!

Prof Otero is a good professor, I learned a lot in the lectures but it helps more if you do the homework readings. But her exams are terrible, despite studying and understanding the concept I would still get really low scores. And I still have no idea how or why but she does give exam corrections only for specific problems on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Extremely kind and knows the material! Very helpful, but exams can be difficult/unclear based on learning in class. Overall great prof!

Prof. Otero is spunky and fun! She tries to make lectures enjoyable by incorporating jokes and encouraging peer conversation. However, her tests are rather difficult, and I recommend doing the assigned readings and studying. If you put in the effort and do all the assignments, it's definitely possible to get an A.

Ana Otero is a kind professor who listens and answers questions. Her classes are tough and require time and effort. She offers extra videos and readings, which are helpful but not required. If you're short on time, consider a different class.

Prof Otero is a nice lady and sometimes funny, but her whole whole class is based off of reading the textbook. I'm not paying thousands of dollars to read a text book we need to ALSO PAY $80 for. I also never took AP bio and her lectures aren't very good so I was even more confused in the end. If you haven't taken bio, don't take Otero.
She is a great teacher and is passionate about her students and the subject taught. She is very understanding and also is super accessible outside of class. Class is super easy

Very bad teacher when it comes to teaching material. I had taken bio in the past and somehow I felt more confused in the class. Lectures are not clear and does not go over all the material on exams. However, she is a very nice person, funny in class, and gives lots of extra credit opportunity. She is very accessible outside of class.

You have to get the textbook (~$80, digital per semester) and it's associated software for homework. Attendance taken every lecture through polleverywhere (5% of grade). Do the pre-class work, even though her lectures are quite elementary her tests use more textbook knowledge. Three midterms all have corrections!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Shes a sweetheart. Class was very easy and she cares about her students. Accessible outside of class and works to make sure everyone understands and gets good grades.

Dr. Otero was a great professor. Took the inquiries section of Climate Change and she made sure that the material given was interesting. She provided a lot of help with the research project. Her exams are fairly easy to pass if you use the study guides she gives. Attendance matters tho and it can be easy to not want to go to a class like inquiries.

Her tests are pretty difficult and are entirely mutiple choice so there is no way to show your knowledge. I am pretty sure she does not write her own tests and gets them off of the internet so in my opinion they are not geared towards the class. I did not like this class at all and this was my lowest grade due to her harsh tests.

Great professor! It's nice to have a professor actually interested and experienced in what they do, and it shows from the way she teaches. Class based off exams, homework, participation, and a few extra credit opportunities. Slides and study guide need some work, but she's great overall. Also, there's opportunities for test corrections! Lifesaver

By far my favorite professor/class at Northeastern. There are 4 take home assignments, 3 quizzes, and 3-4 assignments that work towards your final research poster presentation. There is a lot of in-class group work, but it's nothing high stakes. One of the funniest professors I have ever had, very accessible, understanding, and knowledgeable.

Otero is a good professor. Tests are super easy and based directly off the notes posted online. Can sometimes cold call, so make sure to read course materials. A very easy class as long as you attend class and study the notes.
Prof otero is really sweet and really cares about her students. Her exams were a bit challenging but her office hours are a big help. there are other assignments that make up for the overall grade.
Her class is so boring, struggled to stay awake. Work is easy overall but she's just not engaging. Quizzes are also all open response and she expects u to remember random words for them.

Second time taking this professor and I'm so glad I did. Just go to class and do the work and you will get a good grade. Quizzes are really easy and professor is very understanding and kind. She loves students who go to office hours and communicate as much as possible. Already planning on taking a 3rd course of hers next semester!

Extremely verbose guy to the point that assignments are difficult to parse through to figure out what he actually wants from you. Only 4 assignments for the whole semester, 2 of which are kind of useless. Very slow grader with relatively inconsistent feedback, but easy A if you follow the rubric and scattered instructions in his lengthy documents.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Solid teacher & good guy, class is very politically polarizing which is annoying. Show up to class and you'll do fine.

I enjoyed Akbari. He's passionate and enjoys talking about currents events. He loves to laugh at his own jokes (which usually aren't funny), but overall I really don't have much to complain about. If you're a strong writer this class will be very easy, but he will also try to push you to get better. The four major essays determine the grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Extremely good feedback on your writing. You only get feedback once a paper is submitted. Professor is extremely kind and caring, always available to chat.

Tom is a great professor who really cares about his students. The class was not easy, but he explained our goals for each unit well and allowed us to structure our work how we saw fit. This is the only English class I can say I enjoyed. Thank you, Tom!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I hate writing in general, but he's the reason why I still show up to class and want to do my best. He's an overall good person and professor. Ask for feedback and you'll get it, it's a small class anyways. He remembers the littlest things you say, so he remembers you and it makes me feel I am cared for. Nice grader as long as you put some effort.
He is the BEST! His assignments are hard yet interesting and he is very inspiring and caring, but you need to work hard to get a good grade.

Just the absolute best. I've never had a professor that's so engaging, funny, down to earth, and smart all at the same time. You'd be hard pressed to find another professor who teaches a mandatory class (First-Year Writing) with the same enthusiasm. Please participate though, he really values everyone's input, and deserves all your attention.

"How did Tom Akbari treat his students during COVID-19?" Absolutely hands down the best professor I've seen across multiple universities. Helped students move with his own personal van when everyone was kicked off-campus housing, sent emails immediately asking about personal situations and whether they needed help or aid. He ��checked ��in ��!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor was intimidated by actual writing in the sciences. He had no clue about basic scientific literature, and clearly needs to become more updated in the field. I would avoid taking at all costs, this class will make you a worse writer
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I LOVE Tom! He is such a good professor and hilarious. I love when he makes a "dad" jokes and is the only one laughing. Seriously though, he is a pretty chill guy and is super nice. Take him!

I'm having a genuinely great time in his class. He gives a lot of reading and there's only a few papers, but if the class didn't get to all of the reading or isn't satisfied with drafts, he's good about giving more time. Cares more about the craft than running with the syllabus. Plus he's really nice, an I personally like his lame jokes!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Don't be afraid if you get 5 hours of homework in one weekend. Deadlines for papers are reasonable for the most part.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: take him he's cool

Relies heavily on peer reviews and doesn't give his own feedback on rough drafts before final papers are due. Only grades final papers (only feedback you get is after final grade) & grades as if he told you what you had done wrong & you didn't fix it. Feedback & instruction is lengthy, sometimes hard to understand.  10/10 would suggest dif prof.
he clearly failed at being a writer and now thinks his adjunct professor elective classes are doctoral symposiums on literature.

Thinks everything he says is the funniest thing in the world. Also tries to sound like the smartest person ever. Feedback on papers is hard to understand, given you don't know many of the words he uses. Overall,  class is decent, lots of discussion, no busy work.

Akbari definitely gives good feedback on papers, and they're pretty easy. However, many of the classes we spent entirely peer editing ordiscussing our paper ideas with the class, which was useless. Take advanced writing in the disciplines online andsave yourslef the time.

On the first day of class, Akbari spent the allotted 100 min going the syllabus. He comes to class prepared only to talk about a few topics and refuses to lecture; he relies on the class for discussion, but when we try to bring up slightly more intelligent topics he just stares and continues talking about his shallow topics of choice. Bad prof.

Mediocre Professor. Doesn't really teach anything to help your writing get beyond high school level, but he could be worse. His lectures are useless, but when he gives individual attention to a paper, he sometimes genuinely surprises me with his stellar advice. The best part is that he thinks he's hilarious, doesn't notice silence after his jokes.

I took Advanced Writing in Literature with Tom Akbari. His lectures are repetitive, he refuses to clarify anything, and is very close-minded despite his lip service to open-mindedness. Absolutely do not take a class with him.

She always accounts for student feedback and creates a relaxed environment. I never felt stressed about her class this semester.

Where do I begin. Oh boy. She will either hate you or like you. No in between. Prefers girls or guys and will let you know. One of the most direct professors I have ever had the unfortunate liberty of having. I have so much time on my hands that I would write a FOUL review. But here are my final words. 

Avoid at all costs. A big NO.
Listen well and take good notes.

The class content seems needlessly convoluted and academic, but that might just be the nature of ORGB. Aksehirli keeps class engaging but expects very thorough knowledge of said content (especially theories). Solid professor who actually listens to student feedback, would recommend if you can look past the very heavy use of textbook content.
Very tough tests but I loved him as a professor.
Drakula was a very lecture heavy professor, we had no in class activities to engage ourselves and his exams were extremely difficult. If you don't read the textbook, you wont pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Foundations with Dr. Akula was not good. His exams are difficult even after paying attention and studying for hours/days to the point where only 4 people in a 114 person class got an A on the exam. He also regularly made a majority of the class uncomfortable by making unnecessary, out of line comments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: -I would not take a class with him again. Even if you study everything covered in lecture in detail, you will at best get a B on exams. -Speaks without a filter and says some very questionable things during lecture -Overall, would not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His "Good morning friends" really makes the class for me. I wouldn't suggest asking him a question and expecting him to answer it but overall he is very accomodating to students and grades fairly.  His lectures are a bit dull and he repeats himself a lot but overall its a good class.

can be boring to sit through, do have to do quick presentation then term paper and present that..one midterm...didn't use my book and still got an A in class, not as bad as some people make him sound..loves to smile starts class with "yes, friends"
Exams were based on the class notes; book & articles were not used. Term paper & presentation required.
Kate's teaching quality is very high. The course difficulty is appropriate, and she explains details very clearly. I learned a lot from this class.

professor ashley is really nice and attentive. she provides lots of outside of class feedback and support and very easy to talk to so i do like her lectures. the material itself though is very challenging— lots of work, 4 heavy projects throughout the semester. there are 2 exams which we can bring notes in so should be easy if you actually study.

Prof. Ashley is very by the book, rubric grading, but took FOREVER to get grades back to us. The amount spent on the class as a whole outside of going to class was very minimal, but if you don't pay attention you end up having to teach yourself everything. The final project is with a real company and gives real experience. Hardest content is R code
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors, so kind… and actually takes the time to interact with her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly an amazing professor! She was super sweet and bubbly, open to extensions on assignments, and responds to emails super quick. Also not a harsh grader which was great since we had presentations.
Very energetic and uplifting! Grading criteria is clear, and feedback is thorough. She cares a lot about her students, and makes the content interesting. Take her for Health Comm!

HAD HER FOR COMM3230 INTERPERSONAL COMM (it wasnt listed here)-- Best professor I've ever had in the comms department as a 5th year. She is bubbly, very personable, caring, understanding and flexible for the student needs. She makes it very easy to do well and breaks down the material in a fun, modern way. Highly recommend.
Great professor, super passionate, and very real!

literally one of the kindest profs I've had! She's extremely understanding about her student's circumstances. She's a really engaging professor b/c you can tell she cares about her work. Her course is pretty chill+ she provides rubrics for her assignments. She made public speaking very comfortable so imo i definitely got better at presenting.

Professor Shields is an awesome professor who definitely knows what she is teaching, she also brings crazy energy to the classroom no matter what time the class is. in terms of grading she's pretty chill, she gives rubrics that clearly outline the scope of the assignments and there is no final exam! super sweet, understanding and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ashleigh is one of the most enthusiastic and passionate teachers I have had so far. She is an engaging lecturer and really cares about her students. She made public speaking seem not as frightening.
Professor Shields is so nice, caring, and kind. She is super enthusiastic everyday in class and is very understanding. She's an easy grader and a great person. Definitely take her for PHTH 2300.
Dr. Shields is great! Very humble, kind, and wants to see her students do well.  She makes class fun.

Professor Shields is one of the best instructors I've ever had in my life. She cares so much about what she is doing and teaching, as well as each student. She is very understanding of life outside her class, and will always be accommodating. A good mixture of assignments and the course is very engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof. Shields is a very genuine and kind person, you can truly tell that she cares for all her students. She's a super easy grader and all of the quizzes are pretty easy too.

Prof Shields is full of energy and is super sweet. She makes lectures entertaining and keeps you engaged. She's very lenient about grades/deadlines/etc. I loved the projects and graded assignments she gave us.

She makes lecture engaging by asking questions about your thoughts. For presentations, public speaking is evaluated and she does exercises during class to prepare for that. She's so nice and energetic. Gives feedback and cares about her students. Projects back to back because it was a summer class.

i didnt love prof. shields. she kinda treated the class like it was a high school level in the way she taught it, lots of in class activities, group projects, buzzfeed quizzes? I wasn't really intellectually stimulated. If that's your vibe go for it, the class was easy, i just didnt like how she spoke to students, like we were kids and not adults.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Shields cares about her students and wants us to succeed, so she always gives good feedback on our assignments and presentations. Participation is very important but this is a given since this is a communication class, and be prepared for a lot of presentations/group work. Only critique is that some of what we learned was very theoretical

Professor Shields is wonderful and caring! For those who are scared to speak in front of people, she won't judge you ever. Make sure to read assigned chapters bc she does give pop quizzes where one has to summarize in front of the class. She is so nice and understanding!!! TAKE HER CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Ashley is the best professor I have had during my time at Northeastern. I am a senior and she is so knowledgable about consumer behavior and is a caring grader. She really cares about you as a person and knows every one of her students by name. I highly recommend this class if you are interested in consumer behavior + discussion based class.

Ashley is a fantastic teacher, one of the best in the marketing department. I loved the discussion based class and the fact that Ashley was able to integrate her industry knowledge. The course material was extremely interesting and I loved working with my classmates. As other reviews mention, participation is HUGE, start talking early in semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dont take this class if you are not a discussion, actively participate person. Require you to speak in every class and she will note down. All of the grades are subjective and she does not show grade on canvas.
She's a great professor! The class was very discussion based and interesting.

Ashley was a wonderful professor. This was one of her first zoom classes and she worked very hard to make the class interesting even as an 8am. I especially appreciated she broke down the participation grade in several ways so you could still succeed in the class if speaking in a Zoom class made you anxious. Cares about her students.

I think this guy might be power tripping. He smiles watching students struggle to answer obscure and unclear questions that have no relevancy to anything he has taught us (which is essentially nothing), and expects a perfect answer. Worst professor of my life.

Imagine the worst qualities of a professor - mean, rude, unprepared, cruel, unfair, and terrible at teaching. Well, that's what we have here. He will yell at you for things that are out of your control, like not having a camera, or not knowing topics he never even taught. Quite honestly the biggest waste of money, and infuriating to say the least.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: HE IS THE GOAT

The worst professor I've had. Just don't take the class if it will be with him. He is extremely bossy, you don't learn anything. And btw, there's no rounding so if you get for example 89.8, he won't give you the A- which is 90%.

Do NOT take CS4520 with this professor unless you don't want to learn. You will be assigned time-consuming projects, to then be deducted points for random, and irrelevant stuff. No live coding, and lectures are very boring. 
If you take the class with him you won't learn unless you spend hours and hours on your own trying to figure things out.

lectures provide zero preparation for homework/projects which is the entire course grade. covers little to no code examples in class. left on your own to scour the internet for docs and code examples. a particular TA would CTRL+C CTRL+V our code into ChatGPT to grade, at least have the decency to actually grade. point deductions for random reasons

Very bad lecturer, he goes through the topics extremely fast, and explains very little. Doesn't provide code after lectures and has slides which are not readable at all. Very hard to learn, he just talks and doesn't even do much live coding. 
Takes a long time to answer Piazza posts.
One of the best professors I've had, breaks down technical papers so that they're clear, understandable, and interesting
Best Professor at Northeastern. Hard NOT to pay attention

I truly enjoyed Professor Asthagiri's course. He is incredibly knowledgeable  and has a way of simplyfing complex topics in a way that makes them easy to understand. Moreover, he maintains fairness in grading and is always available to help. He has become one of my favorite professors, and I hope to take another course w/ him soon.

Tough weekly exams (on Fridays. Lectures were convoluted on slideshows and not relevant to the exams. Went over very few examples in lectures and resorted to self-learning from the textbook + mini-lectures.

Prof. Asheghan did his best with the amount of material he had to teach in a short period of time. He is very approachable, enjoys interacting with students, and will go out of his way to help anyone who is struggling with concepts in the class.

The most eager professor to teach I have ever seen. The exams were somehow difficult, but we had three days for four problems and legally were allowed to use any external source. Moreover, the final score can be over 100 (Extra points) that compensates the exam difficulty. Helpful in private meetings.

Worst professor I've take at this school, although I am a second year. He blazes through notes made for him by pearson and they suck, his hand writing is chicken scratch. Also the midterms: The single worst test I have taken in my entire life, it was written like it had gone through google translate from 5 years ago a couple times. Do NOT Take.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lori is kind, her directions are straightforward, and she wants to make sure her students truly learn the content. If you complete the assignments as directed, you'll get a B+ or A-. She really makes you work for the A. Highly recommend contributing more than you think you need to and always including outside resources.

Lori's class is as difficult as you make it. Her instructions and expectations are crystal clear, so if you don't pay attention, you get what you deserve. Yes, participation matters, so all it takes is to show interest and join in discussions. She really knows the subject and went beyond to help me understand it. Inspirational! Thank you, Lori!

Even you speak more than 3 times on the class she still gives you a B- on your class participation, even you tried very hard to make your final paper perfect you may still eventually receive a very low score. Her classes are all very hard.
She is very unorganized and unclear with her instructions. She will give vague instructions and will give you a bad grade if your assignment isnt to her standards (which she doesnt tell you).

Lori is the most hardest grader ever!!!! She doesn't even know what QUITE literally mean. She might give you a C even you talked one or two times in the class. Even you prepared and spoke up more than 3 times, she might also say you are quite.
I never thought I was a good writer but this course made me realize how much I enjoy writing. The photo essay was probably the best unit. A nice break from the rest of my coursework.

I shouldnt have to take this course, I was in an IB program in high school, but all things considered it was a good class. Excpect lots of writing and peer review, and you need to participate in class convo.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Mina's class is very easy and she gives you a lot of time to write each essay. She cancelled like half of the classes during my semester, and honestly the class is a bit of a waste of time considering no work gets done, but you still should come. Going into the last weeks I still had no clue what my grade was so be prepared for the unknown.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Hands down my favorite honors class! I've learned a lot about writing, myself and the world in this course. The texts are difficult but the films and art make up for it. The MFA visit was one of the best parts. Mina really knows her stuff which can be intimidating, but she's always respectful and pushes you to try harder.
Love the class discussions

It was always difficult to understand what was going on. He would rush, stutter, and make mistakes often which made it difficult to follow along with the lecture. He was willing to clear any confusion but it wasn't always helpful. The question s on his tests and quizzes are difficult to understand. The textbook helps explain the core concepts.

Mr. Gomez's teaching style is not effective at all. At times he questions himself, and it's pretty difficult to understand him, and if the class asks too many questions, he ends up getting frustrated and tells everyone to go to his office hours if they have more questions. He does give opportunities to increase grade but its minimal.

His teaching style was really effective and the way he words his questions were confusing as times. He is willing to help out but once again the way he explains things is difficult. He is a strict grader.
I feel like his teaching style isn't really affective
He's very strict and his class is confusing
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Gomez just needs to get settled as a new lecturer, then I think he'll be great. Class was rough sometimes because participation was awful, and during lectures he would sometimes second guess himself which could be confusing. However, grading was fine and he reached out frequently over email with updates on assignment rubrics and stuff.
Uses AI for course content by the way.

I had Professor Arrowood during the Summer of 2023, and I can say without a doubt that he is an effective Org B teacher, and I did enjoy his class. 

The class was extremely simple to understand under professor Arrowood, and if you simply showed up to class and listened, it was easy to score above a B. All you had to do was show up and listen.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Rick Arrowood is a joke! He made my class purchase an "Organizational Behavior Support Materials and Cases" which was $40, made us upload a screen shot of Canvas showing that we purchased the materials. He NEVER USED THEM IN ANY OF THE CLASSES!!!! Waste of my money and time, plus he would constantly cancel class. Unprofessional, should be fired.
Joke of a professor, though not a bad person himself.
I'm still baffled that's he extensively used AI for his course.
Uses AI instead of own knowledge and time to prepare their lectures.  Yet doesnt want you utilizing tools. I guess its great for teaching the greedy and hypocritical side of business instead

Worst instructor I've had. Grades were based on flattery, not work quality. He bragged about himself, put students on the spot to entertain himself, ignored deadlines, and said the syllabus was irrelevant. Class was always cut short and often canceled. Sloppy, AI-generated lecture slides and notes were the least of his many shortcomings. Fire him.
Using too much AI.

Rick might be the worst ever. He spends all the class time on an egotistical rant or creating useless activities and then gives extremely difficult quizzes on lecture notes that he has never discussed. Attending class is a waste of time, though attendance is mandatory, and he never wastes an opportunity to put you down personally and embarassingly.
Very fun professor, super memorable!

Arrowood is a fine professor and this class was not particularly challenging, the content was even interesting. His teaching style was objectively bad. He mostly attempted to actively recall course material aloud in a way that was very difficult to follow. Double standards. Extremely arrogant and disrespectful towards his students. Authoritarian.

(Boston College) Professor Arrowood is charismatic and he tries to make his classes funny and engaging but ends up embarrassing students and himself a lot of the time. He is very unserious during class only for his assignments to be unexpectedly more complicated than they ever should be. Disorganized. Would not take again.

Truly dedicated to his craft great atmosphere & students encouraged to joke & contribute Teaching style not for everyone Went on tangents w/ lectures & interrupted students to embarrass/correct them in front of class Little criteria given - fun at times but expected to know what he wants &  answer how he likes Fun class but introverts be warned!
Amazing gave my group a straight A on the project

Very disorganized and confusing professor. You have to pay for a case study that he wrote which has tons of mistakes and is poorly written. And then he's ironically tough when grading. Asked for feedback on a quiz multiple times and never got it. Discussions are fun but he interrupts frequently and can be disrespectful. Charismatic guy, though.

My second class with Rick and if I could take him again I absolutely would. He truly wants students to learn things through experience rather than from a textbook so the class was very entertaining. Consisted of lighthearted and interesting discussions on EVERYTHING and fun activities. Provided that you match his enthusiasm, you will get an A.

My favourite professor at northeastern. He is the only option to take for ORGB in my opinion. Provided that you go into this course with an open mind about what you normally expect from a class then you will enjoy it. To do well you must participate but all classes are very casual discussions which I loved

One of the most enjoyable classes that I've had at Northeastern so far despite it being a 3 hour long class once a week. 

Professor is nice, funny and fair. Takes a very different approach to classes which involved constant discussion which was a very effective way to learn for me. If you have no trouble participating then this class is for you.

We rarely went over the necessary and applicable materials for this class, and if we did, Arrowwood would only do half of it and ask us to look at it on our own time. Most of the classes were discussions about a topic he chose that was somewhat related to the class. one time he graded my essay with a grammarly screenshot

One of the best professors I've had! Professor Guha is very kind and approachable which was huge for me as a freshman in my first semester. He's very knowledgable and is always willing to help. Also a great lecturer. Coursework wasn't so bad but did require a decent amount of work
Arjun is a good guy who cares a lot about what he's teaching and the students' success. His lectures can be somewhat shaky at times. He's very fair and considerate and wants his students to succeed.

Professor Guha was great at dealing with issues in this class. I had an issue with a lab partner and he resolved it quickly. Though the homework and exams were graded pretty toughly, that was due to the rubric of this class more so than Guha himself. Though his lectures left something to be desired, he was definitely the best option for fundies1.

Arjun is a god. He gives paper practice exam problems all the time in class (often they are harder than the exam itself so don't stress too much if one is particularly hard to understand) and he loves to answer questions. Hilariously sassy too.

Professor Arjun has possibly become my favorite professor at Northeastern, so far. He's very engaging in his lectures; he's funny, attentive,  and caring. If someone has a question, he does his best to answer it in a way they understand, and he actually gives enough time for people to ask questions, unlike some other professors. Highly recommend.
The Best professor in CS 2500 for 23 Fall!

Stopped going to Patterson's lectures to go here and learned so much. Loves how he literally gives practice questions during lectures and gives students time to work w/ each other on the code he wrote. Very interactive space and he's very engaging to listen to.
Very caring professor, the explanations of each concept is clear and understandable.

Arjun was one of the best professors I've had at Northeastern so far. His lectures were funny and I always went to them, even though attendance wasn't required. His lectures can seem unrelated to the homework at times, but you will appreciate them at the end of the course. Will often explicitly write code during office hours --  extremely helpful!

His lectures were good, but if you didn't review the material beforehand it could be very difficult. But yes, it's also a weeder intro CS class, so don't expect it to be easy. He was amazing considering the difficulty of the class. Still, many students didn't come to class and used the recorded lectures (that were great) made by Prof. Derbinsky.
Such a good teacher, class also had recorded video lectures which were helpful. However, even if you learn a lot you can still end with a less than amazing grade.

Arjun is awesome. He is so knowledgeable (granted you are willing to go beyond the topics covered in class) and will help you solve any issues. He has a very good humor that gets you engaged into the lecture. Also, He responds to email in minutes. Would take him again in any class.
Loved taking fundies 1 with Arjun. I feel that regardless of your level of comp sci knowledge before the class, you can come out confident about the material.
Great guy. Has a great sense of humor and cared about his student's success. His live coding style was helpful. He is responsive to feedback and a fair grader.

This class was probably my favorite of all the classes I've ever taken! Though the class was lecture-heavy, it sets you up very well for the exams and weekly homework assignments. Prof. Hamlin and the TA's are easily accessible if you have any questions as well. If you regularly go to class and recitation, then the course is very straightforward.

Lowkey the tests were just super hard imo LOL, I did well on every homework but pretty bad on midterms + final, maybe just me. Ariel as a person is great, she's very accessible outside of class but if tests are hard for you (like me) it may not be the best so go to class because her lectures are very in depth.

Professor Hamlin cares about her students and wants them to succeed. The class is lecture only which is fine, some lectures are better than others. The first exam was relatively difficult, second was extremely easy and just like her guide. The weekly problem sets become increasingly annoying and are worth 40% of your ENTIRE grade, so put in effort.

Incredible engaging and clear lectures, is very knowledgable of the content, and makes you learn it so easy. A bit ackward and cringey. Attendance is not mandatory but I would highly recommend going to class, subject is very interesting too. One of the best professors I've had.
Super nice professor and also very chill. Homework can be time-consuming but will prepare you for the exam. Probably the nicest professor in all of Khoury.

I went to the other professor because i didnt like her she tries to be funny and im just bored of her lectures so i never paid attention. even tho i did the practice exam, i didnt do good on the exams but for some reason i ended with a B+ lolll so ig it chill.

Professor was very warm and welcoming and its hard not to like her. Be prepared to type homework, including tedious mathematical operations, but you get used to it. She teaches really well, grading is fair, and you can really tell she cares about her students. Easy 5!

Very well-explained lectures; knows how to make students understand a completely new topic. Transitions from content is very smooth and easygoing; if you attend all lectures and ask questions, she will make this complicated class way easier. *Be sure to go over formatting for hw since the first day cause you might get deducted some points.
Very good professor, knows a lot about the content and makes the lectures simple to follow and understand.

Tough Professor who wasn't able to provide a lot of support within the classroom. Also notes are horrible, so try to attend the TA Office Hours to understand what happened in class but beware, there are no zooms to check the lecture again so be careful as this professor's notes were bad and there was no zoom to look back at.
Nice professor, easy to follow and understand during classes. Notes aren't great; stay focused during classes.

Great! Will talk about her cats at any given opportunity. HW can get a little heavy, but its not too much work, and the tests are easy. However, do not miss class, there is no textbook and her notes aren't great.
The class is not hard, and you can easily skip classes based on the topic of the class. It's not hard to get an A as long as you go to class and pay attention

Good teacher tbh. Made content that wasn't super straightforward rather easy. I just wish she didn't try to be funny or get the class to participate because no one gives her energy back and it was really hard to watch.

Had very good energy during class. Grading was extremely lenient and fair. Lectures were very clear and easy to follow, she used class time efficiently. Questions on homeworks, quizzes, and the final did not contain material not taught and were very doable if you paid attention in class.

Instructor grading is pretty lenient and they curve the exams if needed. Instructor makes a lot of mistakes during lecture which can hinder your learning experience, but they do correct themselves. Professor would be unprepared and unorganized at times with their notes which can get pretty difficult in understanding material in a timely manner.

Prof. Hamlin is smart, and while the class is lecture heavy, I like her lecture style. She's great at answering questions during lecture, makes herself available outside of class, and is incredibly kind. It's absurd to expect an instructor teaching abstract math to never make a mistake in lecture; she's a great teacher sensitive to students' needs

Often gets confused by her own notes, messes up in lectures, and gets corrected by students. I honestly think she is confused on the topics herself, making it impossible to learn. Homework often includes problems we spoke about in class for 2 minutes. I think if she went over questions that paralleled the homework I would learn much better.
AWESOME

Professor Hamlin is by FAR the best option for CS1800. Attend her lectures even if you aren't placed into her section. The class itself kinda sucks but she does the best job out of any professor of explaining the material in lecture. She's really nice and a bit awkward but that's just part of her charm.
Online class with her was a light workload and she is very generous with grading! Responds quickly to emails and is willing to meet with you if you need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If Cheryl is your co-op advisor, you are in good hands. I had a rough application cycle, and even when I thought my chances were gone she helped me find more opportunities and connected me with a professor so that I could secure a (paid!) work-study co-op. She's very supportive, and I wouldn't have wound up in this great situation without her.
Lectures could be a bit slow but the class was run well overall. Fair grader and always willing to help.

The professor is very fair, great at teaching, and assigns weekly homework with coding reviews conducted by TAs. He is caring, understanding, and professional. He answers all questions, but midterm questions are not directly from slides; they are based on lecture content. I would highly recommend taking his class.
Very good teacher, my concepts are clear because of him
Thoroughly Enjoyed his Class!

I really enjoyed Prof. Nabil's class, so much that I enrolled in another course he teaches. His teaching style combines lectures with hands-on practice, which makes the material very easy to understand. He is also understanding and fair with grading.

Professor Atallah is one of the best instructors I've ever had. He has a rare ability to turn complex topics into clear, engaging stories that actually make sense, rather than material you're forced to memorize. His class never felt overwhelming, because the teaching was thoughtful, structured, and genuinely focused on student learning.
Very good professor

Nabil's class was not just smart, it was current, and bioinformatics was accessible, human and relevant. I felt intellectually alive, safe to ask questions and show up as my full self.  More of this in STEM, please.

As a software developer, Dr Nabil didn't just teach tools but thinking patterns. I learned how to design for high-stakes production environments, and how to integrate automation from the very beginning. I moved beyond simply writing functional code and I began thinking in terms of architecture, systems, and clean, elegant engineering practices.

I'm beyond grateful to Professor Nabil Atallah. Every piece of advice he gave me stayed with me, and during a highly competitive job interview, his exact words guided my answers. I got the job at a top bioinformatics company, and HR told me it was because of how I answered. I couldn't have done it without his mentorship! Best Professor ever!

He is a thoughtful and exceptional professor, clearly passionate about Bioinformatics and made the course material very interesting. He consistently goes the extra mile to help students understand complex material and creates a supportive learning environment. If I get the chance, I'm definitely signing up for more of his classes!

Hi I usually don't write comments, but I have to make an exception. Dr. Nabil Atallah class is sharp, engaging, and makes Bioinformatics easy and exciting. Tbh I never thought I'd enjoy it this much. I hope to take another course with him.

I am taking currently his course on Computational Methods in Bioinformatics (BINF6310). Professor Nabil Atallah brings passion and expertise to his teaching. The class is enjoyable and fun, making challenging subjects more approachable and interesting. I highly recommend.

Nabil is one of the best professors I have had the pleasure of learning under. He is knowledgable, understanding, and more than happy to help when asked. I had him for both 6310 and 6420 (I'm not sure if he's still teaching them) but there is a reason I took 2 classes with him he makes concepts feel easier to grasp without it feeling overwhelming.
An outstanding professor! Incredibly knowledgeable and always eager to support and guide students.

Absolutely incredible teaching! The way Dr Atallah break down complex topics into easily understandable pieces is truly impressive. Great passion for the subject shines through, and it's clear how much you care about your students' success. Every lesson feels engaging and informative.

Most of the homework are discussion posts and discovery-related homework. He does NOT teach these components during the lecture. You will spend time learning how to code to do homework.

The lecture material is undergrad biology that could be taught in

He is kind and wants the students to succeed. He is disorganized and did not provide a syllabus so we did not know when assignments were due. This was made even worse when assignments were posted online without due dates. He would often go off topic in lecture making it hard to pay attention. Group projects are hard but we taught ourselves a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easy and helpful
hands down best professor

He is kind to his students and enthusiastic about teaching. Classes do not feel rigid and are usually quite engaging. There was an irregular upload of assignments in the course but I'd chalk this purely up to inexperience as he is a new professor and I'm sure the course will only get better with future iterations.

Polly is a very insightful instructor and provides very detailed feedback to your work. Lots of reading but she is always willing to help. However, her grading is extremely hard. Getting an A is very difficult unless you are very good at analytical writing and follow her rubrics exactly.

Polly is a great teacher. Although the class has a lot of required reading, it was interesting and I didn't mind doing the work. Come to class prepared and ready to participate; easy A.

talk about having your cake and eating it too. this serbian professional  enlightened me to all aspects of education and what it takes to be an independent teacher (like not dependent at all). I give this class a V for Viciously Vigorous

why is the final paper 10 pages? ridiculous. she is alright. alot of unnecessary and repetitive work. BLAHHHHH

The ratings on here do not do justice to Polly Attwood as a Professor. The class is a lot of work, but it is worthwhile and you truly leave it with an understand of the subject. She is supportive, passionate, and generally there to help you succeed. Very genuine and fair.

Polly knows a lot about kids and teaching and is very passionate about it in class. She is also passionate about her personal beliefs, though, so try not to oppose them too often...

One of the worst professors I have had at northeastern. Gives enough work to accumulate at least three courses. Seems to think her class takes priority over any other class. I had to laugh while I was reading the other comments. While they are aggressive, they're definitely true. Polly loves to teach n no one can argue against that. unfortunately, she has a "benefit of the doubt" view on the world; the same one among politicians that has created more and more horrible poverty and racial tension in this country. b/c of this u have to have about 10 sources to back up every statement u make. she is helpful but get out if u can

Really nice woman with a sort of hippy-sh spin on education. Very supportive and helpful. The class itself is really repetitive, but she does her best to draw on her own and your personal experiences as well as various media to make it interesting. Easy A.

Prof was good. I found him interesting because of his accent. He is knowledgable about International Business.

Very experienced and knowledgable professor in the field. He uses the book and his personal accounts to teach the class. Answers any questions asked and is a very friendly person!

Very experienced in international business.  Very interesting to listen to in a 2 hour class.

I said my idea for my project and he jus said it was a bad idea.I stayed after class to ask y but he got defensive and did not clearly explain why it was bad, he jus said if u think its a good idea then do it. some1 asked to ellaborate on the details and he jus told us to read the syllabus

Course and subject matter was very interesting. Dr. C was not active in discussion boards, however, she graded according to the rubric. I had no issues with her or the coursework. Best. Professor. Ever. Literally nothing bad to say about him. Funny, makes classes interesting and is the nicest person ever
Best professor I have had to this day. Amazing guy who really cares about his students. Stay in contact with him!
THE BEST TEACHER EVER!!!!! George is the man If you never have him as a professor then you are missing out
An amazing professor. Hands down my favorite.

He's a great instructor, tries to be funny which is entertaining. Breaks the class up into different parts making a two hour class fly by. Def suggest choosing him if possible. Great guy, book is easy reading.

He's amazing!! I took Elementary French II and am thrilled to be taking another class with him. He's incredibly passionate and genuinely cares about his students. Such a chill and nice guy. His lectures were interesting, a lot of collaborative work, and fair grader. There was a decent amount of homework due but it was never hard. I definitely reccomend taking him.

reviews.comment: I took FRNH 1101 but they didn't have an option for that so ignore the course number but please don't take this class unless you speak French. I enjoyed having Professor Hancock this semester. He is a great professor and cares about his students. My level of french increase through his teaching. For French 1101. Only took a week so disregard the rest of this rating. Just know that he teaches in French as much as possible. Take him if you are a quick learner who is very present during class time. Also, rather strict homework policies.

Prof Hancock is a new, young professor. He's been an amazing teacher and makes class interesting by having activities or presentations lined up the whole time. Super genuine and willing to help you out anytime. Very easy grader on the homework tasks too. My french has gotten a lot better with him.

The review for CHME 7601. This course was very disappointing. The professor often wrote equations on the board without any explanation, and when asked, she said they were copied from the textbook. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Augustes class is very challenging and work heavy. Sometimes lectures are disorganized but her tests are very fair and she isnt that harsh a grader. She also cares and wants students to succeed.
Poorly organized and hard to follow lecture. There was a semester long group project and didnt teach some of the required information for it until after the first draft was due.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: She is a nice lady, but her lectures can become a bit boring, and sometimes it feels like what she's saying isn't important.
