reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Edwards was a great professor. Lectures are based directly off the textbook and the slides were very comprehensive. She is super nice and understanding towards students and holds review sessions in class before exams and on Zoom with office hours. Exams are hard, but you should be well prepared if you take notes in class and make a good cheat sheet

Overall, Prof. Edwards was great. The lecture slides are well done, with lots of pictures, and they closely follow the textbook readings. Homeworks are generally very helpful for understanding the content. Tests are intentionally very difficult, but the grades are curved at the end. Overall, great professor, great class.

Edwards is one of my favorite professors. I wish more professors were like her. She knows QP is difficult and she does her best to help everyone and take feedback on her lecturing. She listens and clearly cares about her students and is also definitely passionate about the course content. 10/10 would recommend her for QP.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Edwards is an amazing professor. QP is VERY difficult, and for the most part she makes it straightforward. She is willing to meet you halfway as long as you show up and put in the effort. Classes are roughly 2/3 lecture, 1/3 in class practice. The tests are difficult because she's really testing you on application, but the curve is amazing.
She's a good professor but tends to rush through lectures and spends the second half of the class on practice problems.

QP is a notoriously hard course in the BioE curriculum, but Edwards made it really interesting and not too terrible. To be honest, I never read the textbook chapters until before the exams. The lectures and example problems in class are good prep for the exams. She cares about our feedback, will implement changes suggested by students

She is a really good professor for QP. Reading the textbook is a must, but she'll meet you once you've gone that far. She tells you exactly what she's looking for you to know and allows for info sheets on tests. Overall really cares people know the material and is willing to change things around if a lot of people ask/ need it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Ganguly is very knowledgeable in his field. He actively tries to make his students interested the subject, and invites them to a lot of seminars and presentations. He tends to be a little busy sometimes, but his TA is more than capable of handling things when he isn't available. I highly recommend taking any course taught by Prof. Ganguly.
Learned a lot and got exposure to many new areas in time-series.

Don't take a class with him!!! He assumes you already know everything and teaches class like a review session. He doesn't interact with class, just dumps material on board. Homeworks are easy, but exams are crazy hard and pretty conceptual.
good professor

Prof. Awatef is one of the nicest professors at Northeastern. She is really helpful outside class, she is an easy grader, and she gives easy exams. Don't expect the best teaching. However, if you do the HWs and go to class you will get an A.

Prof. Awatef is a very nice person. She teaches really good. Even though she has a little problem with communication, she tries her best to teach the subject properly. If you attend classes regularly and pay attention, then you don't face any difficulty in exams. She takes a lot of examples in the class for practice. She is very caring.

This is the single worst professor Ive ever had the displeasure of having. She cannot hold the attention of the class.  When asked a question she never provides an answer that makes sense. Her examples aren't helpful. She'll spend 20 minutes on problems that only need a minute. When she is going over in class examples her explanations are all over.

Very nice person, not a good teacher. Had a lot of difficulty keeping the attention of the class. Read off of powerpoints for her lectures. IE4516 very similar to a Probs & Stats course but she rarely provided practice problems. Students will most likely get a good grade but will have a hard time learning much.

She is so sweet and caring and it is clear she genuinely cares about her students. She never made the class stressful and made any rules/guidelines clear from the start of class. She made me enjoy writing again! Her TA is also very nice and chill.
Best Professor in the world!

Professor Emily was great. Highly recommend this class because since there is a service aspect you have way less homework than other first year writing course. Professor Emily is super sweet and super understanding if something happens. Her TA is useless so no need to pay any attention to her.

The sweetest professor ever! She is super caring and wants the best for all of her students. The class itself is chill and is a very collaborative and welcoming environment. I honestly looked forward to class every week because Emily is very passionate and optimistic. Overall, this is a great class to take 10/10!!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER. If you plan on taking any writing class, please take Emily. She is super kind and respectful to her students. Great professor, accepts late work and is super understanding if you can't attend class or something, just email her. Thought this class would be a pain, but I really enjoyed it! Professor Avery-Miller is super laid back, her writing assignments are fun and thought provoking. Really got to know people in my class and looked forward to it every week, if you need ENGW1111 take it with her, highly recommend!

Emily is super sweet and an easy and helpful grader, but kind of exhausts group work. I feel like I barely wrote in this class, it was a lot of creative assignments. Feels like a high school class. reviews.comment: Awesome teacher.  Mrs.  Avci  made the class fun in and out of class with interesting  readings and class discussions.  She is also very clear with what she expects and grades based on effort.  Overall a very understanding and nice instructor.

Anderson-sensei is my favorite professor I've taken so far. She is extremely caring, understanding, and is always smiling. As long as you put effort into this class and actively stay engaged, you will love it!

She is a super nice and caring professor (very motherly like). Classes are really engaging and all material to study given prior to the assessment (most if not all on quizlet). Will say its not an easy A course you will have to work for your grade!

Anderson Sensei is so sweet and is an excellent professor. I got so much better at reading, writing, and speaking this semester and you are given chances to practice vocab, kanji, and sentence structure in and out of class. Such an organized professor like Canvas was chef's kiss. Kind and caring, very motherly. Accessible outside of class and very understanding. She's not tough, but she's not an easy A. I loved this class. She'll match each student's pace. Every class was fun.

Professor Yildirim is a great professor in class and cares a lot about what she teaches. The grading is a bit off and can be confusing, but the material is typically fun and interesting. She is great for communicating and engaging in a fun class environment. The workload can get a bit much at times but overall great class.

So you see, the class itself is quite interesting. You may be thinking hmm I like this! That is until... you get a paper every week that is at least 9 pages. Argh. However, she tries her best and is very nice in class. The lectures are fun and all, but don't necessarily teach too much. I would recommend going tho bc it means a lot to her and is fun

reviews.comment: Great Professor. Genuinely cares about what she teaches and rewards effort.
Good energy

Professor Yildirim was really great. Her class is always super interesting and I never found myself board in lectures. She gives 3 "pop quizzes" randomly throughout the semester to basically make sure you are in attendance. Attendance isn't mandatory but it does help you on tests. Her exams went along with the lectures and the work is pretty easy

Professor Bilge was okay as a teacher. Her class was super easy but her grading is a little strange. Her tests are easy and there is a final project but that is also easy. To be honest, she did not really teach anything new or different from psych1011 so I wouldn't take her for a subject I actually wanted to learn something new in. Overall, nice.

I love Dr. Y. Classes are definitely lecture-heavy, but she records them. And sometimes lecture won't be interesting, but lock in & you'll do fine on every exam. She has lots of resources and will always help you. + She clearly loves teaching.
4 exams, one of which is dropped; take-home quizzes (2 tries); sometimes extra credit + test corrections!

Dr Y is a sweetie! Her class is interesting and the poster project is a semester long effort and not bad at all. Her tests are a bit tricky, but not that heavily weighted. Her lectures are crucial for details on exams, so review daily because content builds up. Make sure you follow rubrics to get full credit on classwork grades and it's an easy A.

This class was interesting and Professor Y was very funny, but her teaching style was often hard to follow. There were a few exams and open note quizzes, but they weighed very lightly in terms of your grade. There were slideshows shown in class, but they weren't very helpful so make sure your attendance is good.

I thought Professor Yesilatay was really nice and caring of her students, but her lectures were often confusing. You have to attend class to know what will actually be on tests because the lecture slides are not helpful. There were few assignments, but they were all pretty lengthy. She is very understanding and lenient though!

Dr Y was an engaging lecturer and explained material clearly. Lecture heavy, so attending class was necessary since slides were not comprehensive and most content on quizzes/exams was only taught in class. Grade was determined by many small assignments. She gave detailed rubrics and lots of feedback. Exams were not weighted heavily and fairly easy.

I took A&P 2 with Professor Yesilaltay and I don't regret it at all. She's super caring and wants her students to succeed. There are 4 exams (lowest one gets dropped) and a final. She also allows for test corrections which gets added to your test grade. There's a lot of content but that's to be expected.

I had Dr.Yesilaltay for both A&P 1 and 2, she is amazing! It is a lecture heavy course but lectures are recorded so you can always go back and rewatch. There is test corrections after each exam and your lowest exam grade gets dropped. She is very enthusiastic about teaching and was an overall great professor! I would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: she's awesome!! makes great analogies and answers questions well, and she's honest when she doesn't know an answer. lecture-heavy but she is funny and gives breaks so i've never found a lecture boring.

By far the best professor I have this semester! Definitely recommend if you want a professor who will bring enthusiasm and inspiration to both yours and her own work. Very intelligent individual. Love this class!

Organized, learned a lot, fair exams, exam corrections, and she is really nice and answers all questions. We had online quizzes with multiple attempts and a page of notes for our exams. The lab is the hard part. Great professor and I got an A!

She rambles and goes off topic a lot during lectures but you can tell she's really passionate about her job. Slides are not helpful at all to study with so make sure to attend lectures to catch key points here and there she'll test you on. Amazing lady and so caring as a person. She tries and really wants her students to do well
Very charismatic personality, truly wants her students to succeed! Also very understanding, did well with explaining more difficult concepts whenever prompted.

take-home quizzes every week, poll ev for attendance, and exams that are completely fair/not too difficult, it is manageable to pass this daunting class. she is super sweet and answers emails so fast. if anything the lab was the hardest part and i mean its HARD, so time consuming for a 1 credit course but the lecture is more than fine honestly.

Dr. Y is the sweetest person ever. It is very feasible to get an A in this class. The tests only make up a small part of your grade and there are no curveballs. A lot of the grade is based on a poster project which she does not grade harshly. The lectures can feel long and monotonous, but that's really the only negative thing I can think of.

she is such a sweetheart and i absolutely loved this class. she truly cares about her students and i've maintained a relationship with her afterwards. if you can, take this class, especially if you're new to northeastern.

LOVE HER OMG. she has a funny personality and was very good at answering questions. she had 3 EC assignments and all exams were open note (hand written) and final was online. she also does corrections so not hard to pass her class.

Prof Ayce genuinely cares about her students and goes above and beyond to support their success. She's kind, and approachable, and provides helpful resources like exam corrections and others to help you. Her engaging teaching style makes class enjoyable. Having her for Anatomy 2 was amazing, and she made the challenging material fun!!!

I absolutely loved Dr. Y. She is so so kind and her course was interesting. She allowed us to write a paper for the final instead of a final exam, and she is very reasonable with grades. All exams had corrections as well. She really cares about your education and well-being, and I would take any class she offers just to have her again as my prof.

Dr. Yesilaltay really cares about her students and wants them to do well. If you go to class and do the assignments, you cannot get a bad grade. You can tell she really knows what she is talking about. She is very sweet, funny, and approachable. There was sometimes busy work but it did help boost your grade. She also offered test corrections.

The lectures are a bit hard to follow. She often goes on tangents that are unrelated and the slides are not very helpful in explaining the content. The test questions are often more detailed and difficult then the lecture slides or what is covered in class.  She does give extra credit which I really appreciated.

Literally nothing bad to say about her, impossible to get lower than an A in her class and would make up extra credit if you needed it. So funny and cared about all her students, her class was so easy and even if you failed the exams, they were barely worth anything, she also gave corrections. Wish I could take her forever.

Dr. Y is super nice and always there to help. If you have any questions she has no problem helping you and making sure you're all caught up. Super accommodating. I would take all my classes with her if I could.

Dr. Y is the best professor out there she is so kind and caring. She responds to emails quickly and is always willing to help. Her lectures are engaging and she genuinely cares about all of her students. She wants to see everyone succeed and engage with each other in class.

I LOVE DR Y!!!! She is both passionate about what she teaches and helping her students succeed. Some homework is time consuming and a bit difficult, but she is kind with grading and often moved due dates back to give us more time. Dr Y is also very fun. I was never bored in her class. Take her if you can!

My favorite professor at Northeastern! She made the content engaging, and I feel like I truly learned something from her class. She is very accessible outside of class and genuinely cares about her students. There is a poster project and a lot of reading, but everything is manageable and easy. Exams are done online and at home. 10/10!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Y knows how to make class engaging. She is constantly coming up with little rhymes or songs to help you remember concepts. She is also the most caring professor I've ever had. She recognized me from her BIOL1000 session the semester prior and emailed me to check in on how I was doing. Genuinely the sweetest.

Prof Y was amazing! I took her cholesterol section of this class, she gives great lectures, gets to know everyone, barely any out-of-class work, and an easy grader. Loved her class, was never confused and found the material interesting. Highly recommend :)

Dr. Y is great! She's so caring about her students. The class has many articles and you can easily fall begin if you don't take notes. There are 2 exams and the final one. She gives opportunities for corrections for the exams. There are also quizzes taken only for completion grades. There's also a big project poster about an article of your choice.

Prof. Y is a great teacher and is extremely passionate about biology. She will take as much time as she needs to explain a topic if someone is confused. 2 exams and a final. Some long homework assignments here and there but its all very doable. She offers points back on exams, and for the quizzes, we got 2 attempts and discussed answers in class.
walking dub

Professor Y was all I could have hoped for in a biology teacher. She had weekly "figure facts" that were really straight forward from research papers we read in class, was extremely time consuming though. All tests and quizzes were online, quizzes had multiple attempts and there were test corrections. She was extremely caring and knew everyone
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Best professor I've had at Northeastern. Her lectures are always involving and interesting but doesn't pressure those who don't want to participate. All quizzes and tests are online, and she offers the ability to correct your mistakes to earn some of your points back.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Y was a joy of a professor. She really emphasized engagement within the class and tried to make everything as stress-free as possible. She wanted her students to enjoy lectures by making them interactive and was always accessible in case you had questions on anything. Exams and quizzes are all online and she provides corrections.

Professor Yesilaltay has been my favorite professor at Northeastern so far. She is so caring and understanding and just genuinely wants you to learn the material. Grades aren't really stressed, but trying to understand the material is. I was not even interested in cholesterol before taking her inquiries but I thoroughly enjoyed the class.

Prof Y is the nicest and actually teaches you. She is the best professor I have had at NEU. She cares about you and understands when something is difficult. She encourages asking questions and explains things well. The class is very project bases with two major exams. Most things have the opportunity to do corrections that can help your grade!

One of the best professors I've ever had. She's so sweet and really does want everyone to succeed, and lets you do corrections on all quizzes/exams to earn points back. Great at explaining concepts and super helpful if you have questions, I would highly recommend her class

Professor Yesilaltay is the type of professor who truly cares about you and wants you to succeed. I loved being in her class as she made lectures interesting. There were some online quizzes which were open note, and she did offer corrections on them. There were a couple midterm exams which she also allowed corrections for. Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Yesilaltay is the most caring, helpful professor. She will help you if you need something, and make sure you get concepts, and her lectures are fun, collaborative, and not just the professor speaking to the students. There isn't a ton of reading, and if you pay attention and stay engaged during class you'll do good.

Dr Yesilaltay is an extremely knowledgeable and all around great professor. If you are taking inquiries, you want this teacher. She is understanding with grades, keeps lectures engaging and interesting, and cares about both what she teaches and her students. HW load is a bit lighter than other classes, if you pay attention its a pretty easy A.

Dr. Yesilaltay is an incredible professor who deeply cares about her students. The cholesterol class can be a little intimidating, but you learn so much more than that in a fun and inviting setting. I'd definitely take Bio Inquiries with her if you get the chance!

He's super chill and gets the work done. He made me enjoy reading and writing and has a very laid back demeanor. Class isn't hard, just do the assigned work (not bad at all). If possible I would 110% take him for first year writing.
Such a nice and helpful professor, definitely recommend. He's really funny and the assignments consist of a few projects and writing assignments.

really good teacher. Ends up having a good relationship and gets very connected to all his students. At the end of the day he just trying to make you a better writer. He doesn't use textbooks and makes the class fun and engaging. Homework wise its not bad at all, he gives like project essays every once in a while and somehow you want to do them.

The best teacher you will ever have understands how to make a class that is supposed to be easy, be easy. Shows you the most important errors you have to improve your writing. Is the funniest teacher I've ever had, fun projects, fun class videos and documentaries, overall the GOAT.

Amazing prof and such a funny and cool guy! Gives helpful writing tips, but the more you give the more you get out of it. If you do the assignments you will do well. Def take this class cuz he makes it fun and is caring towards students!

Prof. Ayala is so nice! He does not assign homework but there are some very small presentations here and there (you choose the topic). He is very flexible and understanding. Also an easy grader. Definitely recommend!!!

She is an amazing proffesor!! She cares a lot about her students and provides lots of support. The content was engaging and easy to follow. You can tell she cares a lot about what she is teaching. The workload isn't high so it is great to take as an elective.

Prof Ayanna was very kind and knowledgeable, which made her class engaging. She was also very flexible with due dates, gave mental health days off, and was open to feedback. If you complete assignments with effort, you will get an A. Class was enjoyable, and I would love to take from her again if possible
So nice. taught super interesting material but also wanted us all to succeed. Lots of chances to get extra credit or points.

She is really nice. You don't NEED to go to class but the material is interesting and she ends early sometimes. Tests are online and open note. She is very understanding with late assignments. Cares about the topic and the students.
really chill, readings aren't too necessary to do, easy work, engaging lectures, no exams

She is very knowledgable about the Criminal Legal System and will do her best to answer any questions. She is fair when considering due dates and will use student feedback. However, she would sometimes assign long, technical readings. Despite this, I learned a lot and found the textbook extremely useful.

Ayanna was amazing! Her lectures follow the required textbook but also follow very current events in our society. She facilitates great discussion in class and is very accepting and open. Take this class even if you aren't going into criminal justice! You will learn so much with an awesome professor!

Professor Ayanna was amazing and understood the content to teach it. She cares about the class and is passionate about what she does. She is an easy grader and will offer you room for improvement. She is very reasonable and understands. This is your class if you are looking for a good introduction class to see if you like criminal justice.
I do not recommend to take this course. This course is not hard to understand, but it is hard to get a high grade in the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: my arch nemesis. once a class she'll tell us we shouldn't be on our laptops and we should be asking more questions, but will absolutely clown us if we get something "wrong" in a discussion that doesn't fit her narrative. her slides are wordy and she doesn't have one cohesive thought. you will be jumpscared by rubric criteria she never communicated

There's a lot of readings that can be very boring unless you're into agriculture. As a professor, she is super sweet and a good teacher. Lectures can be boring at times, but she does her best to make it interesting. Brings in guest lecturers and even brought food for the class to try.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Ayers is an outstanding educator; however, this course poses significant challenges. The exams demand hours of reading and studying the material. Particularly, the Neurocreation paper is quite formidable and needs to be worked on ahead of time. Many students opt for an Incomplete grade (I) and submit the paper later in the year.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No longer using flipped classroom as he did in Fall 2020. 3 exams, 1 paper. Take this class if: - You are extremely interested in comparative neurobiology - All the other classes you are taking this semester are easy - You are being legally forced to take this class - Your mental health is stable enough for you to have weekly mental breakdowns

Professor Ayers teaches via a flipped classroom, which is just his way of being able to include as much information as possible into at home work and class lectures. They are extremely dense lectures that take about 2 hours to get through (minimum) and class time is spent reviewing the lectures.

By far the hardest class I've taken in the BNS program. He's an absolutely brilliant professor who will teach you an insane amount of cool info about nervous systems, but his presentation skills are lacking. His slides are incredibly dense, and he gives no hints on what we're supposed to know. Take it if you're brave.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You know those professors who are VERY knowledgeable in their field - yet, they just do not know how to convey the information to others? Yea, that's Dr. Ayers. He's a really nice person, but his lectures are all over the place. His exams are incredibly detailed and the Neurocreation paper was the death of us all. I learned a lot in the end though.

This is class is extremely difficult, it requires a massive amount of work, especially the paper. While i learned alot in this class, i would not recommend taking it in less you are looking to go into neuroscience.  If you take this class make sure the rest of your course load is light because this is a very time consuming class.

Wow! This class is crazy hard.  Only take it unless you are honestly interested in going into comparative neuroscience.  He asks ridiculous detail on tests, refuses to answer e-mails or meet with you, and when you ask questions, he says, I think it is very clear.  I learned a lot, but REALLY hard class

He is an extremely smart guy and the class is interesting. But it was amoung the hardest I have ever taken. You have to read ever thing because he test on the smallest details The test are difficult TF and MC but if he gives you the option  to give short essays I would take it. The paper is difficult but he grades it really easy.You will learn alot

This was the most difficult class I've ever taken.  His tests are very difficult, and the averages were always around 70.  The paper is a beast and will consume your life.  Don't procrastinate on it.  You'll learn a lot, but sometimes he contradicts himself.  The book is useful only about 1/2 the time.  Read the PDF's.  I wish I had had more time.

Definitely the best teacher I've had in college. The subject matter is quite complex and can be overwhelming at times. BUT if you are interested in neuroscience this class is definitely worth taking. The tests are mul. choice, t/f, short answer and essays. You have to write a paper that composes a nervous system. Highly recommended teacher & class.
Joe is awesome, but be sure to pay attention, cause he tests you on EVERYTHING you never thought you'd need to know.

Ayers is the man. Awesome professor and he's got some great stories and does interesting research. Who couldn't love a prof. who makes robotic lobsters?!  Seriously, if you want to know how nervous systems give rise to behaving organisms, he is the man to talk to. Never saw anyone bored in class.

My favorite professor I've had at Northeaster so far. He clearly knows what he's talking about. He's super passionate about what he teaches and it's contagious. Can get sidetracked sometimes but it's almost always informative or entertaining. I highly recommend taking a class with him!

This man is a genius. He talks really fast, but everything he says is amazing. He doesn't put the slides on blackboard, so type the notes. It's an interesting class. Tests are online and easier than they look. The final paper is a breeze. There are readings but really only need to use 2 for your paper and some are on blackboard.

One of my favorite profs I've had.  He's clearly really into his field so he knows what he's talking about, and probably knows what you're talking.  Even if you don't know what you're trying to ask, he probably knows what you mean.  A bit difficult to connect with in class but really opened up in office hours.  Also, super cute.

Professor Ayers is one of my favorite teachers I've ever had at Northeastern. He's not only incredibly smart and humble, but is incredibly understanding about individual schedules and is open to all ideas. Promotes very interesting discussion and encourages students to be confident in their ideas. Definitely recommend!
Excellent professor. Provides great feedback, is extremely helpful, and is not difficult. Allows you to research your own ideas with application. Highly recommended.
She pays attention to every minor detail. Professor Baker is the harsher grader I have came across and I'm a senior. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The overall experience was positive, but the grading was strict, and late submissions were not accepted.
DO NOT TAKE WITH HER
All around a great experience.

Professor Baker clearly cares about her students and wants to see them be successful. She is supportive but knows how to challenge you to help you improve. She is very organized and explicit about what she's looking for. Whenever I needed help with something, she would respond very quickly. I'm definitely a better writer after taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Complete douchebag

Seeing the reviews below, I was definitely a little nervous to take a class with her. However, the syllabus is very clear. My biggest recommendation for anybody reading these reviews is always hand things in on time and thoroughly revise rough drafts. I think she appreciates when there is a clear difference between rough and final drafts.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: I don't know what to say. I am really speechless to see someone so heartless in the middle of the pandemic. I believe people can change. Maybe one day. She thinks people are like trees. They can't be sick, can't have an emergency. No late assignments and they are really explicit. Good luck with her class.

I DID take this class for credit the option did not let me pick that, wanted to make that correction. I am currently still in this class and COULD NOT wait to write a review. This is actually my first review ever because of how awful this class is. The professor treats this class like a Masters science program. I would NOT recommend this professor!

There is no extra credits! No make up exams! She does not care if you are sick, your kids or any type of emergency. Please choose another teacher. Her assignment are not really explicit and so rude when you ask her questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Julie Baker's online writing class should be avoided at all costs. She does empathize with the lives of her student. She offers no make up work, partial credit, or late assignments. On time assignments are valued over working hard and producing quality work. She does not comment on late work despite it being in her syll.

Echoing the words listed here by other students. A very tough teacher who has his own set of rules that, even after finishing this class, I could barely understand. Will not shut down conversations in class, but will talk in circles, and somehow, for talking the whole three hours, he still does not teach anything of value. I regret taking this.

Chris' classes are tough but he will challenge you. I don't want to be learning basic Unity or do some random group project which is every other game class. He has actual industry experience and a focus on patterns, which are tough to learn but actually practical. Take if you are serious about learning and are actually trying to get into industry.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not pointless, but the name is criminally deceiving. Prof has a lot of good intentions but the current class structure is less-than-ideal. Takes a lot of time to teach the pattern identification process, which should be taught in a separate course. He expects the ability to model & work in and Unity but does not teach it so be ready to self-teach.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Barney has a lot of knowledge about the gaming industry at large and tries to instill that knowledge to his students in his classes. Game 3400 has a large focus on modeling which is something to be aware of, but so long as you do the work (which is a lot at times) the professor will work with you.

- You will be the labor of his Pattern studies. He quotes 'It will benefit you a lot' but the entire course is just making you a lab rat. He will not teach you how to use unity, He will not teach you how to modeling, He will not teach you how to game design or level design. Your job is to read tons of stuff and make patterns for his research.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Pattern-obsessed, makes students churn out patterns for his buggy website all semester. Talks in circles, runs out of time in a 3.5-hour class. Never touches Unity, expects self-teaching on top of heavy readings and projects. His unrealistic expectations are exhausting! Please teach a separate patterns class so students can focus on level design.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is so sweet and she made the class enjoyable

What a great person and professor. She cares a ton about the students and wants them to do well in the class. Took it during summer and it went by quickly in a good way. Still quite a bit of work but that's just the nature of the class. She grades very fairly. As long as you care and want to do well, you will be just fine.

Dr. Balman was the best. You could tell she cared about the success of all of her students and walked around the lab to check in and see if anyone had questions. She explained everything well and in good detail. Definitely recommend for Project lab.

hes a great guy and clearly knows a lot about philosophy, but his expectations are ridiculously for a 1000 level course. theres short writings which are good once you get the hang of them, but are impossible to have an average of an A on even with thorough writing the first few times. the final is basically made to drop your grade, but good guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: John is my favorite professor I had this semester. You're expected to read the papers he assigns and discuss them in class. He is a tough grader on the short writing assignments, but offers a lot of incentives that boost your grade a ton. He is super engaging and accessible outside of class. John is genuinely such a great professor.

John is an amazing professor. He is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about technology ethics, and he always made classes engaging. He is a tough but fair grader and provides many grade incentives/ boosts. He is always accessible outside of class and provides a lot of feedback on writing assignments, which helped me improve.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although I received a good grade in this class, he was very rude and had a large ego. He graded very unfairly. I changed my major after suffering greatly.

Although his lectures were super interesting and organized, he grades SO harshly. No matter what I tried or how much effort I put in I would get a bad grade. He also came across as pompous, arrogant, and unhelpful whenever I tried to get extra help. Overall, I constantly felt very discouraged in this class, even though i tried my best.
Took this class online over the summer. He is for sure a hard but fair grader but I learned so much. There was a reading quiz after each reading and a few short writings along with a final paper.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Awesome prof. I feel so lucky that I got to take his class as one of my first in college. I learned so much through his class even tho it was online. He was always available for extra help and really cared that I learned or expanded my perspective on the material. He is a really great person overall too. Highly recommend.
You're lucky if you have a chance to have Bestie John as a professor. I don't even really care about philosophy but I will be taking his class again.
Mr. Basl is an outstanding human and philosopher. 10/10 recommend every time.

I've taken a few classes with Prof Basl - He's a great professor, but you will have to keep up your side of the deal if you want to do well. If you don't read the texts precisely, or listen attentively in class, you're probably not going to do well in his class (or in any philosophy class tbh). This was the hardest PHIL class of the 8 I've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is one of the only classes for NUPath that I struggled in but thoroughly enjoyed. You get what you put into the class. He is definitely a hard, but fair grader. I loved the class so much I didn't tunnel vision on getting an A. Definitely talk to him outside of class to get a grasp of what the class is like!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor was very understanding, learned a lot about research ethics. I would definitely recommend for an online class satisfying ethical reasoning NUPATH requirements.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing guy, great lectures. Very accessible outside of class, very effective at answering questions and giving advice. Really tough essay grader, but he warns you about that from the outset, follows a strict rubric (that he gives you beforehand) gives lots of examples and tons of great feedback.

John is easily one of the best Professors I've ever had. His Moral Philosophy class is difficult, but he's super helpful and accessible if you're having trouble, just go to his office hours. Really interesting class, even if you're not into philosophy, would highly recommend.

John is an excellent professor who clearly cares about his student's success. He is a tough grader, but definitely fair. His feedback on papers was the best I have gotten anywhere, and he is willing to elaborate if you need clarification. I took the class for an easy A, which it wasn't, but definitely came out better at articulating my views.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: John is one of the most caring professors at Northeastern. He really wants to see you succeed, he explains difficult topics well, and he gives great feedback on assignments. He is the hardest grader I have ever had, but he's really helpful at office hours. His lectures are very engaging, he's funny and pretty good-looking too.

John is the absolute best professor at NU.  His classes aren't easy but you'll come out of them a better writer and knowing much more than you did going in.  GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS! He'll work with you on your papers and help you to get good grades on them.  If you spit out papers for him the night before they're due you're going to be miserable.
Good teacher, but super tough grader. Would not recommend taking Contemporary Moral Issues with him unless you want to slave away at assignments that are graded too harshly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: John is one of my favorite teachers, he's the man. He's an amazing teacher who cares about his students he makes a big effort to know at least each students name. The lectures are fun and interesting. He tells you at the beggining of the class he's a tough grader, and he also says the best way to learn is to meet with him and take feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Class was mostly graded off of papers. John is a tough grader but gives you a ton of opportunities  to  work with him directly, get extra credit, and receive very detailed feedback. However, you do need to be both a hard worker AND a critical thinker. The material is very thought provoking and morally developing. (John's not bad to look at, either)

Great professor but a tough grader. Class isn't for someone looking to coast, but perfect for the student with an interest in philosophyenvironmental studies hoping to develop writing and critical thinking skills. Professor is very willing to work with you and is usually available to answer your questions.
Basl is a great professor and is super interested in the material and the students which is amazing. He is passionate and spends a lot of time helping students outside of class. TAKE HIM!

Dr B is the goat. Being a 2nd year who just switched to engineering, this course helped balance my schedule, and although it is a lot of work, it's not hard, and most of the skills/assignments are very practical and useful. The kindest and most understanding prof I've had, very easy grader if you just try hard enough. Don't slack on group projects.

Batrouny's class was my favorite in my first semester. The class is all fun engineering projects or coding. Most things are self-guided, so you are able to go at your own pace, but she also is readily available to help whenever you need it. She is just such a kind person that genuinely wants you to succeed and have a good time in her class.

I will not lie and say this course is not a lot of work, but Dr.B creates a fun, inclusive, and engaging environment. She is very understanding about extensions and personal life events interfering with work. She clearly cares about her students.

I'm actually so heartbroken that Dr. B doesn't teach for anything other than cornerstone. Easily the best professor I've had at NU and the absence of any rating lower than 5 really speaks volumes. She deserves every bit of praise, and if I could I'd write an entire essay on here of how good she is.

SWEETEST WOMAN EVER she used to teach elementary and you can tell (in the best way). she loves to give group projects though but honestly it cuts down on the workload. weekly homework assignments but no finals or midterms. i wish she could teach all of my classes

Honestly, Dr. Batrouny is the best professor ever. She is very kind and caring and passionate in what she teaches. She also makes this class very interactive and fun and its a super chill class in general as long as you do everything you are supposed to. Her projects are also fun and I learned so much from this class. She is an amazing professor.

Dr Batrouny is a goated teacher, if you get her, consider yourself lucky, best Cornerstone teacher ever, her homework is not that hard and here is no Test. There is the occasional quizzes but if you are focus in her class, the quiz is really easy. Definitely would take her again, chill class as well.

She was an excellent professor, and I would absolutely take another class with her. The workload was very manageable, and her office hours were always incredibly helpful. She's also pretty funny, which made the class even more enjoyable.

Hands down the best professor you could have for cornerstone and probably among the best at Northeastern. She is kind, caring, understanding, passionate, and gives loads of opportunities to get a good grade. Only downside is that her TA is evil and grades homework like she hates you personally. But other than that she is great.

I am so glad Dr. B was my prof! She is genuinely a good person and takes the time to interact with all of her students. there is a lot of material in this course, but she is always free to help and makes learning it really fun. if you can, definitely take her!!
Amazing professor! Easy class to do well in and super nice as a person! Highly recommend taking her class!
She the GOAT. take her trust me. Free A+ and you learn so much in that class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved Dr. B and miss her class every day! Ensures that class is fun and motivates us to be the best engineers we can even when we were all first years with little experience. Always super interesting - never felt bored. Super accessible outside of class via email or drop by her office. Wants everyone to succeed while still having fun.

She's super sweet, her classes are fun and never boring. The group projects we do are fun and her lectures are easy to understand. There is a lot of work in the class as we cover a lot of material but she does a good job and it's not overwhelming. Definitely take her!
THE ABSOLUTE GOAT. Dr. B is my queen; if you are blessed enough to have the opportunity to take Cornerstone with her take it !!!!!!!!!

This course is rated a medium difficulty. She does a great job at guiding the class throughout lessons by making them engaging, as well as interesting. She also provides a lot of extra credit opportunities which makes GE1502 less stressful. Dr. Batrouny is more than a professor, she is your buddy that helps prepare for higher levels of academia.

Anyone who has Dr. B for Cornerstone is blessed. She is the best teacher to have for your first year of college. She grades extremely fairly, offers many opportunities for extra credit, and is overall just so kind and fun. Definitely a lot of work, but Cornerstone is about learning a lot of new things anyway, and she makes it very easy to do so.
Dr. B was the best cornerstone professor. She made it easy to learn and succeed in her class. The course does have a lot of group work, but that is unavoidable as a first year engineering student.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. B is super sweet & I learned a good amount from her class. I would definitely recommend her for GE1501 since she cares about students a lot and teaches well. She prioritizes team work, communication, and utilizing campus resources which is nice. Definitely take her!
I had Dr B. a year ago and to this day she is the best professor I have had at Northeastern. Super helpful with any questions or concerns. Lectures are engaging and straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: You cannot go wrong with taking Dr. Batrouny's class. She is super enthusiastic about the engineering field. The class and assignments are engaging and fun for the most part. She is always super lively and happy to teach her students. Every class, she gives her students a 5–10-minute break which is super helpful. HW Assignments take about 2 hr/wk.

Dr.Batrouny is amazing. There are a lot of group projects but done in the intent of building your resume/engineering portfolio. Extremely considerate, allowing you to grade your own quiz and will give tons of extra credit opportunities. Her personality also makes the class so worth it.

Dr. B is the sweetest, caring, funniest professor I've met at Northeastern so far! I love that I have her as my Cornerstone 1 and 2 professor. She is generous with HW extensions, and she grades fairly. Her office hours are chill too so you can swing by with any HW help and she'll be glad to help you! TOTALLY RECOMMEND HER!!!
Dr. B is awesome! I only had her for Cornerstone 1 but I wish I had her for Cornerstone 2 as well. She's really sweet.
Absolutely W professor
Literally the goat. Actually the nicest person.
They are a very good professor!

Professor Batrouny is caring, enthusiastic, and understanding. She makes herself easily available outside of class for help with homework, projects, or concepts in general. She encourages students to work together on assignments and plays music while students work.
If you can choose a GE professor get Dr. B!! She is the best, so laid back, you grade your own quizzes, retakes are available, she is so helpful outside of class, could not recommend more!

teaches over Zoom and just makes you look at his notes and copy them down. fast-paced and hard to follow sometimes. This class is okay because there are no tests, only weekly problem sets, which are pretty time-consuming. He is not good at using Canvas, it is badly organized and hard to find things you need. He is very caring and nice, though.

The class is on zoom which is not advertised when you sign up. All he does is zoom into his notes that he wrote a while ago and goes super quick. He never actually solves anything, just again zooms into already solved proofs. He never goes over any problems just shows derivations. This is too complicated of a subject for it to be taught this way.

He knows his subjects very well, but his questions for tests are readily available online. Not sure if he reuses old questions or takes his inspiration online. Sadly, the courses focus too much on the proof of the math and not the effect of the theory.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Honestly, he's quite a good teacher and clearly knows his stuff, although he can sometimes come off as condescending in class. Exams are hard for sure but the grades you get on them really don't matter that much, I think everyone in my class got at least a B despite a much wider range of exam grades.

Prof. Satvat was incredibly confusing to learn from. We were shown in class how to derive equations, then were never taught how to actually use them. I had to teach way too much to myself before our exams (one of which had a class average of 28). We also got little to no feedback on our tests/homeworks/projects. Nice guy, but bad at teaching.

I did get a B in Transport 2. To get a B, you needed somewhere around a 50% in the class. The average on our first exam was a 34, I got a 16. The average on the second exam was a 48, I got a 62. On the final, I got a 60. After exam 1, I didn't watch/attend a single lecture. For the permitted cheat sheets, copy down the solutions and you'll pass.

He is one of the best professors Ive had. He really cares for his students on a personal level and is willing to help beyond the course at hand, perhaps throughout your professional life. Youre sorted if you attend his class as he teaches everything you need to know. He made challenging concepts fun and Ill always look forward to his classes.

Extremely difficult class with insanely challenging exams. Your final grade is based only on a few exams. He is passionate about math and likes to give complicated math / derivation problems on the exams. Also, he does not explain the physical concepts well, rather prefers to explain the math behind them, which can be confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Love him! I've had him for transport, thermo and grad math. One of the smartest people I've ever met. He loves his students and truly cares for them. He def makes you work and pushes you to be a better engineer. The process was kinda painful but looking back at it I really appreciate how much he pushed me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Satvat is a very kind and caring teacher, and is always willing to help students. He is also very flexible and accommodating with the course schedule, and he really takes students requests into account. That being said, his lecture content, hw assignments, and quizzes all seem to have different material and are incredibly challenging.
Good guy, tough teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He is the best and most charming professor I've ever had. People who are complaining probably do not do the homework themselves, otherwise the course is not that difficult. Great lecture!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Satvat is very tough. He really pushes you to succeed, and his transport class is one of the most difficult classes I have ever taken. However, you learn a lot and he really cares about his students. He makes time for you outside of class and is a very genuine and caring person. He is however a very tough grader and his class is stressful

I've had class with Berry a total of 4 times. Every semester I've had a class with him I've ended up depressed, depression which goes away as soon as I don't have a class with him. He won't teach you any concepts although he will claim he does, he'll spend hours going over problems in class and expect you to do them in 5 minutes in his tests. GL
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Had Barry for transport and thermo. A nice guy and hard worker but not a good professor as he thinks he is. His class leaves you confused. You may learn to derive some equations but left not understanding the chemical engineering concepts. Students earn 8, 20, 30 on his exams cause he makes them very difficult. Not a good way to motivate students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Satvat is probably one of the toughest professors I have had at Northeastern. He can be condescending during class but if you go to his office hours and talk to him you will realize that he is a very down to earth person. He teaches very well and he is always very willing to answer questions as thoroughly as possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Barry was very demanding but made sure that you know the material. His classes do require a lot of independent outside work in order to get a good grade. However, I have never felt more confident in my math skills.

If you are CHEME at northeastern there is not way to avoid him, so just be warned. He is a terrible professor. He assumes that if one student understands something, the whole class does. Most lectures are spent with him calling us stupid. I have had depression for 4 years and I attempted suicide twice this semester because of him. Switch majors!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I've had Professor Satvat 2 times. As a student that's never faced depression and anxiety before, i faced it each time i had a class with Prof Satvat. He is extremely hard. He enjoys dishing out life lessons. I for one did not learn much from his class. I self taught myself from the textbook but that wont really help much on his exams. Good Luck

I had Prof. Satvat for Thermo 12 & Transport 2.  He has a dark sense of humour that I appreciated. Course grade is all (curved) exams, which range from impossible to fair.  Transport 2 exam problems require math that one student may know. If you bomb the first midterm you can redeem your grade on the second. Doesn't care much about final grade.

He is the best professor I have ever had.  He is hard, and he expects his students to work, so if you don't want to learn avoid him.  He will however spend as much time as is needed to teach you the material, going so far as to stay late or come in for tutoring.  He really is good.
No Comments

I'm taking a summer course with him at Mass Bay C.C. and while most of the material is way over my head, he somehow makes me understand. His mildly dark sense of humour puts a smile on my face, and I respect him too much to miss a single class. He says he teaches a a hobby because he enjoys it so much, and it is obviously true. Take a class with th
My number one!

an arrogant ass. doesn't hold office hours because he's too busy with his 300 other titles and positions and then assigns daily homework that the T.A. couldn't help us solve. yes, he's smart as hell. yes, he's funny in class. however, could not convey the basic core material to a ChemE that got an A in Organic Chemistry and Diff Eq. try Nagem @ BU
thought he was great.  tough teacher, but i learned well from him.  great guy!
Humor - a riot. Smart, bright, well spoken. Should think twice before leaving class during a test (people cheat). Methodology to passing his class - get objectives and solve.
Satvat is a ****!!!  Love the guy!
Nice guy to your face. Likes to start trouble between groups of students. Average test score on a standard 1hr exam: 37/100. 37=A, 16=F.  Drives a nice Porsche, though!
On a power trip. Although his bark is worse than his bite most times.
Soheil spends a lot of time on his lectures. Very helpful.

I took CS3000 with Soheil. I made it to most of his lectures, and they were pretty clear and helpful. For the ones I missed, I just watched the recordings. The homework assignments were a bit tough, but manageable. The exams were curved, which was nice.

The logistics were the same for all 4 profs in algo. Soheil is great. He is hella fine so that helps with the long lecture (he records them all). Homework are weird but not impossible to get a good score. All exams have curves but that final was way outta pocket. Algo is already a hard subject but Soheil did the best job in his ability to teach it.

Took CS3000 with this professor. To be fair, all 4 professors just don't care about the students. There is a lot of homework and quizzes (weekly), 2 midterms, and a final. The recitation was the most helpful part of the entire course. The professor is confusing, his explanations are too fast-paced, and he is not understanding towards students.
Barely curves. Doesn't care enough to guide his students to succeed in his class.

Prof Bhawesh is a typical college prof. Class is lecture heavy, so while attendance isn't mandatory, skipping class with often miss you an entire chapter. No tests, 3 exams and group project. Very straight forward. Easy grader as long as you complete your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class is boring but you get a cheat sheet for the test, just pay attention and you'll end with an A. He also grades lightly and clear rubric, semester long project but not too bad.
Take hand written notes. He is so sweet and wants you to understand. As long you pay attention and do the homework you'll do great.
This professor is so nice. He curves based on the final score and understands students' situations. Respected!
Bhawesh is a decent professor. He grades fairly hard, but the expectations are very clear. He cared about the students success and there was no written final, only an easy presentation.

I think as long as you follow along in class and reference the canvas you'll do well. The homeworks are rarely more than an extension of what's covered in class and he's pretty approachable if you have more questions on the topic. Very chill grader as well if he can tell you're putting in effort

Does not know how to teach. Rambled & when someone asked a question he'd repeat what he just said & move on. Made us buy a textbook and never had us use it. No outline/guidance for final project. Tests were hard but let us make cheat sheets; no makeups and mcqs worth 7 points each?? Also taught us coding for no reason (nothing to do with stats?)

Professor is very kind and funny, and did a good job of teaching - can sometimes explain things too quickly for people not familiar with computer science but always willing to go back and repeat. Not a huge workload, would recommend this professor.

Not accommodating at all when having to miss class. Not even wellness days count. if you are sick or have a family emergency you still have to go or makeup in office hours. There are assignments due every class as well as homework. No help is really available for the assignments either.

Really nice professor! Took him for mism 3515 during the pandemic so his classes were online. Thank god, he might be a little slow for some during lecture but overall he's very kind and a solid choice for professor. Unless you have the option of some other amazing professor, go with him.

Super caring professor and is very fair with all students. However, his grading is tough and there is a lot of workload for this class, so be prepared for that! But highly recommend taking his class you will learn a lot!!
He's just amazing. TAKE HIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!!!!!!!!!

Legit favorite person in the world--so caring, equitable, and a genius. This man is literally a superhero. While tests can be hard, they are all open notes so you need to work hard and study the material, but not memorize anything. Changed my major to supply chain because of him!!

One of the absolute best professors at Northeastern; he treats students as equals and actually cares. The tests are difficult, but they have a heavy curve(stated that a 65-70 would equal a B+). Wait until a semester you are starting to look for co-ops, he brings in many guest speakers and discusses his real-life experience in the Supply Chain field

ABSOLUTE GOAT. Cares more about his class and students than my parents care about me. Prof Bhimani is so passionate and understanding. My favorite NEU professor. A little heavy on the work but very manageable. Put in a little effort for this class and you will reap the benefits. I hate supply chain but Prof Bhimani made the class so enjoyable!!!!

Probably the most enthusiastic professor I've had about what he teaches. A literal Gem. Very very understanding and believes everything is a democracy... so your opinion matters. Grade is very divided which means it's doable to score well. He also curves the grades at the end of the semester.
LEGEND! The GREATEST SUPPLY CHAIN PROFESSOR EVER at Northeastern University.

Tbh, Shawn is the best professor I have ever had at NEU, and I have taken his 2301 and 3305 classes. He was the reason why I added SCHM as my second concentration. His class is challenging but really interesting and helpful for your career. Some comments say the test is hard, tbh, exams are not hard if you participate in the class discussion.
Not a good professor. Tests are VERY HARD. I do not take this class again.

Shawn is an amazing person who practices what he preaches. It was so refreshing to take this class and learn about how we, as individuals, are what can make a difference in whatever we do. GAAHHH. Words cannot describe this man. A true gem.

Absolutely loved his class. Incredibly knowledge professor, but his exams are really something else. Extremely difficult unless you pour lots of time into them. However, he curves the class average to a B+.

This professor is by far my favorite I had at Northeastern. He's extremely knowledgeable in Supply Chain, combines class material with personal experiences and is the post inspirational person! You have to study a hard but it's very rewarding at the end. Participate a lot in class, do your homework and you'll do great! 10/10
I enjoyed both classes I had with him.  I didn't find the tests difficult as I put in a lot of time studying and attended all of his review sessions.  Definitely would take again.

Dr. Bennett is great. I had him for BIOL 2301. His lectures are long and his handwriting is sometimes impossible to read but he explains concepts very well. His exams are pretty hard but curved. Put in the work and a B or above is guaranteed. He's also just very nice and overall a wonderful guy. Highly recommend taking him for 2301 and 3611.
Is this guy a professor or the reincarnation of 2018 LeBron? Great guy, looks out for you, lecture heavy, group projects. Accessible outside of class. Had him for biochem, tests were hard but curved.
Definitely recommended!
Two thumbs up! Liked the class and all the activities!
One of the most straightforward learning experiences I've had taking his genetics class.  As others here have said, just put in the work and follow the protocol.

Show up for the lectures and he will take notice. He is very helpful outside of class and hosts zoom office hours at night, and will host more before exams. He genuinely cares about his students, and wants to see everyone succeed in the class. Do the homework, go over the study guides, and go to office hours and you will be set.
Study sessions are very helpful.

I received a B+ in the genetics class, but admit I had my own issues going on. He helped me overall, but with missing class and some assignments my grade dropped. I respect his teaching style a lot and will take him again
I've had him for several classes. Nice and very helpful. I liked the lectures and one really opened me up to the field I'm going into. Exams were easier as he gives a lot of study material.

Most of the exams are based primarily on the Achieve homework. All lectures are based on the textbook. READ THE TEXTBOOK, master the achieve questions and you'll be set. Hes a great guy, super funny and enjoyable lecture.
Really liked to overall

Took his mo bio/genetics class last Spring.  Really liked the class and his approach. The key is to follow what he says when studying for exams, and this is based largely on the lectures.  A lot of students procrastinated and didn't attend any study sessions or watch the videos.
Clear for me and others that went to class.  Learned a lot.

If you can sit through his lecture and actually listen to what he's saying you'll know all you need to. Worst e-handwriting ever because he uses a mouse. This guy needs an apple pen or something. But he'll tell you what to learn for exams, which is clutch tbh. Such a king, my only regret is that I didn't talk to him more.
I personally enjoyed this Genetics class the most.  I learned a ton and appreciated all lectures and activities. He's one of the best at the university.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall enjoyed both his Biochem and Genetics classes. He provides a lot of assistance and his exams are actually easy if you follow his study guides which are based a lot off the lectures.  My friends and I all did very well overall. Just show up and do the work.

He's a super funny and chill guy it's just that his tests are all application based, insanely difficult and reviewing the slides won't help you. It's better to take this class with a different professor but if you aren't able to then make sure to attend his office hours, only look at the achieve questions and read the case studies he hands out.

I took biochem with Prof. Bennett as a summer course and it genuinely traumatized me.

- exams were based off Achieve, NOT what was covered in class (I only picked up on this on the final, where people either got 90-100s or 30-40s)
- get ready to teach yourself the material...
- didn't seem to know any topics
- would give wrong answers to questions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved all the lectures.  He goes into details that are very fascinating and is also very open to students.  Other professors could learn from him as he actually helps students in their pursuits.
Leverages online assignments with in-class problem solving very well. One study tip is to pay attention to the in-class activities!
Overall I liked his genetics course a lot
Enjoyed biochem with him a ton. Will definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: 3611 - Great guy. He wants you to learn and succeed and will do his best to help you. Exams are difficult but curved. Group projects/participation assignments. Class follows lecture-style. Biochemistry is a lot of work so get ready to learn.
Make sure you go to his review sessions and listen closely.

I personally enjoyed his teaching style compared to other professors.  He gives a good balance of lecture and in class activities to help balance things.  Only complaint I've heard is from students who don't like group work.
Fun prof overall. I was able to interact a lot with my classmates for assignments.

Good balance of activities to help with learning.  Some people don't like group projects, but these same people also didn't study much in the class and turned a lot of work in late or not at all.  He's a very fair grader.
The quizzes were helpful in preparing for the exams, and he was accessible outside of class.
Class prepped me for my MCAT unlike any other class I've taken.
I took both a spring and summer class with him, and he was great. If you're serious about learning and planning to continue beyond undergrad, he lays a strong foundation for future success
Worth it for sure.
Enjoyed him and learned a lot.
I like him a lot, nice, and caring.  I went through a crises and he was very accomodating.

Some of these reviews are completely unsubstantiated.  He's been my favorite professor at this school, and me and my peers take every class he offers.  He helps you outside of class and cares about your development.
Very accessible prof that really will help your career in science.  I found my first internship through him, and this was the missing piece in my medical school application.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Loved the class! Definitely would take him again.

I'm taking the MCAT soon and his genetics course was superb with learning material for the exam.  As others have said, everything is online so I know lots of students collaborated on tests. I'm sure this will change in the future to encourage a small minority of students to study more.

Dr. Bennett is very nice and cares about his students. This class was a very easy A, all exams/quizzes were online, but nobody in the class actually learned anything. The lectures are hard to follow and he tends to get sidetracked... If you need to know genetics for your career, don't take him. If you just need the credit, then I would go for it!

I learned nothing in this class. All assignments, quizzes, and exams were online, so everyone did well in the class. If you want a good foundation of genetics, do not take him. If you want an easy A, then do.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I worked hard and learned a lot in his class, and really enjoyed all the practical applications to the field.  Comparatively, other biology professors really lack the application principles and make the classes boring - this class had plenty of variety to make it both interesting and fun.

Not a difficult class considering 90% of the assignments and tests are online. He cares about you personally and will work with you to get the best possible grade. If you care, you'll do well. Funny guy, all over the place during class. Great guy though, he knows a lot and wants you to succeed. Plenty of extra credit and free points along the way.
Really enjoyed this class and learned a ton.

I wish all my professors taught like him.  I feel I learned a ton and actually can use this material.  Would definitely take again and recommend to anyone who wants to advance in this or related fields.

Super flexible professor that knows the subject inside and out.  Yes, he reads his slides a bit because there are so many students that barely know English!  Other classes students complain because professors ramble.  He tells you this in the beginning, and everything you need to know is in his notes for exams.
Loved the guy!  Would definitely take again!

People that post here obviously didn't attend class or ignored all the help Professor Bennett gives. 90% of the class material cannot even be found in a modern day text book and is directly applicable to the field.  It's a terrific class, you will learn a ton, and is great for anyone wanting to study beyond the basics and prep for the next step.

Do not take this class. Bennett is a very nice person but cannot teach for the life of him and constantly assigns long discussion boards and group projects that just felt like busy work. Two weeks in people stopped showing up since you don't learn from his lectures. Even as someone who went to most lectures, I feel like I hardly learned anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have had here. At some points it had honestly felt like he was out to get us. The tests were obnoxiously hard and your only hope is that the curve is good. His lectures are mostly unclear and often times I found myself not understanding what I was even required to know from this course.

Best lectures I've had! He provides everything you need and is exciting.  Other professors give a lot of material that is not relevant, but this is the first class where I learned very relevant material and even new skills.  I would definitely take it again.  Most people that complain on here clearly didn't attend many of the classes.

Prof. Bennett is a very nice guy, but his style of lecture is so not great. Ge doesn't really make his expectation clear of what you should know for the course. He is a helpful person during office hours, but his exams are so difficult for no reason.  There is also a 10+ page paper and final exam, which is so unnecessary.

I'm convinced all good reviews about this guy are fake. Absolutely terrible. His lectures were very obviously stolen and he reads right off the slides, so there's no point in going to lectures. No one learned a thing but exams were online so most people got good grades. This class made me lose my love for bio and consider changing majors.
Dr. Bennett is caring but his lecutres are fast and its hard to catch small details. All of this tests are online and he has lots of group projects and opportunities to raise your grade.

He's definitely a character. His tests had many questions he made mistakes on, so if you get a 60 he'll eventually give you back half of those lost points and you'll end up with an 85. He's funny and cares about the subject, he's just a little all over the place. He also had a cameo from snoop dog about doing your homework which was a little funny.
This teacher has poor lecture skills and cancels his classes way too often

He cares a lot and was very accessible to reach, but lectures were confusing and all over the place. He didn't provide a strong foundation for the content and got sidetracked with unnecessary details. Tests were hard but they were online. He curved all the tests bc everyone failed and assigned a 10pg paper. Very generous grader though which carried
Enjoyed the course.  To achieve a high grade, definitely attend class and participate.
Learned a lot, great lectures, would definitely take again.
Great class and learned a lot!
Great all around experience. Excellent teaching and gives solid career advice.

Great professor and tremendous lecturer.  Encouraged collaboration with students (which some didn't like because they didn't want to do any work).  He's very helpful and has office hours you can schedule that fits your calendar.  A lot of comments here from disgruntled students who likely didn't do the course assignments.  Definitely take again!

His lectures covered cutting edge material, and were definitely not stolen.  I know some classmates simply did not do the work for this class so are posting false comments here.  He's more than fair, and seeks your best interest.  His grading is generous, and gives study reviews.  Do the work and you are fine. Highly recommended, will take again.

Dr. Bennett is one of the best professors I've ever had.  His lectures are amazing and he shares profound insights that inspire learning.  The comments below from other students are not true.  His exams are based off his exciting lectures and if you study, they are not hard.  The course is well organized, and all requirements are laid out clearly.

This class was an absolute joke. He stole slides form another professor and couldn't even relay the information to us. When someone asked a question he would stumble over his words and give a roundabout answer of nothing. He had no clue what he was doing the entire time. We all failed his tests and he was shocked to see this, as if he taught us.
This class was a complete joke. He should not be allowed to teach.
Apparently he is a 5/5 superhost on vrbo and airbnb, but definitely would not give him 5/5 as a professor. I would avoid if possible.
Lecture heavy class. Average always failing. Did not use his own slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He should be smart considering he came from johns hopkins... no. He couldn't even present basic material. The class is literally AP bio pt.2 so everyone already knows it. However, his test ere ridiculously hard and we all failed them and he was forced to curve it. He also made us write a 10-15 pg paper and no one has a 100 so far. Run.

He would read off of another professor's slides and then try to add some of his own words while presenting what contradicted what the slides said. we all failed his tests so bad that he had to curve, and while generous, it still did not get me where i wanted. He made us do a 10-15 page paper and so far no one has a 100. He is actually the worst.
